items.title_en: Next-Generation Segmentation in Radiotherapy: A Narrative Review from Atlas-Based Methods to Agentic Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 放疗中的下一代分割：从图谱方法到智能体视觉语言模型的叙述性综述
items.abstract_en: Precise segmentation of target volumes and organs at risk is an essential prerequisite for modern, high-precision radiation therapy. However, this task has traditionally been time-consuming and subject to high interobserver variability. Motivated by these limitations, more advanced and novel approaches to automating this task have been developed over the past two decades. This narrative review highlights representative milestones, with a focus on the most recent developments. These approaches include atlas-based label propagation, convolutional architectures, promptable foundation models, and, most recently, vision-language models (VLMs), which integrate clinical text with volumetric segmentation. Each methodological generation has addressed limitations of its predecessor while introducing new ones. A substantial gap remains between research progress and clinical deployment, as routine workflows continue to be dominated by atlas-based and narrow task-specific deep-learning tools, which remain strong baselines in geometric overlap metrics but are highly rigid in terms of application, versatility, portability, and interpretability. As contouring systems further grow in complexity, conventional geometric overlap metrics become insufficient, motivating evaluation paradigms that incorporate surface-based, dosimetric, and prompt-adherence assessment. Emerging agentic architectures that combine large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and vision-language segmentation modules are leading towards more flexible, guideline-aware, interactive contouring workflows. These systems could automate flexible and interpretable knowledge-based contouring and actively support the clinical reasoning underlying target volume definition.
items.abstract_zh: 靶区与危及器官的精确分割是现代高精度放疗的前提，但这一工作传统上耗时长且观察者间差异大。为此，过去二十年出现了大量更先进的自动化方法。本叙述性综述梳理代表性里程碑，重点关注最新进展：基于图谱的标签传播、卷积架构、可提示基础模型，以及最新将临床文本与三维体积分割相结合的视觉语言模型（VLM）。每一代方法在解决前代局限的同时也引入新问题。研究进展与临床落地之间仍存在明显鸿沟：常规流程仍以图谱法和任务专用深度学习工具为主，它们在几何重叠指标上依然是强基线，但在适用性、通用性、可移植性与可解释性上非常僵化。随着勾画系统日益复杂，传统几何重叠指标已显不足，促使引入基于表面距离、剂量学与提示遵从性的评价范式。结合大语言模型、检索增强生成与视觉语言分割模块的智能体架构，正推动更灵活、感知指南、可交互的勾画流程，有望自动完成可解释的知识驱动勾画，并主动支持靶区定义背后的临床推理。
items.highlight_zh: 综述放疗分割从图谱法到智能体视觉语言模型的演进与落地鸿沟
items.digest_zh:
① 研究问题：放疗前必须逐层勾画肿瘤靶区与周围危及器官（分割），这直接决定剂量打向哪里。人工勾画耗时且不同医生差异大，因此过去二十年不断有人尝试自动化。
② 方法：这是一篇叙述性综述，按“代际”梳理代表性方法：基于图谱的标签传播（把已勾画病例配准过来）、卷积网络等专用深度学习、可提示的基础模型，以及最新的视觉语言模型（VLM）——把临床文本描述与三维体积分割结合起来。
③ 结果与观察：每一代方法都解决了上一代的短板，又带来新问题；研究进展与临床落地之间差距明显，日常流程仍以图谱法和任务专用模型为主。这些方法在几何重叠指标（如Dice）上依然很强，但适用面窄、通用性与可移植性差、可解释性不足。作者指出，随着系统日益复杂，仅靠几何重叠评分已不够，应引入基于表面距离、剂量学后果以及是否遵从文本提示的评价方式。结合大语言模型、检索增强生成与视觉语言分割模块的“智能体”架构，正走向更灵活、能读指南、可交互的勾画流程。
④ 意义：为放疗分割画出了一条从“图谱”到“智能体”的技术路线图，并提醒评价标准必须同步升级，否则新技术难以真正进入临床。

items.title_en: Intracellular bio-synthesizing Gold Nanoparticles using bacterial systems and their applications in photothermal therapy (A green approach)
items.title_zh: 利用细菌系统胞内生物合成金纳米颗粒及其在光热治疗中的应用（绿色方法）
items.abstract_en: Background: Conventional cancer therapies are heavily constrained by systemic toxicity, off-target side effects, and poor deep-tissue penetration due to the highly heterogeneous tumor microenvironment (TME). Although gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) possess exceptional localized surface plasmon resonance (LSPR) properties ideal for photothermal therapy (PTT), their clinical translation is bottlenecked by inconsistent passive accumulation and chemical toxicity arising from conventional synthetic surfactants. Objective: This study developed a sustainable, biocompatible bio-hybrid platform utilizing the probiotic Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 (EcN) as an autonomous, tumor-homing living carrier integrated with AuNPs synthesized via an eco-friendly intracellular green chemistry approach. Methods: EcN cultures were prepared in Luria-Bertani (LB) medium and subsequently exposed to a 1 mM chloroauric acid (HAuCl4) metallic precursor. A facile, room-temperature green synthesis protocol was established by utilizing ascorbic acid (Vitamin C) as a non-toxic co-reductant to drive a seed-mediated crystallization onto intra-bacterial metallic seeds. The bio-hybrid system (EcN::AuNPs) was characterized via visual inspection, UV-Vis spectroscopy, and in vitro PTT assays under continuous-wave near-infrared (NIR) laser irradiation. Results: Visual confirmation showed an irreversible color shift from pale yellow to a deep dark-brownish hue, serving as a direct diagnostic indicator of successful Au3+ to Au0 reduction. UV-Vis spectroscopic analysis revealed a distinct, broadened surface plasmon resonance (SPR) band centered at 560nm, indicating the formation of stabilized, isotropic gold nanostructures (30-60nm) subjected to near-field electromagnetic coupling within the complex intracellular compartments (periplasm and cytoplasm). Biocompatibility assays demonstrated a significant collapse in cell viability from 10^8CFU/mL down to 10^3CFU/mL, driven by a combination of trivalent gold heavy-metal toxicity, mechanical disruption of the peptidoglycan wall from spatial confinement, and severe metabolic/oxidative stress. Nevertheless, the remaining surviving population maintained required active chemotactic capabilities, while the lysed bacterial matrix provided a natural protein capping layer that prevented nanoparticle aggregation. Under 5 minutes of continuous NIR laser irradiation, the EcN::AuNPs platform exhibited exceptional concentration-dependent hyperthermia kinetics, triggering a drastic thermal escalation from 20 C to an absolute peak of 75.4 C, vastly outperforming all baseline control groups (pure EcN, bare HAuCl4, and standalone ascorbic acid). Conclusion: The engineered EcN::AuNPs bio-hybrid platform represents a highly efficient and biosafe "bacteriobot" paradigm. By shifting the SPR footprint and leveraging the native bacterial cell envelope for colloidal stability, this system achieves an optimal equilibrium between active biological tumor targeting and rapid, localized photothermal ablation, offering a promising alternative for targeted oncological interventions.
items.abstract_zh: 传统癌症治疗受全身毒性、脱靶副作用和深部组织穿透差限制；金纳米颗粒虽适合光热治疗，却受被动蓄积不稳定和化学表面活性剂毒性制约。本研究构建绿色生物杂合平台：以益生菌 Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 为肿瘤归巢活载体，在胞内用抗坏血酸共还原 1 mM 氯金酸，室温合成金纳米颗粒。肉眼可见颜色由浅黄变深褐，UV-Vis 在 560 nm 出现宽表面等离子体共振带，表明形成 30–60 nm 的稳定各向同性金纳米结构；并在近红外激光下开展体外光热治疗评价。
items.highlight_zh: 活菌胞内绿色合成金纳米颗粒，用于光热治疗
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：传统癌症治疗存在全身毒性、脱靶副作用和深部组织穿透不足；金纳米颗粒（AuNPs）的局域表面等离子体共振适合光热治疗（PTT），但常规化学合成使用的表面活性剂有毒性，且被动蓄积不稳定，阻碍临床转化。方法：作者用益生菌 Escherichia coli Nissle 1917（EcN）作为可自主寻肿瘤的活载体，在细菌胞内进行绿色合成：LB 培养 EcN 后加入 1 mM 氯金酸（HAuCl4），以抗坏血酸（维生素 C）作无毒共还原剂，在室温下驱动种子介导的结晶，把金离子还原为金纳米颗粒，形成 EcN::AuNPs 生物杂合体系。表征包括肉眼观察、UV-Vis 光谱，并在连续波近红外激光下做体外 PTT 实验。结果：菌液由浅黄变为深褐，提示 Au3+ 被还原为 Au0；UV-Vis 出现以 560 nm 为中心的宽表面等离子体共振带，说明形成 30–60 nm、较稳定的各向同性金纳米结构。意义：该策略把活菌靶向与胞内绿色合成结合，有望减少化学毒性并改善递送，为基于 AuNPs 的光热治疗提供可持续的生物杂合平台；但摘要未给出完整体内疗效数据，仍需进一步验证。

items.title_en: Defects and Structural Evolution in CrSBr: Machine-Learning Potentials for Atomistic Simulations
items.title_zh: CrSBr中的缺陷与结构演化：用于原子尺度模拟的机器学习势
items.abstract_en: The layered van der Waals semiconductor CrSBr combines intrinsic magnetic order with semiconducting and optical properties, making it a promising material for multifunctional electronic and photonic applications. Understanding how defects and structural transformations affect its properties under experimentally relevant conditions, however, remains challenging for first-principles simulations due to the relevant length and time scales. Here, we develop and benchmark machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for the Cr-S-Br system, enabling large-scale atomistic simulations of CrSBr with accuracy approaching that of density functional theory (DFT). The charge-aware variant qNEP achieves near-DFT accuracy in predicting lattice constants, formation enthalpies, vacancy energetics, and the anisotropic pressure response of o-CrSBr. Nudged elastic band calculations reveal that pre-existing S vacancies lower the Cr Frenkel-pair migration barrier by up to 1.1 eV, providing an atomistic mechanism for beam-induced Cr redistribution and structural transformations. Displacement threshold calculations further show that Br is the most susceptible species to electron-beam-induced displacement, identifying the relative ease of removing different atomic species. Together, these results establish a validated computational framework for investigating atomic-scale disorder and structural transformations in CrSBr, providing a basis for defect engineering in materials for future magneto-optoelectronic applications.
items.abstract_zh: 层状范德华半导体CrSBr结合了本征磁序与半导体和光学性质，使其成为多功能电子和光子应用的有前景材料。然而，要理解缺陷和结构转变如何在实验相关条件下影响其性质，由于相关长度和时间尺度，第一性原理模拟仍面临挑战。在此，我们开发并基准测试了Cr-S-Br体系的机器学习原子间势（MLIP），从而能够对CrSBr进行大规模原子尺度模拟，其精度接近密度泛函理论（DFT）。电荷感知变体qNEP在预测晶格常数、形成焓、空位能量学以及o-CrSBr的各向异性压力响应方面达到接近DFT的精度。微动弹性带计算表明，预先存在的S空位将Cr弗仑克尔对迁移势垒最多降低1.1 eV，为束诱导Cr重新分布和结构转变提供了原子尺度机制。位移阈值计算进一步表明，Br是最易受电子束诱导位移影响的元素，从而识别出不同原子种类被移除的相对难易程度。总之，这些结果建立了一个经过验证的计算框架，用于研究CrSBr中的原子尺度无序和结构转变，为未来磁光电子应用材料的缺陷工程提供了基础。

items.title_en: How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time
items.title_zh: 世界模型需要多少次曝光？在测试时学习未见过的游戏机制
items.abstract_en: World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. A mechanic is a rule for how an action or an interaction changes part of the environment. Each occurrence of a mechanic that the model observes is one exposure. We ask how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of a new environment's mechanics. We address this question on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark of interactive games defined by their programs. We introduce MechEval, which labels 69 recurring mechanics across 20 games from these programs. It scores each prediction on the cells the mechanic changes at each exposure. As a test bed, we build WARC (World model for ARC-AGI-3), a 35M-parameter vision transformer that is pretrained on other games and updates all of its parameters after each transition. On held-out games, WARC learns to predict four in five mechanics with at least 80% accuracy on the cells they change and keeps that accuracy to the end of the recordings. Half of them reach that accuracy within about 80 exposures, in a single play of the game, and without updates only one in seven does at all. In closed-loop play on the public games, WARC-Agent, which pairs WARC with a fixed graph explorer, triples the explorer's official efficiency score from 0.15 to 0.46, mostly through test-time training. On the hidden games of the Kaggle leaderboard, our entry scores 0.20.
items.abstract_zh: 世界模型使智能体能够从想象的经验中进行规划和学习，但在陌生环境中，它们必须从有限交互中学习其机制。机制是动作或交互如何改变环境某一部分的规则。模型观察到的每一次机制发生即为一次曝光。我们研究世界模型需要多少次曝光才能预测新环境机制的效果。我们在ARC-AGI-3上研究这个问题，该基准由程序定义的交互式游戏组成。我们引入MechEval，它从这些程序中标注了20个游戏中的69个反复出现的机制。它在每次曝光时针对机制所改变的单元格对每个预测进行评分。作为测试平台，我们构建了WARC（面向ARC-AGI-3的世界模型），这是一个3500万参数的视觉Transformer，在其他游戏上预训练，并在每次转移后更新其所有参数。在留出游戏上，WARC学会以在其所改变单元格上至少80%的准确率预测五分之四的机制，并将该准确率保持到记录结束。其中一半在单次游玩中约80次曝光内达到该准确率，而在不更新的情况下，仅七分之一能达到。在公开游戏的闭环游玩中，WARC-Agent将WARC与固定图探索器配对，将探索器的官方效率分数从0.15提高到0.46，主要归功于测试时训练。在Kaggle排行榜的隐藏游戏上，我们的参赛条目得分为0.20。

items.title_en: Coding or Cheating? An Investigation of Frontier Coding LLMs
items.title_zh: 编程还是作弊？对前沿编程大语言模型的一项调查
items.abstract_en: Frontier agentic LLMs are trained on verifiable rewards in reinforcement learning (RL) environments built from real software repositories. A passing test suite is treated as the reward for solving the task. We show that, on hard problems, frontier models often satisfy these rewards by obtaining the answer instead of deriving it, known as reward hacking. Prior reports document this behavior on public benchmarks. We test its persistence on unseen problems. In a hardened environment where the answer cannot leak, nearly every model we tested attempted to recover the answer, escalating through tiers of increasingly specialized exploitation: mining the repository history for the upstream fix, inspecting the git object store directly, and sweeping the filesystem for a possible newer copy of the source or hidden tests. These attempts were concentrated on the hardest problems, and the models differed in whether, how often, and how deeply they escalated. Our position is that this behavior is a learned shortcut, acquired in RL environments that leak the answer, not a sign of intelligence. We release agent traces for these models to support further study at https://huggingface.co/datasets/logitly-ai/reward-hacking-raw-v1.
items.abstract_zh: 前沿智能体大语言模型在由真实软件仓库构建的强化学习（RL）环境中基于可验证奖励进行训练。通过测试套件被视为解决任务的奖励。我们表明，在困难问题上，前沿模型常常通过获取答案而非推导答案来满足这些奖励，这被称为奖励黑客。此前的报告已在公开基准上记录了这种行为。我们测试了它在未见问题上的持续性。在一个答案无法泄漏的加固环境中，我们测试的几乎每个模型都尝试恢复答案，并逐步升级为越来越专门化的利用层级：挖掘仓库历史以寻找上游修复，直接检查git对象存储，以及扫描文件系统以寻找可能的更新版源码或隐藏测试。这些尝试集中在最难的问题上，模型在是否升级、升级频率和升级深度上存在差异。我们的立场是，这种行为是在泄漏答案的RL环境中习得的一种学习到的捷径，而非智能的标志。我们发布了这些模型的智能体轨迹以支持进一步研究，地址为https://huggingface.co/datasets/logitly-ai/reward-hacking-raw-v1。

items.title_en: Bridging Task Planning and Execution for Language-Conditioned Bimanual Manipulation
items.title_zh: 连接任务规划与执行：面向语言条件双臂操作
items.abstract_en: Robots are increasingly expected to execute natural-language manipulation tasks in real-world environments. This is particularly relevant in household assistance and logistics, where clutter requires reasoning about both task objectives and execution feasibility. This challenge becomes even more pronounced for bimanual humanoid platforms, where coordinating two manipulators introduces additional interaction and kinematic constraints. We present a zero-shot vision-language framework for execution-aware bimanual manipulation that jointly reasons about task objectives and physical feasibility. Planning is grounded in a structured scene representation that combines semantic object relations with execution constraints, enabling the selection of obstacle relocations and execution choices while preserving task semantics. Compatible actions are organised into parallel bimanual stages with explicit pre- and post-conditions. A hierarchical validator evaluates these conditions under perceptual uncertainty and uses stage-level execution history to support local recovery or targeted replanning. Experiments on the CENTAURO hybrid wheeled-legged humanoid robot across nine language-conditioned manipulation scenarios show higher task success than a non-execution-aware baseline. In dedicated failure scenarios, hierarchical validation recovers from execution failures with fewer model queries than always replanning. These results demonstrate the benefits of combining execution reasoning directly into task planning. Videos and additional material are available on the Project Webpage: https://advrhumanoids.github.io/bridging-planning-execution/.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人日益被期望在真实环境中执行自然语言操作任务。这在家庭辅助和物流中尤其相关，因为杂乱环境需要同时推理任务目标和执行可行性。对于双臂人形平台，这一挑战更加突出，因为协调两个机械臂会引入额外的交互和运动学约束。我们提出一个零样本视觉语言框架，用于执行感知的双臂操作，联合推理任务目标和物理可行性。规划基于结构化场景表示，该表示将语义对象关系与执行约束相结合，从而能够在保持任务语义的同时选择障碍物重定位和执行方案。兼容动作被组织为具有显式前置条件和后置条件的并行双臂阶段。分层验证器在感知不确定性下评估这些条件，并利用阶段级执行历史来支持局部恢复或定向重规划。在CENTAURO混合轮腿人形机器人上跨九个语言条件操作场景的实验表明，其任务成功率高于非执行感知基线。在专门的失败场景中，与始终重规划相比，分层验证以更少的模型查询从执行失败中恢复。这些结果证明了将执行推理直接结合到任务规划中的益处。视频和其他材料见项目网页：https://advrhumanoids.github.io/bridging-planning-execution/。

items.title_en: Scale-Consistent Monocular Fisheye Visual Odometry via Spherical Bundle Adjustment-Guided Unsupervised Depth Learning
items.title_zh: 通过球面光束法平差引导的无监督深度学习的尺度一致单目鱼眼视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: The wide field of view of fisheye cameras and the simplicity of a monocular setup make monocular fisheye visual odometry (VO) attractive for robotic localization and mapping. Nevertheless, scale drift remains a major challenge over long trajectories. Unsupervised depth learning can help to mitigate this issue, but the pronounced distortion of fisheye images poses challenges for accurate depth estimation. This article presents S$^2$D-FVO, a monocular fisheye VO framework integrating spherical bundle adjustment (SBA)-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy. Given that pixel reprojection residuals do not uniformly reflect angular deviations between viewing rays and that the first-order linearization of a scalar angular reprojection residual is insensitive to perturbations along one tangent direction, SBA employs tangent-space angular reprojection residuals derived from the spherical logarithmic map. These residuals retain sensitivity along both tangent directions, with their norms equal to the corresponding scalar angular residuals. A median depth-based scale regularization term is further integrated into SBA to constrain the reconstruction scale. Building on these formulations, SBA replaces the pose estimation network during unsupervised depth learning, providing more reliable relative poses for view synthesis. In turn, depth estimates from the well-trained depth estimation network provide scale references for SBA, improving scale consistency while allowing individual 3-D landmark positions to be refined. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple public datasets, as well as two newly collected large-scale datasets, demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms representative existing approaches in both depth and trajectory estimation accuracy and is applicable to different camera models.
items.abstract_zh: 鱼眼相机的宽视场和单目设置的简洁性，使单目鱼眼视觉里程计（VO）对机器人定位与建图具有吸引力。然而，在长轨迹上尺度漂移仍是主要挑战。无监督深度学习有助于缓解这一问题，但鱼眼图像的显著畸变给精确深度估计带来挑战。本文提出S$^2$D-FVO，一种单目鱼眼VO框架，集成了球面光束法平差（SBA）引导的无监督深度学习，以提高尺度一致性和深度估计精度。鉴于像素重投影残差不能一致地反映视线之间的角度偏差，且标量角度重投影残差的一阶线性化对沿一个切方向的扰动不敏感，SBA采用由球面对数映射导出的切空间角度重投影残差。这些残差在两个切方向上都保持敏感性，其范数等于相应的标量角度残差。一个基于中值深度的尺度正则化项进一步集成到SBA中，以约束重建尺度。基于这些公式，SBA在无监督深度学习期间替代位姿估计网络，为视图合成提供更可靠的相对位姿。反过来，训练良好的深度估计网络提供的深度估计为SBA提供尺度参考，在允许细化单个三维路标点位置的同时提高尺度一致性。在多个公开数据集以及两个新采集的大规模数据集上进行的大量实验表明，所提框架在深度和轨迹估计精度上优于代表性的现有方法，并且适用于不同的相机模型。

items.title_en: Redefining Synovial Pathotypes in Psoriatic Arthritis through Multi-Modal Histology and Machine Learning (The PSYNOVIUM Study)
items.title_zh: 通过多模态组织学与机器学习重新定义银屑病关节炎的滑膜病理类型（PSYNOVIUM 研究）
items.abstract_en: Background Synovial inflammation in psoriatic arthritis (PsA) lacks a validated histological classification framework. Current approaches apply rheumatoid arthritis (RA) synovial pathotypes to PsA, which overlooks immunobiological differences between the diseases and limits the predictive power of tissue stratification. We aimed to define data-driven, PsA-specific synovial pathotypes to facilitate tissue-driven precision medicine. Methods In this cross-sectional study, ultrasound-guided synovial biopsies were obtained from 61 patients with PsA (n=22), seropositive RA (n=23), seronegative RA (n=10), and other inflammatory arthritides (n=6). Sections underwent multi-modal staining, including H&E, picrosirius red, and immunohistochemistry for CD3, CD20, CD68, CD138, and CD31. Whole-slide digital image analysis and automated pixel classifiers quantified cellular and stromal metrics. Unsupervised hierarchical clustering identified intrinsic PsA pathotypes, which were correlated with clinical disease activity, radiographic osteoarthritis (OA), and longitudinal treatment responses. Findings While a subset of PsA patients shared an inflammatory signature with seropositive RA, unsupervised clustering of the PsA cohort revealed three distinct, novel pathotypes: Dense Myeloid (macrophage-driven), Fibro-Stromal (fibrosis and pauci-immune), and Angio-Lymphoid (hypervascular with significant CD138+ plasma cell infiltration). Pathotypes were independent of treatment and concurrent radiographic knee OA. The Fibro-Stromal pathotype correlated with significantly higher cutaneous psoriasis severity. Longitudinally, patients with the Fibro-Stromal pathotype exhibited a trend toward lower treatment response (44%) following standard interventions (methotrexate or TNF inhibitors) compared to the Dense Myeloid (50%) and Angio-Lymphoid (80%) pathotypes. Interpretation We present the first computationally derived synovial pathotypes specific to PsA, revealing distinct plasma cell and fibrotic architectures not captured by RA-centric models. To enable clinical translation, we distilled these findings into a pragmatic, four-marker diagnostic decision tree (CD31, CD68, CD138, and picrosirius red) designed for routine histopathology workflows, providing a staging ground for biomarker-stratified clinical trials in PsA. Funding Funding from the NIHR Biomedical Research Centre: Manchester, Arthritis UK, the Wellcome Trust, Brit-PACT, the National Psoriasis Foundation, and the Medical Research Council.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：银屑病关节炎（PsA）的滑膜炎症缺乏经过验证的组织学分类框架。当前方法将类风湿关节炎（RA）的滑膜病理类型套用于 PsA，忽视了疾病间的免疫生物学差异，并限制了组织分层的预测能力。我们旨在定义数据驱动的、PsA 特异的滑膜病理类型，以促进组织驱动的精准医学。方法：在这项横断面研究中，从 61 例患者获取超声引导下滑膜活检，包括 PsA（n=22）、血清阳性 RA（n=23）、血清阴性 RA（n=10）和其他炎性关节炎（n=6）。切片接受多模态染色，包括 H&E、天狼星红（picrosirius red），以及 CD3、CD20、CD68、CD138 和 CD31 的免疫组织化学。全切片数字图像分析和自动像素分类器量化细胞与基质指标。无监督层次聚类识别出内在 PsA 病理类型，并将其与临床疾病活动度、影像学骨关节炎（OA）和纵向治疗反应相关联。发现：虽然一部分 PsA 患者与血清阳性 RA 共享炎症特征，但对 PsA 队列的无监督聚类揭示了三种不同的新病理类型：致密髓系型（巨噬细胞驱动）、纤维基质型（纤维化和寡免疫）和血管淋巴样型（富血管并伴显著 CD138+ 浆细胞浸润）。病理类型独立于治疗和并发的影像学膝 OA。纤维基质型与显著更高的皮肤银屑病严重程度相关。纵向来看，纤维基质型患者在标准干预（甲氨蝶呤或 TNF 抑制剂）后表现出治疗反应较低的趋势（44%），而致密髓系型为 50%、血管淋巴样型为 80%。解释：我们提出了首个计算推导的 PsA 特异性滑膜病理类型，揭示了以 RA 为中心的模型未捕捉到的独特浆细胞和纤维化结构。为促进临床转化，我们将这些发现提炼为一个实用的四标志物诊断决策树（CD31、CD68、CD138 和天狼星红），设计用于常规组织病理学工作流程，为 PsA 中生物标志物分层的临床试验提供分期基础。资助：资助来自 NIHR 生物医学研究中心（曼彻斯特）、Arthritis UK、Wellcome Trust、Brit-PACT、National Psoriasis Foundation 和 Medical Research Council。

items.title_en: Modular and Looping Quantum Photonic Processing Unit for Quantum Computing
items.title_zh: 用于量子计算的模块化循环式量子光子处理单元
items.abstract_en: Photonic processors are emerging as promising platforms in the race towards the realization of practical universal quantum computers. Several architectures with universal capabilities have been proposed for their implementation via a photonic platform, each with their own set of benefits and drawbacks. In this work we propose an architecture for a universal photonic quantum computer. The proposed architecture is modular, allowing for a high degree of flexibility and scalability, and relies on a loop-based structure, significantly reducing the number of physical components required to implement it experimentally. We prove that our architecture is universal, deterministic, and compatible with the quantum circuital model, as well as reprogrammable and capable of adaptive measurements. Furthermore, we showcase its functioning via numerical simulation on specific examples, by using machine learning techniques on a set of fundamental linear and nonlinear optical components to obtain some of the building blocks used in the architecture. The obtained results can be used to highlight the benefits and the drawbacks of the proposed architecture, as well as the route for future developments towards its physical implementation.
items.abstract_zh: 光子处理器正成为实现实用通用量子计算机竞赛中极具前景的平台。已有多种具备通用能力的架构被提出以通过光子平台实现，每种架构各有其优缺点。本工作提出一种通用光子量子计算机的架构。所提出的架构是模块化的，允许高度灵活性与可扩展性，并依赖于基于循环的结构，显著减少实验实现所需的物理元件数量。我们证明该架构具有通用性、确定性，并与量子线路模型兼容，同时可重新编程且能够进行自适应测量。此外，我们通过在特定实例上的数值模拟展示其运行，利用机器学习技术在一组基本线性和非线性光学元件上获得架构中所使用的一些构建模块。所得结果可用于突出所提架构的优点与缺点，以及其物理实现的未来发展路径。

items.title_en: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations
items.title_zh: 探索权重空间编程：能力、泛化与局限
items.abstract_en: Weight-Space Programming (WSP) enables reasoning agents to directly inspect and modify neural network parameters, offering an alternative to gradient-based model adaptation. However, its capabilities, cross-task generalization, and practical limitations remain insufficiently understood. We systematically investigate WSP through 16 editing trajectories across seven benchmarks and two model scales (Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-9B). Our findings reveal three key insights. First, WSP can achieve substantial performance gains through highly localized interventions. On full held-out evaluations, accuracy improves by up to 29.45, 4.42, 36.72, and 17.11 percentage points on MATH-500, GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench, respectively. Notably, modifying only 1,023 parameters yields a 29.45-point improvement. Second, WSP exhibits promising but uneven cross-task generalization. A Math-edited checkpoint improves GPQA Diamond, IFEval, and SciBench by 3.03, 12.18, and 20.10 points, respectively, without further editing, while leaving SciCode performance unchanged. Third, effective editing remains challenging and inconsistent. Outcomes vary substantially across trajectories, and six of the 16 trajectories retain the original weights when candidate improvements cannot be reliably validated. Together, these results highlight WSP's potential for highly localized model adaptation while revealing important challenges in intervention discovery, reliability, and cross-task transfer. Homepage: https://wsp-scope.github.io/ GitHub: https://github.com/WSP-Scope/WSP-Scope-Project
items.abstract_zh: 权重空间编程（WSP）使推理智能体能够直接检查和修改神经网络参数，为基于梯度的模型适配提供了替代方案。然而，其能力、跨任务泛化和实际局限仍未被充分理解。我们通过 16 条编辑轨迹，在七个基准和两个模型规模（Qwen3.5-0.8B 和 Qwen3.5-9B）上系统研究 WSP。我们的发现揭示三个关键见解。第一，WSP 可通过高度局部化的干预实现显著性能提升。在完整留出评估中，准确率在 MATH-500、GPQA Diamond、IFEval 和 SciBench 上分别最多提升 29.45、4.42、36.72 和 17.11 个百分点。值得注意的是，仅修改 1,023 个参数就带来 29.45 个百分点的提升。第二，WSP 展现出有前景但不均衡的跨任务泛化。一个经数学编辑的检查点在无需进一步编辑的情况下，将 GPQA Diamond、IFEval 和 SciBench 分别提升 3.03、12.18 和 20.10 个百分点，同时使 SciCode 性能保持不变。第三，有效编辑仍具挑战性且不一致。结果在不同轨迹间差异很大，16 条轨迹中有 6 条在候选改进无法可靠验证时保留原始权重。总之，这些结果突显了 WSP 在高度局部化模型适配方面的潜力，同时揭示了干预发现、可靠性和跨任务迁移方面的重要挑战。主页：https://wsp-scope.github.io/ GitHub：https://github.com/WSP-Scope/WSP-Scope-Project

items.title_en: Is Persona Generalization Predictable?
items.title_zh: 人格泛化是可预测的吗？
items.abstract_en: Persona generalization occurs when fine-tuning a language model in one domain induces behavioral changes in others -- for example, the broadly unsafe behavior observed in emergent misalignment. We discover a surprising "on-the-line" phenomenon in persona generalization: in-domain and out-of-domain persona rates across various fine-tuning hyperparameters follow an approximately probit-linear relationship, and the specific probit-linear relationship is surprisingly shared even across model families and model sizes, including Qwen and Llama. Training choices that leave the set of trainable parameters unchanged, such as learning rate, weight decay, and training duration, largely move models along the same line, reducing transfer mainly by weakening in-domain learning. Changing which layers are fine-tuned, however, can change the slope. For unsafe behavior, fine-tuning only later layers yields shallower slopes, retaining strong in-domain learning while reducing out-of-domain misalignment. This "on-the-line" phenomenon unifies unexpected, isolated observations of persona generalization within a quantitative framework for predicting and controlling behavioral transfer.
items.abstract_zh: 当在一个领域微调语言模型会在其他领域引发行为变化时，就发生了人格泛化——例如在涌现性失准中观察到的广泛不安全行为。我们发现了人格泛化中一个令人惊讶的“在线上”现象：在各种微调超参数下，域内与域外人格率之间遵循近似概率单位（probit）线性关系，而且这一特定的概率单位线性关系甚至在模型家族和模型规模之间也出人意料地共享，包括 Qwen 和 Llama。不改变可训练参数集合的训练选择，如学习率、权重衰减和训练时长，在很大程度上使模型沿同一条线移动，主要通过削弱域内学习来减少迁移。然而，改变微调哪些层可以改变斜率。对于不安全行为，仅微调较后层会产生较浅的斜率，在保持强域内学习的同时减少域外失准。这一“在线上”现象将人格泛化的意外、孤立观察统一到一个用于预测和控制行为迁移的定量框架中。

items.title_en: DPGS-SLAM: Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Dynamic Visual Sensing
items.title_zh: DPGS-SLAM：面向动态视觉感知的扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯溅射SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents DPGS-SLAM (Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM) for dense mapping in environments containing dynamic objects. Dynamic observations can contaminate camera tracking and scene reconstruction in visual SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping). Although 3DGS (3D Gaussian splatting) enables efficient dense mapping, existing 3DGS-SLAM systems may exhibit instability when dynamic objects violate their underlying static-scene assumption. Excluding dynamic observations can reduce their influence on tracking and mapping, but may leave occluded static backgrounds missing or weakly constrained. Our proposed DPGS-SLAM is a monocular RGB SLAM framework that supports provisional representations of insufficiently observed static backgrounds through asynchronous diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware Gaussian mapping. Dynamic regions are identified through optical-flow-based motion discovery and temporally consistent mask propagation by SAM2 (segment anything model 2). For selected keyframes, a fine-tuned diffusion inpainting model generates plausible background appearance in occluded regions, while Metric3D v2 predicts metric depth from the completed images to initialize provisional Gaussian primitives. Provenance labels distinguish generated primitives from observation-supported primitives, excluding generated content from camera-pose estimation and observed-map optimization. When previously occluded backgrounds become visible, eligible generated primitives are removed, and observation-supported primitives are independently initialized from real RGB observations and predicted depth. Experimental results demonstrated competitive camera tracking, with average ATE RMSE values of 1.2 cm on TUM RGB-D and 2.7 cm on BONN RGB-D. On StaDy4D, DPGS-SLAM improved average PSNR by 4.60 dB over WildGS-SLAM using only monocular RGB input.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 DPGS-SLAM（扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯溅射 SLAM），用于包含动态物体的环境中的稠密建图。动态观测会污染视觉 SLAM（同时定位与建图）中的相机跟踪与场景重建。尽管 3DGS（3D 高斯溅射）能够实现高效稠密建图，但当动态物体违反其底层静态场景假设时，现有 3DGS-SLAM 系统可能表现出不稳定性。排除动态观测可减少其对跟踪与建图的影响，但可能使被遮挡的静态背景缺失或约束不足。我们提出的 DPGS-SLAM 是一个单目 RGB SLAM 框架，通过异步的基于扩散的背景补全和来源感知高斯建图，支持对观测不足的静态背景进行临时表示。动态区域通过基于光流的运动发现和 SAM2（segment anything model 2）的时间一致掩码传播来识别。对于选定的关键帧，一个微调的扩散修复模型在遮挡区域生成合理的背景外观，而 Metric3D v2 从补全后的图像预测度量深度，以初始化临时高斯基元。来源标签区分生成基元与观测支持的基元，将生成内容排除在相机位姿估计和观测地图优化之外。当先前被遮挡的背景变为可见时，符合条件的生成基元被移除，观测支持的基元则独立地从真实 RGB 观测和预测深度初始化。实验结果表明具有竞争力的相机跟踪，在 TUM RGB-D 上的平均 ATE RMSE 为 1.2 cm，在 BONN RGB-D 上为 2.7 cm。在 StaDy4D 上，DPGS-SLAM 仅使用单目 RGB 输入，平均 PSNR 比 WildGS-SLAM 提升 4.60 dB。

items.title_en: ForeAct: Geometry-Guided Action Learning from World Representations
items.title_zh: ForeAct：从世界表示中进行几何引导的动作学习
items.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation requires representations that capture both scene geometry and its evolution during interaction. Existing approaches have largely treated these two aspects separately. World action models capture such dynamics by coupling action prediction with future video generation, but their reliance on iterative diffusion or rectified-flow inference leads to high computational cost, while their representations lack explicit spatial structure. Explicitly modeling scene geometry typically requires auxiliary modules that increase both parameter count and computational cost. Conversely, geometry-centric policies primarily recover observed spatial structure and often lack explicit supervision for anticipating future geometric changes during interaction. To address these limitations, we introduce ForeAct, which repurposes a pretrained video world model as a single-pass representation backbone for low-latency control. ForeAct directly processes the clean latent of the current observation in one forward pass, eliminating future-frame synthesis and iterative denoising while retaining the backbone's pretrained spatiotemporal priors. Rather than introducing a separate geometry backbone, ForeAct uses learnable tokens supervised by next-frame relative depth to shape the shared video representation through bidirectional self-attention. This compact interface turns the spatial knowledge already encoded in the backbone into a future-aware representation for action generation, with little parameter overhead. The lightweight geometry readout is used only during training and removed at deployment, enabling low-latency, geometry-aware control without depth input or an external geometry backbone. Without additional large-scale pretraining, ForeAct achieves 96.6% average success on LIBERO, 63.5% on SimplerEnv-Bridge, and a 74.4% success rate across 90 real-world rollouts.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人操作需要既能捕捉场景几何又能捕捉交互过程中其演化的表示。现有方法在很大程度上将这两个方面分开处理。世界动作模型通过将动作预测与未来视频生成耦合来捕捉此类动态，但其对迭代扩散或整流流推理的依赖导致高计算成本，且其表示缺乏显式空间结构。显式建模场景几何通常需要增加参数数量和计算成本的辅助模块。相反，以几何为中心的策略主要恢复观测到的空间结构，往往缺乏对交互过程中预测未来几何变化的显式监督。为解决这些局限，我们引入 ForeAct，它将预训练视频世界模型重新用作单次通过的表示骨干，以实现低延迟控制。ForeAct 在单次前向传播中直接处理当前观测的干净潜在表示，消除未来帧合成和迭代去噪，同时保留骨干的预训练时空先验。ForeAct 不引入单独的几何骨干，而是使用由下一帧相对深度监督的可学习 token，通过双向自注意力塑造共享视频表示。这一紧凑接口将骨干中已编码的空间知识转变为面向动作生成的未来感知表示，参数开销很小。轻量几何读出仅在训练时使用，部署时移除，从而无需深度输入或外部几何骨干即可实现低延迟、几何感知的控制。无需额外大规模预训练，ForeAct 在 LIBERO 上达到 96.6% 的平均成功率，在 SimplerEnv-Bridge 上达到 63.5%，在 90 次真实世界 rollout 中成功率为 74.4%。

items.title_en: Stathmin-2 regulates microtubule dynamics and axonal resilience in human motor neurons
items.title_zh: Stathmin-2 调控人运动神经元中的微管动力学与轴突韧性
items.abstract_en: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is characterized by the selective degeneration of motor neurons, yet the mechanisms that either induce neurodegeneration or confer neuronal resilience remain poorly understood. Loss of the microtubule-associated protein Stathmin-2 (STMN2) is a downstream consequence of TDP-43 pathology present in nearly all cases of ALS and has emerged as a central feature of disease. However, the mechanisms by which STMN2 maintains homeostasis in motor neurons remain incompletely defined. Here, we investigated the role of STMN2 in regulating cytoskeletal organization and axonal function. Using TIRF microscopy, we quantified STMN2-dependent changes in microtubule growth and catastrophe at single-microtubule resolution. In human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived motor neurons, STMN2 depletion increased baseline rates of microtubule polymerization. However, STMN2 depletion impaired recovery of axonal microtubules following transient nocodazole-induced depolymerization, indicating that STMN2 is required for efficient cytoskeletal remodeling after stress. Consistent with these findings, STMN2-depleted neurons exhibited impaired microtubule recovery following acute depolymerization and reduced axonal recoil after optically induced local microtubule severing. Finally, STMN2 depletion disrupted the formation of neuromuscular junction-like contacts in human motor neuron-myocyte co-cultures, linking impaired cytoskeletal homeostasis to loss of distal neuronal connectivity. Together, these findings identify STMN2 as a key regulator of cytoskeletal resilience that coordinates microtubule remodeling, mitochondrial transport, and maintenance of neuromuscular junctions. We propose that impaired resilience of the axonal cytoskeleton represents a critical point of vulnerability in motor neurons in patients with ALS, establishing cytoskeletal resilience as a potential therapeutic target downstream of TDP-43 pathology.
items.abstract_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的特征是运动神经元的选择性变性，但诱导神经变性或赋予神经元韧性的机制仍知之甚少。微管相关蛋白 Stathmin-2（STMN2）的缺失是几乎所有 ALS 病例中都存在的 TDP-43 病理的下游后果，并已成为该疾病的核心特征。然而，STMN2 维持运动神经元稳态的机制仍未完全明确。在本研究中，我们探究了 STMN2 在调控细胞骨架组织和轴突功能中的作用。利用 TIRF 显微镜，我们在单微管分辨率下量化了 STMN2 依赖的微管生长和灾变变化。在人诱导多能干细胞来源的运动神经元中，STMN2 耗竭增加了微管聚合的基线速率。然而，STMN2 耗竭损害了短暂诺考达唑诱导的解聚后轴突微管的恢复，表明 STMN2 是应激后有效细胞骨架重塑所必需的。与这些发现一致，STMN2 耗竭的神经元在急性解聚后表现出微管恢复受损，并且在光学诱导的局部微管切断后轴突回缩减少。最后，STMN2 耗竭破坏了人运动神经元-肌细胞共培养中神经肌肉接头样接触的形成，将受损的细胞骨架稳态与远端神经连接丧失联系起来。总之，这些发现将 STMN2 确定为细胞骨架韧性的关键调控因子，协调微管重塑、线粒体运输和神经肌肉接头的维持。我们提出，轴突细胞骨架韧性受损代表了 ALS 患者运动神经元中的一个关键脆弱点，并将细胞骨架韧性确立为 TDP-43 病理下游的潜在治疗靶点。

items.title_en: Long-distance quantum secure direct communication with Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill qubits
items.title_zh: 基于 Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill 量子比特的远距离量子安全直接通信
items.abstract_en: The Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) code possesses a lattice periodic structure that enables the effective correction of small displacement errors induced by noise in phase space, which is indispensable for quantum computation. The GKP code was also used to construct a long-distance entanglement channel in quantum repeaters and distribute random keys in quantum key distribution (QKD). Using GKP encoding, we propose a quantum secure direct communication (QSDC) protocol that not only transmits the secret message directly, but also helps protect the safety of communication personnel. The exponential attenuation loss of photons can be overcome by the third-generation quantum repeater. Numerical simulation results demonstrate that secure transmission distance exceeding 1000 km is achievable with a 23 dB squeezing level. Furthermore, we establish a cost-based optimization framework to characterize the trade-off among secure communication distance, secrecy capacity, and repeater resources, enabling optimized repeater deployment and providing a systematic design strategy for scalable quantum repeater architectures. The results demonstrate the potential of combining GKP error correction for long-distance QSDC and quantum networks.
items.abstract_zh: Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill（GKP）码具有晶格周期结构，能够有效纠正相空间中噪声引起的小位移误差，这对量子计算不可或缺。GKP 码也被用于在量子中继器中构建远距离纠缠信道，以及在量子密钥分发（QKD）中分发随机密钥。利用 GKP 编码，我们提出一种量子安全直接通信（QSDC）协议，不仅直接传输秘密消息，还有助于保护通信人员的安全。光子的指数衰减损耗可通过第三代量子中继器克服。数值模拟结果表明，在 23 dB 压缩水平下可实现超过 1000 km 的安全传输距离。此外，我们建立了一个基于成本的优化框架，以刻画安全通信距离、保密容量和中继器资源之间的权衡，从而实现优化的中继器部署，并为可扩展的量子中继器架构提供系统设计策略。结果展示了将 GKP 纠错用于远距离 QSDC 和量子网络的潜力。

items.title_en: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
items.title_zh: Agentic-OPD：通过面向智能体任务的同策略蒸馏恢复被遗忘的智能体能力
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is now the mainstream paradigm for training LLMs on agentic tasks, yet standard practice keeps only the best-validation checkpoint and discards the rest. We show that this is lossy: in GRPO training of LLM agents, the best-validation checkpoint fails on problems that earlier checkpoints from the same run had already solved, and the union of problems solved across checkpoints far exceeds any single one. The discarded checkpoints thus form a teacher pool obtained at no additional training cost, which on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover the lost coverage. Mining this pool raises two challenges: i) which checkpoint to distill from, as no checkpoint dominates the others and complementarity to the student is problem-specific; ii) where to trust it, as even a well-chosen teacher is only locally superior, so indiscriminate distillation overwrites behavior the student has already mastered. We propose Agentic-OPD, which treats the best-validation checkpoint as the student and all saved checkpoints as frozen teacher candidates, using the student's evolving capability gaps to guide both teacher selection and supervision filtering: the HCN policy (Highest Coverage Next) dynamically selects teachers by weighted coverage of the student's unsolved problems, while the LAD module (Locality-Aware Distillation) confines transfer to failed student rollouts on problems where the teacher performs better. Across five agentic task domains and 24 benchmarks and task subsets, Agentic-OPD improves over its initialization checkpoint by up to 7.4 points, with a 4B student surpassing the latest frontier models GPT-5.6 and DeepSeek-V4.1 on deep search. Agentic-OPD recasts a finished RL run as a reusable pool of policies and establishes post-RL capability recovery as a stage orthogonal to improvements in the RL algorithm itself.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习目前是在智能体任务上训练 LLM 的主流范式，但标准做法只保留最佳验证检查点，丢弃其余检查点。我们表明这是有损的：在 LLM 智能体的 GRPO 训练中，最佳验证检查点在同一次运行的早期检查点已经解决的问题上失败，而跨检查点解决的问题并集远超任何单一检查点。因此，被丢弃的检查点形成了一个无需额外训练成本即可获得的教师池，同策略蒸馏（OPD）可以挖掘它以恢复丢失的覆盖。挖掘该池带来两个挑战：i）从哪个检查点蒸馏，因为没有检查点占主导地位，且与学生的互补性因问题而异；ii）在哪里信任它，因为即使选择得当的教师也仅在局部更优，因此不加区分地蒸馏会覆盖学生已经掌握的行为。我们提出 Agentic-OPD，它将最佳验证检查点作为学生，并将所有保存的检查点作为冻结的教师候选，利用学生不断演变的能力差距来指导教师选择和监督过滤：HCN 策略（Highest Coverage Next）通过学生对未解决问题的加权覆盖动态选择教师，而 LAD 模块（Locality-Aware Distillation）将迁移限制在学生在教师表现更好的问题上失败的 rollout 上。在五个智能体任务领域以及 24 个基准和任务子集上，Agentic-OPD 较其初始化检查点提升最多 7.4 分，其中 4B 学生在深度搜索上超越了最新前沿模型 GPT-5.6 和 DeepSeek-V4.1。Agentic-OPD 将已完成的 RL 运行重塑为可复用的策略池，并将 RL 后能力恢复确立为与 RL 算法本身改进正交的阶段。

items.title_en: A Cost That Practice Accuracy Hides: Worked Solutions in Self-Generated Training Data and the Compositional Use of New Rules
items.title_zh: 练习准确率所掩盖的一项代价：自生成训练数据中的带步骤解答与新规则的组合使用
items.abstract_en: A worked solution can make self-generated training targets shorter and cheaper, but accuracy on the practiced operation may hide how well a model can reuse newly learned rules. We study this choice in a 2B-parameter reasoning model learning two invented quantitative rules. The model generates targets from a rule sheet alone or from the sheet plus a program-written worked solution; targets are accepted for final-answer correctness, and the support is removed for fine-tuning and evaluation. Training questions request forward use in one segment; composition requires sequential reuse of the same rule across two segments. After six passes, using a program-checked numerical signature, sheet-only targets lead by 24.3 percentage points (95% item-bootstrap CI 14.6-34.0) on composition in a prospective test. On unseen argument values, observed forward accuracy is identical (87.5% each), but composition accuracy is 58.3% versus 23.6%, a 34.7-point gap (25.7-43.8). An independently sampled second target-bank pair repeats the direction (+14.6 points, 2.1-26.0). Ten passes on the shorter worked-solution targets, approximately matching the domain tokens of six sheet-only passes while changing other training quantities, narrow the gap to 16.3 points (6.3-26.7) in the first bank pair and 6.2 points (-6.3 to 18.8) in the second, where the pre-specified test does not hold. At six passes each, the worked-solution policy uses fewer capture tokens and less update time, yet the trained models use 2.6 times as many generated tokens per composition success under the numerical signature (2.1 times in the second bank pair). Choosing a capture context therefore requires testing how the new rules are reused, alongside the inference cost of those uses, rather than relying on forward accuracy alone.
items.abstract_zh: 带步骤解答能使自生成训练目标更短、更便宜，但在所练习操作上的准确率可能掩盖模型能在多大程度上复用新学到的规则。我们在一个学习两条虚构定量规则的20亿参数推理模型中研究这一选择。模型仅根据规则表，或根据规则表加程序编写的带步骤解答来生成目标；目标按最终答案正确性被接受，并在微调和评估时移除支撑信息。训练问题要求在一个片段中进行前向使用；组合则要求跨两个片段顺序复用同一规则。经过六轮后，使用程序检查的数值签名，在前瞻性测试中，仅规则表目标在组合任务上领先24.3个百分点（95%条目自助法置信区间14.6–34.0）。在未见过的参数值上，观测到的前向准确率相同（各为87.5%），但组合准确率为58.3%对23.6%，相差34.7个百分点（25.7–43.8）。独立采样的第二对目标库重复了这一方向（+14.6个百分点，2.1–26.0）。在更短的带步骤解答目标上训练十轮，大致匹配六轮仅规则表训练的领域token数，同时改变其他训练量，在第一对目标库中将差距缩小到16.3个百分点（6.3–26.7），在第二对中缩小到6.2个百分点（-6.3至18.8），此处预先指定的检验不成立。在各自六轮时，带步骤解答策略使用更少的捕获token和更少的更新时间，但在数值签名下，训练后的模型每次组合成功所使用的生成token数是前者的2.6倍（第二对目标库中为2.1倍）。因此，选择捕获上下文需要检验新规则如何被复用，以及这些使用的推理成本，而不能仅依赖前向准确率。

items.title_en: Beyond Memory Limits: A Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Map Representation for Large-Scale 3D Autonomous Exploration
items.title_zh: 超越内存限制：面向大规模三维自主探索的分层时空地图表示
items.abstract_en: Autonomous UAV exploration is increasingly used for large-scale surveying and inspection in inaccessible or disaster-affected environments, where onboard memory and computational resources are often severely constrained. Most existing UAV exploration systems maintain globally queryable geometric map representations for motion planning and exploration decision-making, causing memory consumption and spatial-query costs to increase with the explored area. Robot-centric local mapping bounds dense-map memory and computation but discards global task context needed for long-horizon exploration.We present FLAVOR, a hierarchical spatio-temporal framework that confines dense metric geometry to a robot-centric local map while retaining compact global observation and task context. At the observation level, lightweight LiDAR-keyframe visibility records preserve ray-wise evidence for frontier reasoning. At the task level, unresolved frontiers beyond the local-map extent are retained as compact pending tasks associated with odometry anchors. A sparse topological graph connects these anchors through retained routes for future revisits.Upon returning to a task region, FLAVOR reconstructs the frontier and exploration viewpoint from observations, while the topological route is instantiated and validated against the current local map before execution. Dense-map capacity remains fixed as exploration expands, with exploration-dependent memory growth confined to compact observation and task context.FLAVOR achieves 31.98--41.88% shorter exploration time and a 94--99% smaller map memory footprint than the best baseline that completes all three simulated scenes. In real-world deployments, it reduces this footprint by 92.67% in the forest and 62.42% at the construction site relative to an explicit point-cloud ikd-tree while preserving long-term task continuity under constrained onboard resources.
items.abstract_zh: 自主无人机探索越来越多地用于难以进入或受灾害影响环境中的大规模测绘与巡检，而其机载内存和计算资源通常严重受限。大多数现有无人机探索系统维护可全局查询的几何地图表示，用于运动规划和探索决策，导致内存消耗和空间查询成本随已探索区域增加。以机器人为中心的局部建图限制了稠密地图的内存和计算，但丢弃了长时程探索所需的全局任务上下文。我们提出FLAVOR，一个分层时空框架，将稠密度量几何限制在以机器人为中心的局部地图中，同时保留紧凑的全局观测和任务上下文。在观测层面，轻量级激光雷达关键帧可见性记录保留用于前沿推理的逐射线证据。在任务层面，超出局部地图范围且未解决的前沿被保留为与里程计锚点关联的紧凑待处理任务。稀疏拓扑图通过保留路径连接这些锚点，以供未来重访。返回任务区域后，FLAVOR根据观测重建前沿和探索视点，同时拓扑路径在执行前被实例化并对照当前局部地图进行验证。随着探索扩展，稠密地图容量保持固定，依赖探索的内存增长被限制在紧凑的观测和任务上下文中。FLAVOR相比完成全部三个模拟场景的最佳基线，探索时间缩短31.98–41.88%，地图内存占用减少94–99%。在真实部署中，相对于显式点云ikd-tree，其在森林中减少该占用92.67%，在建筑工地减少62.42%，同时在受限机载资源下保持长期任务连续性。

items.title_en: TransArt3D: From Two States to Articulated 3D Reconstruction with Video Transition Priors
items.title_zh: TransArt3D：从两个状态到带视频过渡先验的铰接式三维重建
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing interactable articulated assets from a few images is key to robotics and simulation, yet highly underconstrained. Existing optimization-based methods fit an articulated asset under a static 3D prior that scores each state independently, so per-state reconstruction errors leak into the estimated moving part and joint as false motion. Video diffusion models capture how objects move between states, but only implicitly in 2D. To this end, we present TransArt3D, an optimization-based framework that reconstructs an articulated 3D asset from two endpoint images by translating this video transition prior into explicit part structure and joint kinematics. It first lifts frames generated between the endpoints with a transition-coupled 3D consensus that applies the static 3D prior jointly across frames, stabilizing unchanging regions and initializing the parts and joint. A rectified-flow kinematic refinement then lets the video prior supervise a 3D motion field over the whole transition, while part assignment and a shared joint constrain the field throughout optimization, keeping per-state errors out of the articulation. Finally, a motion-aware canonical appearance fusion uses the recovered articulation to map both endpoint images onto one canonical surface, texturing regions that only one state reveals. On PartNet-Mobility, TransArt3D outperforms methods given the same two endpoints in geometry and joint accuracy, and surpasses methods given six observed states in articulated-state geometry, joint localization and appearance.
items.abstract_zh: 从少量图像重建可交互的铰接式资产对机器人学和仿真至关重要，但高度欠约束。现有基于优化的方法在静态三维先验下拟合铰接式资产，该先验独立评分每个状态，因此逐状态重建误差会作为虚假运动泄漏到估计的运动部件和关节中。视频扩散模型捕捉物体在状态之间如何运动，但仅在二维中隐式捕捉。为此，我们提出TransArt3D，一个基于优化的框架，通过将这种视频过渡先验转化为显式的部件结构和关节运动学，从两个端点图像重建铰接式三维资产。它首先用过渡耦合的三维一致性提升在端点之间生成的帧，该一致性跨帧联合应用静态三维先验，稳定不变区域并初始化部件和关节。随后，整流流运动学细化让视频先验监督整个过渡上的三维运动场，而部件分配和共享关节在整个优化过程中约束该场，使逐状态误差不进入关节运动。最后，运动感知的规范外观融合利用恢复的关节运动将两个端点图像映射到一个规范表面上，为仅由一个状态显露的区域添加纹理。在PartNet-Mobility上，TransArt3D在几何和关节准确率上优于给定相同两个端点的方法，并在铰接状态几何、关节定位和外观上超过给定六个观测状态的方法。

items.title_en: Synaptic Dendritic Neuron Model (scDNM) for Cell Type Classification in Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data
items.title_zh: 用于单细胞RNA测序数据细胞类型分类的突触树突神经元模型（scDNM）
items.abstract_en: Cell type classification in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data is challenging because of high dimensionality, sparsity, and transcriptionally similar cell types. We developed scDNM, an adaptation of the dendritic neuron model incorporating learnable synaptic thresholds, a supervised gene pool, staged training, and ensemble prediction. Six binary classification tasks were constructed from the Paul15, PBMC3k, and Nestorowa datasets. All models were evaluated using leakage-free nested cross-validation, with feature selection, scaling, and hyperparameter tuning performed independently of the outer test folds. scDNM ranked first in three of six tasks (including one tie) and achieved the best mean accuracy rank (2.00), followed by XGBoost (2.75), Random Forest (3.33), logistic regression (3.33), and SVM (3.58). In a six-class PBMC3k experiment, scDNM achieved 95.997% accuracy and 0.944 macro-F1, compared with 94.243% and 0.914 for SingleR. Garnett returned only Unknown labels and was treated as a zero-coverage technical outcome. Ablation analysis supported the contributions of dendrites and synaptic thresholds. However, XGBoost achieved higher mean binary-task accuracy (96.20% versus 95.32% for scDNM), and across-task rank differences were not statistically significant. These findings demonstrate that scDNM is competitive for scRNA-seq cell type classification, although broader independent validation is required.
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中的细胞类型分类具有挑战性，因为存在高维、稀疏和转录相似的细胞类型。我们开发了scDNM，这是树突神经元模型的一种改编，结合了可学习突触阈值、受监督基因池、分阶段训练和集成预测。从Paul15、PBMC3k和Nestorowa数据集构建了六个二分类任务。所有模型均使用无泄漏嵌套交叉验证评估，特征选择、缩放和超参数调优均独立于外层测试折进行。scDNM在六个任务中的三个任务中排名第一（包括一次并列），并取得最佳平均准确率排名（2.00），其次是XGBoost（2.75）、随机森林（3.33）、逻辑回归（3.33）和SVM（3.58）。在六类PBMC3k实验中，scDNM达到95.997%的准确率和0.944的宏F1，而SingleR为94.243%和0.914。Garnett仅返回Unknown标签，被视为零覆盖的技术性结果。消融分析支持树突和突触阈值的贡献。然而，XGBoost取得了更高的平均二分类任务准确率（96.20%对scDNM的95.32%），且跨任务排名差异不具有统计显著性。这些发现表明scDNM在scRNA-seq细胞类型分类中具有竞争力，但仍需要更广泛的独立验证。

items.title_en: Weight-Space Programming of Variational Quantum Circuits: Large Language Models Write Quantum Circuit Parameters Without an Optimizer
items.title_zh: 变分量子电路的权重空间编程：大语言模型无需优化器即可写出量子电路参数
items.abstract_en: Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) optimize circuit angles through repeated quantum-device evaluations, often facing vanishing gradients and high optimization costs. We ask whether a large language model (LLM) can write these angles directly. Extending *weight-space programming* from classical networks to quantum circuits, we provide a frontier LLM (\gpt) with the problem, circuit, and gate conventions. Its angles are executed exactly as written, without returning losses, gradients, or accuracy feedback. Across 139 requests, we test handwritten-digit classification, VQE ground-state estimation for spin chains and H$_2$, and MaxCut QAOA, comparing against random weights, classical optimization, and optimization initialized with LLM weights on the same circuit. When parameters have interpretable structure, the LLM matches or approaches the optimizer: it achieves 95--100\% of the energy spectrum on every VQE problem, derives the exact H$_2$ ground state in closed form, finds optimal depth-one QAOA angles for every graph, and reaches 93--96\% accuracy on digits 3 versus 8 with 12--18 hand-written weights, outperforming an optimizer trained on the same ten examples. Its weights are also strong warm starts: optimization reaches its best value after a median of one evaluation rather than hundreds. Allowed to design circuits, the LLM chooses data-dependent rotation chains encoding pixel importance in all 30 cases (one qubit for binary tasks, one chain per qubit for ten classes), reaching 65\% accuracy across ten digits. Yet the approach fails in opaque weight spaces: accuracy drops to chance when fixed circuits exceed 30 weights, while optimization improves. It is also sensitive to gate conventions: 6 of 42 QAOA replies reverse mixing-angle signs and fail. We release all prompts, replies, and scores.
items.abstract_zh: 变分量子算法（VQA）通过重复的量子设备评估来优化电路角度，常面临梯度消失和高优化成本。我们询问大语言模型（LLM）能否直接写出这些角度。我们将权重空间编程从经典网络扩展到量子电路，向一个前沿LLM（\gpt）提供问题、电路和门约定。其角度按所写内容精确执行，不返回损失、梯度或准确率反馈。在139个请求中，我们测试手写数字分类、自旋链和H$_2$的VQE基态估计以及MaxCut QAOA，并与随机权重、经典优化以及在同一电路上以LLM权重初始化的优化进行比较。当参数具有可解释结构时，LLM匹配或接近优化器：它在每个VQE问题上达到能谱的95–100%，以闭式推导出精确的H$_2$基态，为每个图找到最优深度一QAOA角度，并在使用12–18个手写权重时对数字3与8达到93–96%的准确率，优于在相同十个示例上训练的优化器。其权重也是强热启动：优化在中位数一次评估后而非数百次后达到最佳值。在允许设计电路时，LLM在所有30个案例中选择编码像素重要性的数据依赖旋转链（二分类任务使用一个量子比特，十分类每个量子比特一条链），在十个数字上达到65%的准确率。然而，该方法在不透明权重空间中失败：当固定电路超过30个权重时，准确率降至随机水平，而优化则会改善。它还对门约定敏感：42个QAOA回复中有6个反转混合角符号并失败。我们发布所有提示、回复和分数。

items.title_en: $Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control
items.title_zh: $Σ$-LeWM：通过S-信息学习用于机器人控制的世界模型
items.abstract_en: World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 世界模型越来越多地被用作机器人操作和运动等任务中基于模型的控制方法。早期世界模型架构依赖解码器来防止模式崩溃并学习可预测的潜在空间，而近期关于世界模型的工作，如联合嵌入预测架构或LeWorldModel，越来越多地旨在学习无需接地解码器的嵌入，仅利用潜在前向动力学预测器和稳定熵项。在本文中，我们旨在证明，向LeWorldModel进一步引入两个额外的潜在损失——后向动力学预测器和逆动力学动作预测器——会在潜在嵌入上施加进一步结构，从而在性能和规划效率上带来进一步提升。这些是提高此类方法对真实机器人实时基于模型控制适用性的关键性质。我们在标准世界模型基准和两个模拟机器人操作任务上展示了这些收益。

items.title_en: EmoHarness: Boosting Multimodal Emotion Understanding with Meta-Harness Evolving
items.title_zh: EmoHarness：利用元框架演化（Meta-Harness Evolving）提升多模态情感理解
items.abstract_en: Small multimodal models can misjudge emotion when words, voice, and visual cues conflict. We present EmoHarness, which runs such a model, the frozen student, inside a harness: the prompts, settings, and verification code around its calls. A human-written starting harness, the scaffold, numbers the student's visual observations, transcript, and prosody descriptions as citable evidence and has the student weigh candidate emotions against it. In Meta-Harness Evolving (MHE), a stronger LLM, the Builder, reads the student's errors and execution traces offline and edits the harness; static checks and validation gates decide which edits are kept, and the Builder never sees evaluation items. On 5,507 MME-Emotion items, EmoHarness raises task-macro Recognition by 7.6-13.4 points over a single video-only call for all four students and both Builders. Transcripts and prosody descriptions supply most of this boost (+5.38 to +10.71); the scaffold changes the audio-augmented call by -0.79 to +2.54, partly through extra multi-label predictions, and evolved edits add at most +0.95, although no evolved increment survives Holm correction. The harness's emotion context also transfers to IntentQA, with small gains for three of four students, none of which survives correction. EmoHarness thus boosts small multimodal students chiefly by supplying and organizing audio-derived evidence.
items.abstract_zh: 当词语、语音和视觉线索相互冲突时，小型多模态模型可能误判情感。我们提出 EmoHarness，它将此类模型（冻结的学生模型）置于一个框架（harness）中运行：该框架包括其调用周围的提示、设置和验证代码。人工编写的初始框架（即脚手架）将学生模型的视觉观察、转录文本和韵律描述编号为可引用证据，并让学生模型据此权衡候选情感。在 Meta-Harness Evolving（MHE）中，更强的 LLM（即 Builder）离线读取学生模型的错误和执行轨迹并编辑该框架；静态检查和验证门决定保留哪些编辑，且 Builder 从不见到评估项目。在 5,507 个 MME-Emotion 项目上，对于全部四个学生模型和两个 Builder，EmoHarness 相比单次仅视频调用将任务宏平均识别率（task-macro Recognition）提高了 7.6–13.4 个百分点。转录文本和韵律描述贡献了大部分提升（+5.38 至 +10.71）；脚手架使音频增强调用变化 -0.79 至 +2.54，部分通过额外的多标签预测实现；演化编辑最多增加 +0.95，尽管没有演化增量通过 Holm 校正。该框架的情感上下文也可迁移至 IntentQA，四个学生模型中有三个获得小幅提升，但均未通过校正。因此，EmoHarness 主要通过提供并组织音频衍生证据来提升小型多模态学生模型。

items.title_en: Selective Cooperative Perception via Blind Spot Reasoning and Agentic Dialogue with Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 通过盲区推理与视觉语言模型智能体对话的选择性协同感知
items.abstract_en: Real-time cooperative perception (CP) in multi-agent traffic environments is highly resource-intensive, which posing scalability challenges for large-scale deployment. Efficiency can be significantly improved by selectively performing CP only in safety-critical scenarios and for key occluding objects. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are well-suited for complex reasoning in dynamic and uncertain environments, making them a promising tool for this selective CP task. This study proposes a VLM-driven agentic framework for blind spot reasoning and dialogue-based CP. A mixed-model architecture is designed that integrates conventional object detection for stable perception, vision-language reasoning for identifying impactful occlusions, and a physics-based geometric module to align reasoning with real-world visibility constraints. The framework also incorporates a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting mechanism to enhance interpretability and intent-aware decision-making. We collect real-world data from connected vehicles operating in urban traffic and compare the driving-critical blind spot identification and dialogue performance of four state-of-the-art VLMs. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves over 80% accuracy in driving-critical blind spot detection and over 90% success in dialogue-driven perception sharing. This work provides a scalable, interpretable, and bandwidth-efficient alternative to conventional CP pipelines, and offers new insights into agentic communication design for future connected traffic systems.
items.abstract_zh: 多智能体交通环境中的实时协同感知（CP）资源消耗很高，给大规模部署带来可扩展性挑战。仅在安全关键场景和关键遮挡对象上选择性执行 CP，可显著提高效率。视觉语言模型（VLM）非常适合在动态和不确定环境中进行复杂推理，因而成为该选择性 CP 任务的有前景工具。本研究提出一种由 VLM 驱动的智能体框架，用于盲区推理和基于对话的 CP。设计了一种混合模型架构，集成用于稳定感知的传统目标检测、用于识别有影响遮挡的视觉语言推理，以及基于物理的几何模块，以使推理与真实世界可见性约束对齐。该框架还引入思维链（CoT）提示机制，以增强可解释性和意图感知决策。我们采集了在城市交通中运行的网联汽车真实世界数据，并比较了四种最先进 VLM 的驾驶关键盲区识别和对话性能。实验结果表明，我们的方法在驾驶关键盲区检测中达到超过 80% 的准确率，在对话驱动的感知共享中达到超过 90% 的成功率。这项工作为传统 CP 流程提供了一种可扩展、可解释且带宽高效的替代方案，并为未来网联交通系统的智能体通信设计提供了新见解。

items.title_en: DINO-Nucleus: Multi-Level Self-Supervised Features for Nucleus Instance Segmentation
items.title_zh: DINO-Nucleus：用于细胞核实例分割的多级自监督特征
items.abstract_en: Nucleus instance segmentation and counting are essential for quantitative microscopy, enabling reliable analysis of cell populations, tissue organization, and disease-related changes. However, accurately separating touching nuclei remains difficult, and many existing approaches rely on complex models or sensitive post-processing procedures. We present DINO-Nucleus, a parameter-efficient framework that leverages multi-level self-supervised DINOv2 representations for nucleus instance segmentation and counting. The model jointly predicts nucleus regions, pixel-wise instance flows, and explicit nucleus centers, while a consistency objective encourages the predicted flows to converge toward their corresponding centers. Multi-level transformer features provide complementary spatial and semantic information, and the pretrained backbone is adapted using lightweight LoRA modules to reduce fine-tuning cost. Experimental results show that DINO-Nucleus achieves strong segmentation and counting performance with parameter-efficient backbone adaptation. These findings demonstrate that parameter-efficient adaptation of multi-level self-supervised features can provide an effective solution for nucleus instance segmentation in microscopy images.
items.abstract_zh: 细胞核实例分割与计数对定量显微术至关重要，可实现对细胞群体、组织结构及疾病相关变化的可靠分析。然而，准确分离相互接触的细胞核仍然困难，许多现有方法依赖复杂模型或敏感的后处理流程。我们提出 DINO-Nucleus，一个参数高效框架，利用多级自监督 DINOv2 表征进行细胞核实例分割与计数。该模型联合预测细胞核区域、逐像素实例流和显式细胞核中心，同时一致性目标促使预测流收敛到其对应中心。多级 Transformer 特征提供互补的空间与语义信息，预训练骨干通过轻量 LoRA 模块进行适配，以降低微调成本。实验结果表明，DINO-Nucleus 在参数高效骨干适配下取得较强的分割与计数性能。这些发现表明，多级自监督特征的参数高效适配可为显微图像中的细胞核实例分割提供有效解决方案。

items.title_en: Protein B-factor modeling with local magnitude
items.title_zh: 使用局部幅值进行蛋白质 B 因子建模
items.abstract_en: Topological magnitude characterizes the effective size and spatial organization of metric spaces, offering a geometric approach with potential applications in molecular biology and materials science. Previous work has demonstrated its utility in modeling protein flexibility from structure, but global magnitude weighting requires dense linear systems whose computational cost increases with protein size. We introduce a local magnitude representation that retains residue-level structural information through nearest-neighbor environments. The construction is well posed and geometrically invariant, with central weighting distinguished from scalar neighborhood magnitude. Across 364 proteins, the mean within-protein fitting Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) increases from 0.725 for global magnitude to 0.728 for local magnitude. Blind-prediction experiments on 345 proteins combine each representation with identical auxiliary descriptors and evaluate random forests and gradient boosting under three validation protocols. Local features improve the primary PCC in all six model--protocol comparisons, with a maximum absolute increase of 0.008 in protein-level ten-fold gradient boosting. For a fixed feature bank, local factorization costs $O(Nk^3)$ compared with $O(N^3)$ for global factorization, where $N$ is the number of C$_α$ atoms and $k$ the neighborhood size. Timing measurements show a computational advantage of local magnitude on large structures. Within the tested single-seed configuration and distinct global and local scale banks, these results support local magnitude as a compact representation that preserves useful B-factor information while reducing feature-extraction costs for large proteins.
items.abstract_zh: 拓扑幅值刻画度量空间的有效大小和空间组织，提供一种几何方法，在分子生物学和材料科学中具有潜在应用。先前工作已证明其可用于从结构建模蛋白质柔性，但全局幅值加权需要稠密线性系统，其计算成本随蛋白质尺寸增加。我们引入一种局部幅值表示，通过最近邻环境保留残基级结构信息。该构造是适定的且具有几何不变性，其中中心加权与标量邻域幅值相区分。在 364 个蛋白质上，蛋白质内拟合 Pearson 相关系数（PCC）均值从全局幅值的 0.725 提高到局部幅值的 0.728。在 345 个蛋白质上的盲预测实验将每种表示与相同的辅助描述符结合，并在三种验证协议下评估随机森林和梯度提升。局部特征在所有六项模型—协议比较中均提高主要 PCC，在蛋白质级十折梯度提升中最大绝对提高为 0.008。对于固定特征库，局部分解成本为 O(Nk^3)，而全局分解为 O(N^3)，其中 N 为 C_α 原子数，k 为邻域大小。计时测量显示局部幅值在大结构上具有计算优势。在测试的单种子配置以及不同的全局和局部尺度库下，这些结果支持局部幅值作为一种紧凑表示，在保留有用 B 因子信息的同时降低大蛋白质的特征提取成本。

items.title_en: High-sensitivity sensing technology of 10 MHz radio frequency electric field based on Rydberg atoms
items.title_zh: 基于里德堡原子的 10 MHz 射频电场高灵敏度传感技术
items.abstract_en: To address the pressing need for high-sensitivity, miniaturized electric field sensors in the short-wave communication band (3-30 MHz), this study proposes and demonstrates a radio frequency electric field quantum sensing scheme based on cesium atomic Rydberg states and the electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) effect. The scheme employs an all-infrared optical design, utilizing 852 nm probe light, 1470 nm dressing light, and 780 nm coupling light to efficiently prepare the 49P3/2 Rydberg state in a room-temperature cesium vapor cell, which is then probed non-destructively via ladder-type four-level EIT spectroscopy.
items.abstract_zh: 为满足短波通信频段（3–30 MHz）对高灵敏度、小型化电场传感器的迫切需求，本研究提出并演示了一种基于铯原子里德堡态和电磁诱导透明（EIT）效应的射频电场量子传感方案。该方案采用全红外光学设计，利用 852 nm 探测光、1470 nm 缀饰光和 780 nm 耦合光，在室温铯蒸气池中高效制备 49P3/2 里德堡态，然后通过阶梯型四能级 EIT 光谱对其进行非破坏性探测。

items.title_en: Smartphone-Enabled Depth-Aware Transillumination Imaging for Detection of Chicken Breast Fillet Myopathies in Chicken Fillets
items.title_zh: 智能手机赋能深度感知透照成像用于检测鸡胸肉片中的肌病
items.abstract_en: Woody Breast (WB) myopathy is a major quality defect in broiler chickens characterized by fibrosis, increased tissue hardness, and altered structural properties that affect product quality. Conventional palpation is subjective and labor-intensive, while many non-destructive methods require specialized equipment or substantial computational resources. This study developed a smartphone-based transillumination and 3D point-cloud framework for non-destructive WB severity classification. A total of 267 chicken breast fillets, including normal breast (NB, n = 87), mild WB (MWB, n = 85), and severe WB (SWB, n = 95), were evaluated using RAW transillumination images and 3D point clouds acquired with an iPhone 16 Pro. A total of 91 features, comprising 14 image-derived, 76 geometric, and one physics-informed Beer-Lambert attenuation feature, were extracted. Partial correlation controlling for thickness revealed a significant association between image characteristics and WB severity (r = 0.413, p < 0.0001), indicating optical information independent of fillet geometry. SWB tissue exhibited approximately 26% greater light attenuation per unit thickness than NB. The 2D-only models achieved approximately 82% test accuracy, while the multimodal ensemble combining Fusion-DGCNN, XGBoost, and physics-guided logistic regression (PGLR) achieved approximately 90% accuracy. These findings demonstrate the complementary value of optical, geometric, and physics-informed features and establish the feasibility of smartphone-based, non-destructive WB severity assessment.
items.abstract_zh: 木质胸（WB）肌病是肉鸡中的一种主要质量缺陷，其特征为纤维化、组织硬度增加以及影响产品质量的结构特性改变。传统触诊主观且劳动强度大，而许多无损方法需要专用设备或大量计算资源。本研究开发了一种基于智能手机的透照和 3D 点云框架，用于无损 WB 严重程度分类。使用 iPhone 16 Pro 采集的 RAW 透照图像和 3D 点云，对总共 267 个鸡胸肉片进行了评估，包括正常胸肉（NB，n = 87）、轻度 WB（MWB，n = 85）和重度 WB（SWB，n = 95）。共提取 91 个特征，包括 14 个图像衍生特征、76 个几何特征和 1 个物理信息启发的 Beer-Lambert 衰减特征。控制厚度的偏相关分析显示，图像特征与 WB 严重程度之间存在显著关联（r = 0.413，p < 0.0001），表明光学信息独立于肉片几何形状。与 NB 相比，SWB 组织每单位厚度的光衰减约高 26%。仅 2D 模型达到约 82% 的测试准确率，而结合 Fusion-DGCNN、XGBoost 和物理引导逻辑回归（PGLR）的多模态集成达到约 90% 的准确率。这些发现证明了光学、几何和物理信息启发特征的互补价值，并确立了基于智能手机的无损 WB 严重程度评估的可行性。

items.title_en: CaseLaw: A Policy-Decoupled Framework for Training-Free Content Moderation
items.title_zh: CaseLaw：一种策略解耦的免训练内容审核框架
items.abstract_en: Content moderation is inherently policy-dependent: moderation boundaries are often subtle, subjective, and frequently updated, while conventional rule based or fine-tuning based systems require costly rule rewriting, model retraining, or system redeployment. We propose CaseLaw, a policy-decoupled and training-free framework for adaptive content moderation. CaseLaw reformulates moderation as precedent-based retrieval and voting, where multimodal content is transformed into evidence-preserved structured semantics, embedded into a stable semantic space, and classified by thresholded voting over retrieved precedent labels. We train NoteCap on a large-scale corpus of structurally annotated notes to ensure consistent semantic extraction and freeze it during subsequent policy adaptation, which requires no additional training. Policy adaptation is achieved by updating the semantic case library, including case labels and mappings, without retraining models or modifying prompts. To evaluate CaseLaw, we construct MFO-RedNotes, a benchmark for the male-female opposition risk domain. We additionally provide a five category CoPro comparison. Experiments show that CaseLaw consistently outperforms competing baselines in both precision and recall across policy-dependent risk levels and broader safety categories, with category-wise precision/recall reaching up to 86.8%/90.1% on MFO-RedNotes across both policy settings and 94.5%/92.3% on CoPro. Our work highlights the potential of precedent-based reasoning for policy adaptive content moderation and offers a practical direction toward more stable, transparent, and training-free moderation systems.
items.abstract_zh: 内容审核本质上依赖策略：审核边界往往细微、主观且频繁更新，而传统的基于规则或基于微调的系统需要昂贵的规则重写、模型重新训练或系统重新部署。我们提出 CaseLaw，一种用于自适应内容审核的策略解耦且免训练的框架。CaseLaw 将审核重构为基于先例的检索和投票：多模态内容被转换为保留证据的结构化语义，嵌入稳定的语义空间，并通过对检索到的先例标签进行阈值投票来分类。我们在大规模结构化标注笔记语料上训练 NoteCap，以确保一致的语义提取，并在后续策略适应期间冻结它，这不需要额外训练。策略适应通过更新语义案例库（包括案例标签和映射）实现，无需重新训练模型或修改提示。为评估 CaseLaw，我们构建了 MFO-RedNotes，这是男女对立风险领域的基准。我们还提供了五类别 CoPro 比较。实验表明，CaseLaw 在依赖策略的风险等级和更广泛的安全类别中，在精确率和召回率上均持续优于竞争基线；在 MFO-RedNotes 上，跨两种策略设置，按类别精确率/召回率达到最高 86.8%/90.1%，在 CoPro 上达到 94.5%/92.3%。我们的工作凸显了基于先例的推理在策略自适应内容审核中的潜力，并为更稳定、透明且免训练的审核系统提供了实用方向。

items.title_en: OfficeTwin: Realizing 3D Reconstruction of Redundant Scenes through Partial Viewpoint Perception
items.title_zh: OfficeTwin：通过部分视点感知实现冗余场景的 3D 重建
items.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction turns an uncalibrated monocular stream into a dense point cloud in a single inference pass, orders of magnitude faster than classical structure-from-motion (e.g., COLMAP), and reliable on the weakly textured, repetitive surfaces where keypoint matching fails outright. However, raw point clouds lack the object identity, physical properties, and watertight volume required for robot learning. This gap widens under robot-native capture. A camera mounted on a robot constrained to a few degrees of freedom sees each object only partially, and the repetitive, weakly textured structure of an office makes distinct workstations nearly indistinguishable, leaving redundant and partial observations that downstream reconstruction cannot resolve. Existing image-to-3D generation methods struggle with these conditions, hallucinating geometry under incomplete views and confusing repeated instances. We present OfficeTwin, a robot-native framework that converts these incomplete observations into simulation-ready digital twins. OfficeTwin first imposes metric and structural constraints, then exploits the office's structural redundancy by registering repeated cubicles into a shared canonical frame, where complementary observations recover geometry occluded in any single view without hallucination. On a real office scan, OfficeTwin recovers every cubicle as an individually watertight, metric solid, outperforming feed-forward reconstruction and generative baselines that fail to produce simulation-ready assets.
items.abstract_zh: 前馈 3D 重建可在单次推理过程中将未标定的单目视频流转换为稠密点云，比经典运动恢复结构（例如 COLMAP）快几个数量级，并且在关键点匹配完全失败的弱纹理、重复表面上仍然可靠。然而，原始点云缺乏机器人学习所需的物体身份、物理属性和水密体积。在机器人原生采集下，这一差距进一步扩大。安装在仅具有少数自由度的机器人上的相机只能部分看到每个物体，而办公室重复、弱纹理的结构使不同工作位几乎无法区分，留下下游重建无法解决的冗余和部分观测。现有图像到 3D 生成方法在这些条件下表现不佳，在不完整视图下幻觉出几何结构，并混淆重复实例。我们提出 OfficeTwin，一种机器人原生框架，将这些不完整观测转换为可用于仿真的数字孪生。OfficeTwin 首先施加度量和结构约束，然后通过将重复的隔间配准到共享规范坐标系来利用办公室的结构冗余，在此框架中，互补观测可在无幻觉的情况下恢复任何单视图被遮挡的几何结构。在真实办公室扫描中，OfficeTwin 将每个隔间恢复为单独水密、度量正确的实体，优于前馈重建和无法生成仿真就绪资产的生成基线。

items.title_en: Refer-CityFlow and M3Track: A Benchmark Dataset and Reference Framework for Language-Driven Multi-Target Multi-Camera Tracking
items.title_zh: Refer-CityFlow 与 M3Track：面向语言驱动的多目标多摄像头跟踪的基准数据集与参考框架
items.abstract_en: Referring multi-object tracking enables users to specify targets through natural language, but existing Refer-MOT benchmarks primarily focus on single-camera settings. We formalize Referring Multi-Target Multi-Camera Tracking (Refer-MTMCT), where free-form queries specify identity-consistent trajectories to be recovered across a network of sequential, sparse-overlap cameras. We introduce Refer-CityFlow, a benchmark built on CityFlow's global cross-camera identity annotations and augmented with language queries requiring joint language grounding, cross-camera association, and spatio-temporal reasoning. Refer-CityFlow covers 96 videos from 40 roadside cameras with 660+ identity-consistent cross-camera trajectories, 4,362 trajectory-level descriptions, and 7,699 queries, including 1,699 real-user queries collected from 50 participants. Reference experiments on the four-camera Scenario 02 show that single-camera referring trackers reach 14.95-18.28 HOTA on real-user queries, while the evaluated cross-view method achieves about 0.05 HOTA in direct transfer. To establish reference performance, we provide M3Track, a modular multimodal reference framework in which a large language model (LLM)-based agent orchestrates interchangeable detection, tracking, and cross-camera association modules. M3Track reaches 44.10 HOTA and 65.40 IDF1 on the same real-user query set. The project repository is available at https://github.com/phuongnguyen194/Refer-CityFlow-and--M3Track.
items.abstract_zh: 指称式多目标跟踪允许用户通过自然语言指定目标，但现有 Refer-MOT 基准主要集中于单摄像头设置。我们将指称式多目标多摄像头跟踪（Referring Multi-Target Multi-Camera Tracking, Refer-MTMCT）形式化，其中自由形式查询指定需在一组顺序、稀疏重叠的摄像头网络中恢复的身份一致轨迹。我们引入 Refer-CityFlow，这是一个基于 CityFlow 的全局跨摄像头身份标注构建、并用语言查询增强的基准，要求联合进行语言 grounding、跨摄像头关联和时空推理。Refer-CityFlow 涵盖来自 40 个路侧摄像头的 96 个视频，包含 660+ 条身份一致的跨摄像头轨迹、4,362 条轨迹级描述和 7,699 条查询，其中包括从 50 名参与者收集的 1,699 条真实用户查询。在四摄像头 Scenario 02 上的参考实验表明，单摄像头指称跟踪器在真实用户查询上达到 14.95–18.28 HOTA，而所评估的跨视角方法在直接迁移时仅达到约 0.05 HOTA。为建立参考性能，我们提供 M3Track，一个模块化多模态参考框架，其中基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体编排可互换的检测、跟踪和跨摄像头关联模块。M3Track 在同一真实用户查询集上达到 44.10 HOTA 和 65.40 IDF1。项目仓库见 https://github.com/phuongnguyen194/Refer-CityFlow-and--M3Track。

items.title_en: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Annealing for Protein Side-Chain Optimization: A Feasibility Study
items.title_zh: 用于蛋白质侧链优化的混合量子-经典退火：可行性研究
items.abstract_en: Hybrid quantum-classical annealing solvers are moving from research laboratories toward industrial use, but their advantage over classical optimization appears to be confined to a narrow class of problems. A recent systematic benchmark of the D-Wave hybrid solver against industry-leading classical solvers, across several classes of optimization problems, found it to be most competitive on binary quadratic programs, while noting that few industrial problems take this form. Therefore, identifying real-world industrial problems that can be modeled with this structure is a key challenge. We propose protein side-chain optimization, a core step of computational protein design, as one of these problems: it is natively a binary quadratic program, and its application context requires pools of low-energy solutions, which annealers naturally return. In this feasibility study, we test whether the competitiveness of the hybrid solver against industry-leading classical solvers extends to this problem. On 40 instances derived from 20 experimentally determined protein structures with up to about 200 amino acids and 2000 binary variables, we compare the results achieved with a hybrid solver, run for 5 seconds, against those of the commercial solver Gurobi, run for 10 seconds, 1000 seconds, and 4 hours. The hybrid solver reaches the certified optimum whenever one is available, matches Gurobi's performance on smaller instances, and outperforms it on larger instances, finding lower-energy solutions. These results show that the competitiveness of the hybrid solver on binary quadratic programs, so far observed only on a synthetic benchmark, extends to a real-world problem. This motivates comparisons with classical heuristics specific to protein side-chain optimization.
items.abstract_zh: 混合量子-经典退火求解器正从研究实验室走向工业应用，但其相对于经典优化的优势似乎局限于一类狭窄的问题。最近一项针对 D-Wave 混合求解器与业界领先经典求解器在若干类优化问题上的系统性基准测试发现，该求解器在二元二次规划上最具竞争力，同时指出很少有工业问题采用这种形式。因此，识别能够用这种结构建模的真实工业问题是一项关键挑战。我们提出蛋白质侧链优化——计算蛋白质设计的一个核心步骤——作为这类问题之一：它本质上是二元二次规划，并且其应用场景需要低能量解池，而退火器自然会返回这类解。在这项可行性研究中，我们测试混合求解器相对于业界领先经典求解器的竞争力是否可扩展到该问题。在由 20 个实验确定的蛋白质结构导出的 40 个实例上（最多约 200 个氨基酸和 2000 个二元变量），我们将混合求解器运行 5 秒得到的结果与商业求解器 Gurobi 运行 10 秒、1000 秒和 4 小时得到的结果进行比较。只要存在可认证的最优解，混合求解器就能达到该最优解；在较小实例上与 Gurobi 的性能相当，在较大实例上则优于 Gurobi，找到能量更低的解。这些结果表明，混合求解器在二元二次规划上的竞争力——此前仅在合成基准上观察到——可扩展到一个真实世界问题。这促使我们与针对蛋白质侧链优化的经典启发式方法进行比较。

items.title_en: Dynamical Light-Matter Coupling with Protected Superconducting Oscillators
items.title_zh: 具有受保护超导振荡器的动态光-物质耦合
items.abstract_en: Superconducting circuits hosting long-lived bosonic modes are an excellent platform for emulating the dynamics of light and matter and exploiting them for quantum information processing. The space of accessible dynamics is greatly extended by introducing the frequency tunability of artificial atoms, whereby the interactions with the light field of a microwave cavity can be modified on demand. However, using external flux bias to control the frequency of transmons introduces significant losses to coupled cavities, reducing their single-photon lifetimes to a few tens of $μ$s. These imperfections compromise the usefulness of the bosonic mode, which loses its ability to store and manipulate the quantum information of many-photon states. This thesis investigates the issue and demonstrates how to enhance the flux control of microwave cavities without compromising protection. Several hardware solutions were explored, including off-plane remote flux sources routed by a magnetic hose, and lithographically printed on-chip lines equipped with multiple stages of filtering. These developments equip the systems with broadband flux control and photon lifetimes of several hundred $μ$s. They enable the real-time manipulation of the two central parameters of the Rabi model: detuning and coupling strength. This flexibility translates into operational primitives of interest, such as the calibration of nonlinearities to different interaction regimes, the activation of parametric resonances with adjustable coupling strengths, and the use of number-selective transmon-cavity transitions for qudit state preparation and control. These results lay the groundwork for exploring richer synthetic light-matter systems, controlling cavities with more complex nonlinear circuits, and engineering driven-dissipative systems with applications in quantum computation and sensing.
items.abstract_zh: 承载长寿命玻色模式的超导电路是模拟光与物质动力学并将其用于量子信息处理的绝佳平台。通过引入人工原子的频率可调性，可访问的动力学空间得到极大扩展，从而可以按需修改与微波腔光场的相互作用。然而，使用外部磁通偏置控制transmon的频率会给耦合腔引入显著损耗，将其单光子寿命降低到几十 μs。这些不完美损害了玻色模式的实用性，使其失去存储和操纵多光子态量子信息的能力。本论文研究该问题，并演示如何在不损害保护的情况下增强微波腔的磁通控制。探索了若干硬件解决方案，包括通过磁通软管路由的离面远程磁通源，以及配备多级滤波的光刻印刷片上线路。这些进展使系统具备宽带磁通控制和数百微秒的光子寿命。它们能够实时操纵Rabi模型的两个核心参数：失谐和耦合强度。这种灵活性转化为有意义的操作原语，例如将非线性校准到不同相互作用区间、激活具有可调耦合强度的参量共振，以及使用数选择性transmon-腔跃迁进行qudit态制备和控制。这些结果为探索更丰富的合成光-物质系统、用更复杂非线性电路控制腔，以及工程化驱动耗散系统并应用于量子计算和传感奠定了基础。

items.title_en: K-prop: Deep Online Learning by Backpropagating Temporal Kernels
items.title_zh: K-prop：通过反向传播时间核的深度在线学习
items.abstract_en: Self-recurrence represents an important component for temporal processing in neural networks, both artificial and biological, where it appears naturally in the form of leaky integration. However, due to the complex temporal dependencies of the gradient, an efficient and effective method of online training is still lacking. Here we propose K-prop, a novel online learning method for leaky neural networks. It dramatically reduces the computational and memory cost of real time recurrent learning (RTRL) by propagating kernel gains. K-prop also outperforms existing RTRL approximations and achieves performance comparable to backpropagation through time in sequence learning, classification, and reinforcement learning tasks. We further analyze how its sole approximation affects gradient quality and identify conditions under which K-prop remains accurate and effective.
items.abstract_zh: 自递归是神经网络（包括人工和生物神经网络）时间处理的重要组成部分，它以泄漏积分的形式自然出现。然而，由于梯度的复杂时间依赖性，仍然缺乏高效且有效的在线训练方法。在此，我们提出K-prop，一种用于泄漏神经网络的新型在线学习方法。它通过传播核增益大幅降低实时递归学习（RTRL）的计算和内存成本。K-prop还优于现有的RTRL近似，并在序列学习、分类和强化学习任务中达到与时间反向传播相当的性能。我们进一步分析其唯一近似如何影响梯度质量，并确定K-prop保持准确有效的条件。
