items.title_en: ScrapeBench: Evaluating Legal Compliance of AI Agents in Website Scraping
items.title_zh: ScrapeBench：评估AI代理在网站抓取中的法律合规性
items.abstract_en: AI agents deployed on the open web are becoming more capable of performing actions that may breach contractual provisions and violate computer security laws. In this paper, we introduce ScrapeBench, the first agentic benchmark for empirically evaluating the legal compliance of AI agents with website scraping policies, namely terms of service (ToS) and robots.txt directives. Across widely used closed-weight and open-weight AI agents, we find that most agents exhibit low compliance rates (< 5%) when instructed to scrape websites in our sample of 1,626 popular websites that explicitly prohibit scraping. In addition, we observe that even where AI agents actively check the applicable ToS and robots.txt, they continue to exhibit low compliance rates. Conversely, in our sample of 269 websites that do not prohibit scraping, we observe that agents sometimes refuse to scrape despite it being lawful, such as Claude Opus 4.6 exhibiting an over-refusal rate of 98.5%. Our human baseline experiments (n = 180 participants) suggest that humans exhibit compliance rates comparable to AI agents but over-refuse at much higher rates.
items.abstract_zh: 部署在开放网络上的AI代理正变得越来越有能力执行可能违反合同条款和计算机安全法的操作。在本文中，我们提出ScrapeBench，这是首个用于实证评估AI代理遵守网站抓取政策（即服务条款（ToS）和robots.txt指令）法律合规性的代理基准。在广泛使用的闭权重和开权重AI代理中，我们发现，在指示其抓取我们样本中1,626个明确禁止抓取的流行网站时，大多数代理表现出低合规率（<5%）。此外，我们观察到，即使AI代理主动检查适用的ToS和robots.txt，它们仍表现出低合规率。相反，在我们269个不禁止抓取的网站样本中，我们观察到代理有时在合法情况下仍拒绝抓取，例如Claude Opus 4.6表现出98.5%的过度拒绝率。我们的人类基线实验（n=180名参与者）表明，人类的合规率与AI代理相当，但过度拒绝率要高得多。

items.title_en: A Unified Inertial Encoder for Human and Humanoid Motion
items.title_zh: 用于人体和人形运动的统一惯性编码器
items.abstract_en: Learning humanoid state estimation and language-grounded motion understanding from robot recordings ties training coverage to the robot's motion repertoire. Human motion datasets offer broader coverage, yet transferring this knowledge requires overcoming differences in body geometry, sensing, and physical disturbances. To enable this transfer, we propose a unified inertial encoder whose shared inertial interface uses kinematic IMU synthesis to represent human and humanoid motion at corresponding body sites. Within this common input space, joint training on human and kinematically retargeted humanoid motion combines velocity estimation and motion--text alignment with continuous-time encoding and sensor and motion randomization. The resulting model transfers zero-shot to a physical Unitree G1 without physics simulation, real-robot training trajectories, or fine-tuning, achieving the lowest velocity error among evaluated methods across five datasets, including 0.099m/s on real G1. Its motion-description retrieval also extends to retargeted G1 motion categories observed only in human training, demonstrating how human motion knowledge can support the generalization of humanoid inertial odometry and language-grounded motion understanding.
items.abstract_zh: 从机器人记录中学习人形状态估计和语言接地的运动理解，会使训练覆盖范围与机器人的运动库绑定。人体运动数据集提供更广的覆盖，但迁移这些知识需要克服身体几何、传感和物理扰动方面的差异。为实现这种迁移，我们提出一种统一惯性编码器，其共享惯性接口使用运动学IMU合成来表示对应身体部位的人体和人形运动。在这个共同输入空间中，对人体和运动学重定向的人形运动进行联合训练，将速度估计和运动-文本对齐与连续时间编码以及传感器和运动随机化相结合。所得模型无需物理仿真、真实机器人训练轨迹或微调，即可零样本迁移到实体Unitree G1，在五个数据集上取得所评估方法中最低的速度误差，包括在真实G1上的0.099m/s。其运动描述检索还扩展到仅在人体训练中出现过的重定向G1运动类别，展示了人体运动知识如何支持人形惯性里程计和语言接地的运动理解的泛化。

items.title_en: Flex-RSI: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement of Frontier Agents
items.title_zh: Flex-RSI：前沿智能体递归自我改进的基准测试
items.abstract_en: Frontier language models are increasingly deployed as agents, and how well an agent performs depends not only on its model but also on its harness: the prompts, tools, memory, and control loop through which the model acts. When an agent is applied to a new problem, a natural question is whether it can use the feedback of the task to improve the way it works, and not merely its answer. Most existing benchmarks keep the agent's harness fixed and score the solution it produces, or target large-scale model training. We introduce Flex-RSI, a benchmark for the recursive self-improvement of agents on vision and robotics tasks under a fixed budget. In each round, an executor improves the task solution, which is kept only if it scores higher on held-out validation data, and an improver then revises the harness, including the executor and itself. Every run starts from the same general-purpose harness, and the final solution is scored on hidden test data. Evaluating closed-source and open-weight models on tasks spanning perception, reasoning, robot action, 3D reconstruction, visual creation, and infrastructure, we find that self-improvement helps most when the agent builds its own solution, that feedback recording only success or failure holds back open-weight models, and that open-weight models fall furthest behind where outputs must pass strict checks of physical stability or exact correctness. Paired runs further show that editing the harness itself contributes to the gains.
items.abstract_zh: 前沿语言模型正越来越多地被部署为智能体，而智能体的表现不仅取决于其模型，也取决于其运行框架（harness）：模型借以行动的提示、工具、记忆和控制循环。当智能体被应用于新问题时，一个自然的问题是：它能否利用任务反馈来改进自己的工作方式，而不仅仅是改进其答案。现有大多数基准测试要么保持智能体框架固定并对其产生的解决方案评分，要么面向大规模模型训练。我们提出 Flex-RSI，这是一个用于在固定预算下评估智能体在视觉和机器人任务中递归自我改进的基准。在每一轮中，执行器改进任务解决方案，只有当该方案在留出验证数据上得分更高时才被保留；随后，改进器修订框架，包括执行器及其自身。每次运行都从相同的通用框架开始，最终解决方案在隐藏测试数据上评分。我们在涵盖感知、推理、机器人动作、3D 重建、视觉创作和基础设施的任务上评估闭源模型和开放权重模型，发现：当智能体构建自己的解决方案时，自我改进最有帮助；仅记录成功或失败的反馈会阻碍开放权重模型；开放权重模型在输出必须通过物理稳定性或精确正确性严格检查的任务上落后最多。配对运行进一步表明，编辑框架本身也有助于性能提升。

items.title_en: Personalized health coaching via coachable health age and counterfactual wearable trajectories
items.title_zh: 基于可指导健康年龄与反事实可穿戴轨迹的个性化健康指导
items.abstract_en: Personalized health coaching requires moving beyond retrospective wearable summaries toward quantitative, actionable behavioral prescriptions. We introduce Coachable Health Age (CHA), an interpretable health-age metric built from modifiable physiological and behavioral signals passively captured by consumer wearables. Across the WEAR-ME (N=2,780), All of Us (N=22,748), and longitudinal Fitbit (N=1,464) cohorts, CHA aligns with established cardiometabolic health constructs and improves prognostic discrimination for incident cardiovascular and metabolic disease beyond age, sex, and body mass index. To enable prospective behavioral optimization, we developed Sensor World Model (SensorWM), an action-conditioned wearable world model pretrained on over 2.2 million person-weeks of longitudinal sensor data from approximately 100,000 participants. SensorWM accurately forecasts multi-week physiological responses to candidate lifestyle changes ($R^2=0.664$), outperforming generic time-series foundation models while preserving downstream clinical signal for diabetes, hypertension, and other health outcomes. Finally, we integrate CHA and SensorWM into an agentic counterfactual coaching system to synthesize personalized 12-week coaching plans. In blinded paired reviews, certified lifestyle coaches preferred counterfactual-grounded plans over plans grounded in wearable history alone for overall quality (71.4%, P < 0.001) and anticipated adherence (71.0%, P < 0.001), and board-certified clinicians judged 99.2% of counterfactual-grounded plans to meet clinical safety criteria (vs. 97.6% of comparison plans). Automated evaluations across the full cohort (N=2,780) also favored counterfactual-grounded plans. By closing the loop between longitudinal tracking, trajectory prediction, and counterfactual coaching, our framework provides a scalable path to systematically improve cardiometabolic health.
items.abstract_zh: 个性化健康指导需要超越回顾性可穿戴设备摘要，转向定量、可操作的行为处方。我们提出可指导健康年龄（Coachable Health Age，CHA），一种由消费级可穿戴设备被动采集的可修改生理和行为信号构建的可解释健康年龄指标。在 WEAR-ME（N=2,780）、All of Us（N=22,748）和纵向 Fitbit（N=1,464）队列中，CHA 与既有心脏代谢健康构念一致，并在年龄、性别和体重指数之外改善了对新发心血管和代谢疾病的预后判别。为实现前瞻性行为优化，我们开发了 Sensor World Model（SensorWM），这是一个以动作为条件的可穿戴世界模型，预训练于来自约 100,000 名参与者的超过 220 万人周的纵向传感器数据。SensorWM 能准确预测候选生活方式改变引起的多周生理反应（R²=0.664），优于通用时间序列基础模型，同时保留对糖尿病、高血压和其他健康结局的下游临床信号。最后，我们将 CHA 和 SensorWM 集成到代理式反事实指导系统中，以合成个性化 12 周指导计划。在盲法配对评审中，认证生活方式教练在整体质量（71.4%，P < 0.001）和预期依从性（71.0%，P < 0.001）方面更喜欢基于反事实的计划，而非仅基于可穿戴历史的计划；委员会认证临床医生判定 99.2% 的基于反事实的计划符合临床安全标准（相比比较计划的 97.6%）。全队列（N=2,780）的自动评估也偏向基于反事实的计划。通过在纵向跟踪、轨迹预测和反事实指导之间闭环，我们的框架为系统改善心脏代谢健康提供了可扩展路径。

items.title_en: A Phase-Balanced Differential Rydberg-Atom Quantum Receiver for Weak GNSS Signal Detection
items.title_zh: 用于弱GNSS信号检测的相位平衡差分里德堡原子量子接收机
items.abstract_en: This paper proposes a phase-balanced differential Rydberg atomic quantum receiver (DRAQR) for weak-signal recovery, using local-oscillator phase control to reinforce differential signal responses and a shared squeezed-reservoir model to correlate inter-cell quantum projection noise (QPN) and photon shot noise (PSN). An analytical model incorporating QPN, PSN, intrinsic thermal noise (ITN), and inter-cell correlations quantifies signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) gain, outage-constrained minimum detectable power, and bit-error rate (BER) for square $M$-QAM. For the evaluated settings, SNR gain reaches approximately $10$~dB as PSN correlation approaches unity, with BER decreasing as correlation increases. Under Rician fading, at a $0$-dB threshold SNR and maximum outage probability of $0.1$, the minimum detectable power decreases from $-146.95$~dBm at $K=1.155$ to $-159.98$~dBm at $K=2.4$. Analytical results are validated against Monte-Carlo simulations over $150{,}000$ data runs per point for receiver-performance plots.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种相位平衡差分里德堡原子量子接收机（DRAQR），用于弱信号恢复，利用本振相位控制增强差分信号响应，并采用共享压缩储库模型关联单元间量子投影噪声（QPN）和光子散粒噪声（PSN）。一个纳入QPN、PSN、固有热噪声（ITN）和单元间相关性的解析模型，量化了方形M-QAM的信噪比（SNR）增益、中断约束下的最小可检测功率和误码率（BER）。在所评估的设置下，当PSN相关性趋近于1时，SNR增益达到约10 dB，且BER随相关性增加而降低。在莱斯衰落条件下，当阈值SNR为0 dB且最大中断概率为0.1时，最小可检测功率从K=1.155时的-146.95 dBm降至K=2.4时的-159.98 dBm。对于接收机性能图，每个点使用150,000次数据运行的蒙特卡洛仿真验证了解析结果。

items.title_en: HyInv Technical Report
items.title_zh: HyInv技术报告
items.abstract_en: Inverse folding designs amino-acid sequences for a given protein backbone, and screening needs many candidates that are both diverse and well folded. We present HyInv, a 1.96-million-parameter backbone-conditioned graph network with an encoder-decoder architecture, trained by Hyra 2.0, the research agent developed by our team: pretrained with random-order autoregressive sequence modeling, followed by structure-reward reinforcement learning. At inference, a grouped draft-and-rewrite sampler that uses separate draft and rewrite temperatures improves refolding TM-score at matched diversity. An optimized implementation with BF16 numerics designs 128 sequences for a 402-residue backbone in 50.6 ms on a single NVIDIA H20 GPU, about 52 times faster than the reference sampler, and an exact FP32 path that returns the reference sequences is 8.7 times faster. Across five benchmark datasets and seven dataset-predictor combinations, HyInv reaches a higher average scTM than all ten external baselines at comparable or higher sequence diversity, with large margins over ProteinMPNN and ProteinZero V2. The same default setting supports de novo backbones, pocket-constrained libraries, enzyme redesign with the catalytic site kept, and loop redesign. We have released our code and model at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hyra-results/tree/main/AI4Science/hyinv.
items.abstract_zh: 逆折叠为给定蛋白质主链设计氨基酸序列，而筛选需要许多既多样又折叠良好的候选序列。我们提出HyInv，一个具有编码器-解码器架构的196万参数、以主链为条件的图网络，由我们团队开发的研究代理Hyra 2.0训练：先以随机顺序自回归序列建模预训练，再进行结构奖励强化学习。在推理时，一种使用独立起草温度和重写温度的分组起草-重写采样器在匹配多样性下提高重折叠TM-score。采用BF16数值的优化实现在单块NVIDIA H20 GPU上为402残基主链设计128条序列耗时50.6 ms，比参考采样器快约52倍；而返回参考序列的精确FP32路径快8.7倍。在五个基准数据集和七种数据集-预测器组合上，HyInv在相当或更高的序列多样性下达到比所有十个外部基线更高的平均scTM，并大幅领先ProteinMPNN和ProteinZero V2。相同的默认设置支持从头主链、口袋约束文库、保留催化位点的酶重设计以及环区重设计。我们已在https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hyra-results/tree/main/AI4Science/hyinv发布代码和模型。

items.title_en: Evaluating Physically Grounded Procedural Reasoning in VLMs through Real-World Execution: Crochet as a Testbed
items.title_zh: 通过真实世界执行评估VLM中物理接地的程序性推理：以钩针编织为测试平台
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can generate procedures that look convincing on paper, but do they work in practice? In this paper, we propose crochet as an ideal testbed for physically grounded procedural reasoning in VLMs. Crochet cannot be reliably simulated or automated: the only way to know what a pattern produces is to make it by hand, yet verification is tangible and cheap, requiring nothing but a hook and a ball of yarn. We introduce FoundationChain, a deceptively simple test of procedural reasoning: given an image of a basic crochet object, can VLMs infer how it was made and generate a pattern that produces the same result? We crochet 40 patterns generated by four VLMs by hand. Even at this scale, physical execution not only reveals failures that automated proxies cannot detect, but also enables a more precise diagnosis of their causes and consequences: while models write fluent, convincing patterns, only four are free of errors, and our analysis exposes deficiencies in visual, geometric and procedural reasoning.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）可以生成在纸面上看起来令人信服的流程，但它们在实践中有效吗？在本文中，我们提出将钩针编织作为VLM中物理接地的程序性推理的理想测试平台。钩针编织无法可靠地仿真或自动化：要知道一个编织图解会产出什么，唯一的方法是用手制作；然而验证是具体且廉价的，只需要一个钩针和一团纱线。我们提出FoundationChain，一个看似简单的程序性推理测试：给定一个基础钩针编织对象的图像，VLM能否推断它是如何制作的，并生成能产生相同结果的编织图解？我们手工钩织了由四个VLM生成的40个图解。即使在这个规模上，物理执行不仅揭示了自动化替代指标无法检测的失败，还能更精确地诊断其原因和后果：虽然模型写出流畅、令人信服的图解，但只有四个没有错误，我们的分析揭示了视觉、几何和程序性推理方面的缺陷。

items.title_en: Energy-Aware Open-Vocabulary Detection Scheduling for Low-Power Robotic Autonomy
items.title_zh: 面向低功耗机器人自主性的能量感知开放词汇检测调度
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) lets robots search for run-time object queries, but fixed-rate inference spends embedded compute on low-value frames during idle motion, map revisits, or stable viewpoints. This paper presents an energy-aware OVD scheduler for low-power mobile robots. The scheduler uses odometry, map change, and detector confidence to switch among low-, mid-, and high-power YOLO-World-S modes on a Jetson Orin Nano. We evaluate the energy-quality trade-off on an AgileX LIMO using 40 real navigation trials: two target objects, five placements per target-policy pair, and four perception policies. Across bottle and cup trials, the scheduler records 8/10 mission success compared with 7/10 for each fixed-rate baseline, while reducing mean Jetson input power (a Jetson-side power-draw metric) by 5.2% relative to an 8 Hz high-rate baseline and lowering achieved OVD call rate by 34.0%. It does not minimize mission-window Jetson input energy because longer missions can erase instantaneous power savings. A separate 60 s stationary microbenchmark isolates the perception workload: the scheduler lowers mean power from 8.045 W to 7.301 W and energy from 484.7 J to 438.1 J relative to the 8 Hz baseline. These results support robot-state-aware OVD scheduling as a promising power-management mechanism with competitive task reliability, while showing that mission-window Jetson input energy must be read together with task progress and runtime.
items.abstract_zh: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）使机器人能够搜索运行时目标查询，但固定速率推理会在空闲运动、地图重访或稳定视点期间将嵌入式计算花费在低价值帧上。本文提出一种用于低功耗移动机器人的能量感知 OVD 调度器。该调度器利用里程计、地图变化和检测器置信度，在 Jetson Orin Nano 上在低、中、高功耗 YOLO-World-S 模式之间切换。我们在 AgileX LIMO 上使用 40 次真实导航试验评估能量-质量权衡：两个目标物体，每个目标-策略对五种放置，以及四种感知策略。在瓶子和杯子试验中，该调度器记录到 8/10 的任务成功率，而每个固定速率基线为 7/10；同时相对于 8 Hz 高速率基线，将平均 Jetson 输入功率（Jetson 侧功耗指标）降低 5.2%，并将实际达到的 OVD 调用率降低 34.0%。它并未最小化任务窗口内的 Jetson 输入能量，因为更长任务可能抵消瞬时功率节省。一个单独的 60 秒静止微基准测试隔离了感知工作负载：相对于 8 Hz 基线，调度器将平均功率从 8.045 W 降至 7.301 W，能量从 484.7 J 降至 438.1 J。这些结果支持机器人状态感知的 OVD 调度作为一种有前景的电源管理机制，并具有有竞争力的任务可靠性，同时表明任务窗口内的 Jetson 输入能量必须与任务进度和运行时一起解读。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏输入视图优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续5D坐标（空间位置$(x,y,z)$和观察方向$(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和视角相关的发射辐射度。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组具有已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于神经渲染和视图合成先前工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: OriDynamics: Towards a World Model for Biomolecular Dynamics
items.title_zh: OriDynamics：迈向生物分子动力学的世界模型
items.abstract_en: Biomolecular recognition and regulation depend on atomic interactions that change as molecular partners fluctuate and adopt alternative conformations. Modeling these processes requires ensembles that capture both conformational diversity and coordinated atomic fluctuations between interacting molecules. Here we present OriDynamics, a unified framework for all-atom ensemble generation across protein monomers and complexes with small molecules or protein partners. OriDynamics introduces a latent ensemble decomposition that couples broad conformational exploration in a compact structural latent space with local all-atom sampling around generated proposals. Ensemble-level supervision constrains mean positions, fluctuation amplitudes and joint coordinate covariance to capture coordinated atomic variability within and between molecular partners. Across benchmarks of proteins and their complexes, OriDynamics demonstrates superior overall performance in conformational coverage, atomic fluctuation fidelity and interaction geometry compared with leading baselines. Application studies further demonstrate recovery of alternative functional conformations and partner-dependent changes in conformational ensembles alongside sampling of configurations associated with ligand dissociation. These capabilities provide a foundation for a biomolecular world model that represents accessible molecular states and their dependence on interaction context.
items.abstract_zh: 生物分子识别与调控依赖于原子相互作用，而这些相互作用会随着分子伙伴的涨落和采取替代构象而变化。对这类过程建模需要能够同时捕捉构象多样性和相互作用分子之间协同原子涨落的系综。本文提出 OriDynamics，一个统一框架，用于跨蛋白质单体以及与小型分子或蛋白质伙伴形成的复合物生成全原子系综。OriDynamics 引入潜在系综分解，将紧凑结构潜在空间中的广泛构象探索与围绕生成提议的局部全原子采样耦合起来。系综级监督约束平均位置、涨落幅度和联合坐标协方差，以捕捉分子伙伴内部及之间的协同原子变异性。在蛋白质及其复合物的基准上，与领先基线相比，OriDynamics 在构象覆盖、原子涨落保真度和相互作用几何方面展现出更优的总体性能。应用研究进一步展示了恢复替代功能构象和构象系综中伙伴依赖的变化，同时采样与配体解离相关的构型。这些能力为生物分子世界模型提供了基础，该模型可表示可及分子状态及其对相互作用情境的依赖。

items.title_en: Reconstructing intracell polarization with calibrated sapphire-window optics for collimated blue-light generation in a rubidium cell
items.title_zh: 利用校准的蓝宝石窗口光学器件重建铷池内偏振以产生准直蓝光
items.abstract_en: We study the polarization dependence of collimated blue light (CBL) generated near 420~nm by resonant four-wave mixing in thermal rubidium vapor in a sapphire-window cell driven at 780 and 776~nm. Sapphire windows can transform the polarization of pump light before it reaches the vapor, complicating the interpretation of polarization-dependent nonlinear emission. We measured the 780-nm pump Stokes state at an external before-cell reference plane to calibrate the common HWP/QWP preparation optics and recorded 266 off-resonant external output Stokes states after the complete sapphire-window rubidium cell at 90, 100, and 110~$^\circ$C in two propagation orientations. Direct paired-wavelength measurements show a mean before-cell 780/776 separation of $4.29^\circ$ and temperature- and orientation-specific complete-cell rotations of $22.20^\circ$--$32.02^\circ$, with rms residuals of $4.83^\circ$--$12.87^\circ$. Using this calibrated co-prepared pump description, we analyzed 2574 measurements of total spectrally filtered 420-nm CBL intensity. Across the six temperature--orientation data sets, a complete nine-coefficient second-order response yielded cross-validated $R^2$ values of 0.636 to 0.828. These paired-wavelength measurements establish, for each temperature--orientation data set, a fixed relative Stokes-space map between the two co-prepared pump trajectories, with the residual of this mapping defining the experimental uncertainty of the correlated two-pump reduction used in the response model. Thus, the resulting framework combines a reconstructed vapor-entrance polarization coordinate with direct two-wavelength calibration of the assembled cell and provides a practical basis for polarization-controlled nonlinear-optical experiments in sapphire-window vapor cells.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在蓝宝石窗口池中、由 780 和 776 nm 驱动的热铷蒸气中通过共振四波混频产生的近 420 nm 准直蓝光（CBL）的偏振依赖性。蓝宝石窗口可在泵浦光到达蒸气前改变其偏振，从而使偏振相关非线性发射的解释复杂化。我们在外部池前参考平面测量 780 nm 泵浦斯托克斯态，以校准共用的 HWP/QWP 制备光学器件，并在 90、100 和 110 °C、两种传播取向下，记录完整蓝宝石窗口铷池后的 266 个非共振外部输出斯托克斯态。直接配对波长测量显示，池前 780/776 平均分离为 4.29°，且完整池的旋转随温度和取向而异，为 22.20°--32.02°，均方根残差为 4.83°--12.87°。利用这一校准后的共同制备泵浦描述，我们分析了 2574 次经光谱滤波的 420 nm CBL 总强度测量。在六个温度-取向数据集上，完整的九系数二阶响应给出交叉验证 R² 值为 0.636 至 0.828。这些配对波长测量为每个温度-取向数据集建立了两个共同制备泵浦轨迹之间的固定相对斯托克斯空间映射，该映射的残差定义了响应模型中所用相关双泵浦约化的实验不确定度。因此，所得框架将重建的蒸气入口偏振坐标与对组装池的直接双波长校准相结合，并为蓝宝石窗口蒸气池中的偏振控制非线性光学实验提供实用基础。

items.title_en: An Evaluation of Tabular Foundation Models as Training-Free World Models
items.title_zh: 对表格基础模型作为免训练世界模型的评估
items.abstract_en: World models are widely considered to be a potential key component of model-based reinforcement learning and robot planning, but typically require task-specific training on substantial interaction data. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TabFM) can serve as a training-free dynamics model for world modeling by framing next-state prediction as in-context regression over transition pairs, and where such a model helps and where it breaks. Across synthetic dynamical systems and robot locomotion benchmarks, TabFM is more accurate than LSTM and MLP models trained from scratch on the same limited transitions in almost all settings, and among regressors fitted to the same data it is the most accurate on locomotion, while a Gaussian process is more accurate on smooth low-dimensional systems. However, models trained on the full dataset remain substantially better on most systems. When rolled out autoregressively over multiple steps, TabFM's accuracy depends strongly on how much context it is given. With a short context, its rollouts quickly degrade to the level of a trivial baseline, whereas with a long context they improve substantially and, on one locomotion task, exceed a trained LSTM. Inference is also about three orders of magnitude slower than an LSTM. Overall, in their current state, we find that training-free priors are useful as predictors when data are scarce and enough context is available, but they are not yet a substitute for trained world models in planning.
items.abstract_zh: 世界模型被广泛认为是基于模型的强化学习和机器人规划的潜在关键组成部分，但通常需要在大量交互数据上进行任务特定训练。我们研究预训练表格基础模型（TabFM）能否通过将下一状态预测表述为对转移对的上下文回归，来作为免训练的动力学模型用于世界建模，并考察此类模型在何处有帮助、在何处失效。在合成动力系统和机器人运动基准上，几乎所有设置中，TabFM 都比在相同有限转移数据上从头训练的 LSTM 和 MLP 模型更准确；在拟合相同数据的回归器中，它在运动任务上最准确，而高斯过程在平滑低维系统上更准确。然而，在大多数系统上，在全数据集上训练的模型仍然明显更好。当进行多步自回归展开时，TabFM 的准确率强烈依赖于所给上下文的多少。在短上下文下，其展开很快退化到平凡基线的水平；而在长上下文下，展开显著改善，并在一个运动任务上超过训练过的 LSTM。推理速度也比 LSTM 慢约三个数量级。总体而言，就当前状态而言，我们发现免训练先验在数据稀缺且上下文充足时可用作预测器，但在规划中尚不能替代训练过的世界模型。

items.title_en: Language as Trait, Politeness as Strategy: Controlled Tests of Linguistic Effects in LLM Social-Deduction Agents
items.title_zh: 语言作为特征，礼貌作为策略：LLM 社交推理智能体中语言效应的受控测试
items.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate through conversation, and the same message can be phrased in simpler or more complex language, bluntly or politely. We test whether such differences change how other agents judge and act, using the LURK Werewolf framework, which separates each utterance's speech-act predicate from its natural-language realization. We rewrite only the realization, check that the game content is preserved, and replay each game day from saved checkpoints against a re-sampled control. We vary linguistic range consistently across a speaker's messages and politeness strategy per utterance. Across 30 games and 4,335 replays, neither manipulation changes the trust other agents place in the speaker, and no effect on votes or night actions survives correction for multiple comparisons; the largest uncorrected effect is that shifting range away from a neutral paraphrase changes about 4 percentage points more of the other players' votes. In natural play, 88% of face-threatening speech is bald on-record regardless of role.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过对话进行协调，而同一消息可以用更简单或更复杂的语言、直率或礼貌的方式表达。我们使用 LURK Werewolf 框架测试这类差异是否会改变其他智能体的判断和行动，该框架将每个话语的言语行为谓词与其自然语言实现分离。我们只重写实现，检查游戏内容得到保留，并从保存的检查点重放每个游戏日，与重新采样的对照进行比较。我们在说话者的消息中一致地改变语言范围，并逐话语改变礼貌策略。在 30 局游戏和 4,335 次重放中，两种操纵都没有改变其他智能体对说话者的信任，也没有任何对投票或夜间行动的影响在经过多重比较校正后仍然存在；最大的未校正效应是，将语言范围从中性转述移开会使其他玩家约 4 个百分点的投票发生变化。在自然游玩中，88% 的威胁面子言语无论角色如何都是赤裸裸地公开实施（bald on-record）。

items.title_en: CSG-Nav: Confidence-Aware Semantic-Geometric Fusion for Robust Exploration and Accurate Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation
items.title_zh: CSG-Nav：面向鲁棒探索与准确零样本物体目标导航的置信度感知语义-几何融合
items.abstract_en: Zero-shot object-goal navigation requires autonomous agents to explore unseen environments and locate target objects without task-specific training, posing challenges in perceptual reliability under observation uncertainty and physically grounded goal termination. Although foundation-model-based approaches improve generalization, they remain vulnerable to unreliable long-range perception, hallucination-induced directional bias, and semantically plausible but geometrically incorrect stopping decisions. To address these limitations, we propose CSG-Nav, a zero-shot navigation framework centered on confidence-aware multimodal information fusion. CSG-Nav integrates three complementary fusion mechanisms. First, semantic-source fusion integrates open-vocabulary detection results, detection confidence, scene observations, and relational reasoning to produce more reliable direction-level semantic scores and suppress hallucination-induced directional bias. Second, spatial-confidence fusion weights multi-view semantic evidence using a Gaussian decay function, suppressing unreliable distant observations while accumulating spatially consistent exploration preferences. Third, semantic-geometric decision fusion combines semantic target detection with depth-based 3D localization to support physically grounded stopping decisions. Experiments on HM3Dv1, HM3Dv2, and MP3D demonstrate competitive zero-shot performance, achieving success rates of 58.9%, 71.6%, and 44.3%. Fusion-level ablations and real-world deployments in indoor and outdoor environments further verify the effectiveness and practicality of CSG-Nav for robust navigation under uncertain perception. Code is available at https://xr-ui.github.io/CSGNav.github.io/
items.abstract_zh: 零样本物体目标导航要求自主智能体在无需任务特定训练的情况下探索未见环境并定位目标物体，这在观测不确定性下的感知可靠性和物理上合理的目标终止方面带来挑战。尽管基于基础模型的方法提升了泛化能力，它们仍然容易受到不可靠的远距离感知、幻觉引起的方向偏差，以及语义上合理但几何上不正确的停止决策的影响。为解决这些局限，我们提出 CSG-Nav，一个以置信度感知多模态信息融合为核心的零样本导航框架。CSG-Nav 集成了三种互补的融合机制。第一，语义源融合整合开放词汇检测结果、检测置信度、场景观测和关系推理，以产生更可靠的方向级语义分数，并抑制幻觉引起的方向偏差。第二，空间置信度融合使用高斯衰减函数对多视角语义证据加权，在抑制不可靠远距离观测的同时累积空间一致的探索偏好。第三，语义-几何决策融合将语义目标检测与基于深度的三维定位相结合，以支持物理上合理的停止决策。在 HM3Dv1、HM3Dv2 和 MP3D 上的实验展示了有竞争力的零样本性能，成功率分别达到 58.9%、71.6% 和 44.3%。融合级消融实验以及在室内外环境中的真实部署进一步验证了 CSG-Nav 在不确定感知下进行鲁棒导航的有效性和实用性。代码见 https://xr-ui.github.io/CSGNav.github.io/。

items.title_en: Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning
items.title_zh: Reframe：面向智能体视觉推理的观测对齐多教师同策略蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. We introduce Reframe, a post-training framework that treats the observation state, rather than only the output distribution, as an object of alignment. First, Ground-Drop-GRPO (GD-GRPO) trains spatial and temporal specialists with evidence-aware rewards and stochastic removal of the original visual input, encouraging them to acquire grounded evidence and use the returned observations. Second, Observation-Gated-MOPD (OG-MOPD) replaces deficient tool actions with canonical ones mid-rollout and resumes distillation from the repaired observation. The two stages complement each other, as learning to rely on tool-returned observations can help the policy benefit from observation repair. Neither stage requires a task-specific SFT cold start. Extensive experiments over 14 image and video benchmarks demonstrate that Reframe outperforms both Mix-RL and vanilla MOPD. Ablation results show that GD-GRPO increases observation dependence and tool gain compared with outcome-based GRPO.
items.abstract_zh: 智能体强化学习（RL）和多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）提供了互补的后训练路径。然而，对于视觉智能体，工具使用带来两个相关挑战。模型可能忽略有用的工具返回观测，而基础不牢的动作会限制后续蒸馏可用的证据。我们提出 Reframe，一个后训练框架，将对齐对象视为观测状态，而不仅仅是输出分布。第一，Ground-Drop-GRPO（GD-GRPO）使用证据感知奖励和随机移除原始视觉输入来训练空间和时间专家，鼓励它们获取有根据的证据并使用返回的观测。第二，Observation-Gated-MOPD（OG-MOPD）在展开过程中用规范动作替换有缺陷的工具动作，并从修复后的观测恢复蒸馏。这两个阶段相互补充，因为学习依赖工具返回的观测可以帮助策略从观测修复中受益。两个阶段都不需要任务特定的 SFT 冷启动。在 14 个图像和视频基准上的大量实验表明，Reframe 优于 Mix-RL 和原始 MOPD。消融结果表明，与基于结果的 GRPO 相比，GD-GRPO 提高了观测依赖性和工具增益。

items.title_en: Reproducible quantum clustering for single-cell transcriptome atlases
items.title_zh: 用于单细胞转录组图谱的可复现量子聚类
items.abstract_en: Current single-cell clustering pipelines discard most genes and can yield inconsistent clusters across random seeds. We introduce KQE-2, a training-free hybrid quantum-classical framework for reproducible whole-transcriptome clustering. KQE-2 maps cells into entanglement-free quantum states, enabling exact feature evaluation on classical hardware and direct checks on a quantum processor. Theoretically, we prove that removing entanglement is necessary and sufficient to bound single-qubit feature variance locally. Practically, while retraining scVI shifted 14% of cells and altered rare-type markers and drug targets, KQE-2 delivered identical biology across runs. On standard highly variable genes, the quantum encoding alone raised accuracy on a developing cortex from 0.61 to 0.79. KQE-2 scales to 11.4 million nuclei on one server, outperforming the compared methods on eight of ten complete atlases (and within the best method's run-to-run range on two), and leads on six even under standard downstream clustering.
items.abstract_zh: 当前的单细胞聚类流程丢弃大多数基因，并且在不同随机种子下可能产生不一致的聚类。我们提出 KQE-2，一个免训练的混合量子-经典框架，用于可复现的全转录组聚类。KQE-2 将细胞映射为无纠缠量子态，从而能够在经典硬件上进行精确特征评估，并在量子处理器上直接检查。在理论上，我们证明去除纠缠是局部界定单量子比特特征方差的必要且充分条件。在实践中，重新训练 scVI 会使 14% 的细胞发生偏移，并改变稀有类型标记和药物靶点，而 KQE-2 在多次运行中给出相同的生物学结果。在标准高变基因上，仅量子编码就将发育中皮层的准确率从 0.61 提高到 0.79。KQE-2 可在单台服务器上扩展到 1140 万个细胞核，在十个完整图谱中的八个上优于所比较方法（并在两个上处于最佳方法的运行间范围内），并且即使在标准下游聚类下也在六个图谱上领先。

items.title_en: Stable, High-Charge, Laser-Driven VHEE Beams for Preclinical Applications
items.title_zh: 用于临床前应用的稳定高电荷激光驱动 VHEE 束
items.abstract_en: Laser-driven plasma accelerators (LPAs) are promising sources of very-high-energy-electron (VHEE) beams for medical applications, but increasing charge per pulse while maintaining pointing stability remains challenging. We demonstrate laser-accelerated beams with total charge per pulse reaching (559 $\pm$ 56) pC using an 80 TW laser system. The spectra have a dominant component at 40-60 MeV and a high-energy tail extending to approximately 200 MeV. Pointing jitter measured in air at the irradiation target plane reaches as low as 0.7 mrad. The beams were used for VHEE irradiation experiments involving a 10 mm region of interest through a 40 mm depth at 400 $\pm$ 20 mGy/pulse. Spectral reproducibility is quantified over fixed-setting shot sequences. Particle-in-cell simulations produce a peak-and-tail spectrum through acceleration in successive bubbles associated with a strongly modified plasma wake, providing a plausible mechanism for maintaining substantial accelerated charge despite strong beam loading. Dose-weighted time-of-flight calculations indicate an effective pulse dose rate of $10^{12}$ Gy/s and average dose rates of tens of Gy/min. These results establish an LPA operating regime relevant to preclinical VHEE irradiation.
items.abstract_zh: 激光驱动等离子体加速器（LPA）是医学应用中很有前景的极高能电子（VHEE）束来源，但在保持指向稳定性的同时提高每脉冲电荷仍具挑战性。我们使用 80 TW 激光系统展示了每脉冲总电荷达到（559 ± 56）pC 的激光加速束。光谱在 40–60 MeV 有主导成分，并有延伸至约 200 MeV 的高能尾部。在照射靶平面空气中测得的指向抖动低至 0.7 mrad。这些束用于 VHEE 照射实验，涉及通过 40 mm 深度的 10 mm 感兴趣区，剂量为 400 ± 20 mGy/脉冲。光谱可重复性在固定设置射击序列上量化。粒子网格（PIC）模拟通过与强烈修正的等离子体尾场相关的连续气泡中加速产生峰尾谱，为在强束流负载下仍保持可观加速电荷提供了合理解释机制。剂量加权飞行时间计算表明有效脉冲剂量率为 10^12 Gy/s，平均剂量率为数十 Gy/min。这些结果建立了一个与临床前 VHEE 照射相关的 LPA 运行区间。

items.title_en: Operator Learning of Microstructure-Dependent Internal-Variable Models for Inelastic Homogenization: Approximation and Complexity
items.title_zh: 面向非弹性均匀化的微结构依赖内变量模型的算子学习：近似与复杂度
items.abstract_en: We study the learning of homogenized constitutive laws for inelastic heterogeneous materials, aiming to replace costly concurrent unit-cell simulations with surrogates that generalize across loading histories and microstructures. We focus on the recurrent neural operator framework, motivated by the explicit form of homogenized Kelvin--Voigt linear viscoelasticity. In this framework, internal variables enable a Markovian approximation of loading-history dependence, and neural operators represent the microstructure-dependent constitutive response. For periodic Kelvin--Voigt viscoelasticity, we prove a universal approximation theorem showing that the model can approximate the homogenized constitutive law to any prescribed accuracy, uniformly in time and over a wide set of admissible strain trajectories and microstructural property fields, in two and three dimensions. This comprises a significant extension of the existing, somewhat limited, one-dimensional theory that uses explicit solutions for piecewise constant materials. Instead, in two and three dimensions, we adopt a more versatile approximation based on the spectral representation of the memory kernel that arises from homogenization. This also enables us to give an explicit bound on the internal-variable dimension, sufficient for approximation, exhibiting logarithmic growth in the inverse relative stress error and in material contrast. Numerical experiments on viscoelasticity and crystal plasticity complement the theory, illustrating the roles of internal-variable dimension and sample complexity in learning homogenized responses from unit-cell data. Theoretical results are formally verified in Lean 4.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究非弹性异质材料均匀化本构律的学习，旨在用能够跨加载历史和微结构泛化的代理模型替代昂贵的并发单胞模拟。我们聚焦于循环神经算子框架，其动机来自均匀化 Kelvin--Voigt 线性粘弹性的显式形式。在该框架中，内变量使加载历史依赖性能够进行马尔可夫近似，神经算子表示微结构依赖的本构响应。对于周期性 Kelvin--Voigt 粘弹性，我们证明了一个通用近似定理，表明该模型可以在二维和三维中，对时间一致地、在广泛的可允许应变轨迹和微结构属性场上，以任意指定精度近似均匀化本构律。这显著扩展了现有的、略显有限的一维理论，该理论使用分段常数材料的显式解。相反，在二维和三维中，我们采用一种更通用的近似，其基于均匀化产生的记忆核的谱表示。这也使我们能够给出内变量维度的显式界，该维度足以用于近似，并表现出随相对应力误差倒数和材料对比度的对数增长。关于粘弹性和晶体塑性的数值实验补充了理论，说明了内变量维度和样本复杂度在从单胞数据学习均匀化响应中的作用。理论结果已在 Lean 4 中形式化验证。

items.title_en: The Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model
items.title_zh: 模拟视角的几何：在多模态语言模型中解离表征与行为
items.abstract_en: Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. This dissociation is further illustrated by minimal identity statements that alter representations even without changing responses. These findings demonstrate that representational distance does not necessarily reflect behavioural relevance. More broadly, they reveal how simulated perspectives emerge as distinct structures within the representational space of artificial cognitive systems, highlighting a fundamental distinction between the geometry of internal representations and their functional consequences.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态语言模型可以模拟不同的观察者，但尚不清楚被分配的视角如何重塑其内部表征，以及这些变化是否支配其判断。在此，我们研究 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 中人格条件化视觉有趣性的表征几何。在 100 张图像和 53 种提示条件下，我们系统地改变人格内容以及用于引入人格的语言框架，同时记录行为评分和逐层隐藏状态。我们观察到表征几何随处理深度发生系统性重组：早期层主要编码图像身份，而人格特定结构在较晚层出现。引人注目的是，提示框架对内部表征的重塑比人格身份更强，而人格内容对行为判断的影响更大。这种解离进一步由最小身份陈述说明，这些陈述即使不改变响应也会改变表征。这些发现表明，表征距离不一定反映行为相关性。更广泛地说，它们揭示了模拟视角如何作为独特结构出现在人工认知系统的表征空间中，强调内部表征的几何与其功能后果之间的根本区别。

items.title_en: DreamLander: A 6-DOF World Model based Reinforcement Learning Planetary Lander
items.title_zh: DreamLander：一种基于6自由度世界模型的强化学习行星着陆器
items.abstract_en: Soft powered descent landings are becoming evermore important in the field of space exploration and scientific advancement, because of their ability to deliver mission critical payloads, both highly accurately and safely. The high efficiency restriction on planetary landings due to the severely limited fuel supply results in the need for optimal guidance trajectories and control. Model based reinforcement learning is proving to be an important tool in simplifying the highly complex process of generating optimal guidance trajectories and control. In this work, we present DreamLander, a state of the art model based reinforcement learning algorithm based on DreamerV3, to generate optimal guidance and control for a realistic 6 degree of freedom entry descent landing problem. The model based approach creates a sample efficient and highly generalizable model that can be applied to a variety of scenarios whilst maintaining a high degree of accuracy, landing within 2 meters of the designated landing zone, and with velocity norm less than 0.3 meters per second. DreamLander makes use of state sensor observations, making progress toward End-to-End solutions of the Entry Descent Landing problem.
items.abstract_zh: 软动力下降着陆在太空探索与科学进步领域正变得越来越重要，因为它能够高精度且安全地投送任务关键载荷。由于燃料供应严重受限，行星着陆对高效率的限制导致需要最优制导轨迹与控制。基于模型的强化学习正被证明是简化生成最优制导轨迹与控制这一高度复杂过程的重要工具。在本工作中，我们提出DreamLander，一种基于DreamerV3的最先进的基于模型的强化学习算法，用于为真实的6自由度进入下降着陆问题生成最优制导与控制。该基于模型的方法创建了一个样本高效且高度可泛化的模型，可应用于多种场景，同时保持高精度，在指定着陆区2米范围内着陆，速度范数小于0.3米/秒。DreamLander利用状态传感器观测，朝着进入下降着陆问题的端到端解决方案迈进。

items.title_en: AI-based characterization of lymphoid structures and the tumor microenvironment reveals lower mature tertiary lymphoid structures, lymph-node follicles, and plasma cells after neoadjuvant therapy in lung squamous cell carcinoma
items.title_zh: 基于AI的淋巴结构与肿瘤微环境表征揭示肺鳞状细胞癌新辅助治疗后成熟三级淋巴结构、淋巴结滤泡和浆细胞减少
items.abstract_en: Mature, germinal centre-bearing tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) and mature lymph node follicles (secondary lymphoid structures, SLS) sustain the plasma cell response that shapes outcome and immunotherapy benefit in lung cancer. How this loco-regional axis differs between neoadjuvant-treated and therapy-naive tumors is poorly defined. We analyzed H&E whole-slide images of resected tumors and paired proximal and distal lymph nodes from matched neoadjuvant-treated (neoLUSC, n=20) and therapy-naive (naivLUSC, n=20) lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) patients. Aignostics Atlas H&E Tissue Analysis (HETA) models quantified cell densities per tissue compartment and cell-cell co-localization; a dedicated deep-learning model validated against pathologist annotations detected TLS and SLS and graded their maturity. Prognostic value was tested in an independent cohort (n=458; 46 treated). In neoLUSC tumors, stromal plasma cell density was 72% (p=0.004) and stromal lymphocyte density 48% (p=0.015) lower than in naivLUSC; macrophages and granulocytes did not differ significantly. Total and immature TLS did not differ, whereas mature TLS in the tumor (p=0.034) and mature SLS in the tumor-distal lymph node (p=0.003) were lower in neoLUSC patients. Peri-TLS plasma cell density correlated with tumor lymphocyte density in naivLUSC (rho=0.54, p=0.017) but not in neoLUSC tumors (rho=0.07). In the validation cohort, stromal plasma cell density (HR 0.69, p=0.011) and lymphocyte-plasma cell co-localization (HR 0.66, p=0.004) were associated with longer survival, and neoadjuvant status with shorter survival (HR 1.50, p=0.026). Neoadjuvant therapy is thus associated with fewer mature lymphoid structures and weaker coupling of the humoral compartment to the tumor rather than uniformly lower immune readouts. The stromal plasma cell/co-localization axis is a candidate prognostic biomarker.
items.abstract_zh: 成熟、含生发中心的三级淋巴结构（TLS）和成熟淋巴结滤泡（次级淋巴结构，SLS）维持浆细胞反应，而该反应塑造肺癌的结局和免疫治疗获益。新辅助治疗与未治疗肿瘤之间这种局部区域轴如何不同仍定义不清。我们分析了匹配的新辅助治疗（neoLUSC，n=20）和未治疗（naivLUSC，n=20）肺鳞状细胞癌（LUSC）患者切除肿瘤及配对近端和远端淋巴结的H&E全切片图像。Aignostics Atlas H&E Tissue Analysis（HETA）模型量化每个组织区室的细胞密度和细胞-细胞共定位；一个经病理学家标注验证的专用深度学习模型检测TLS和SLS并对其成熟度分级。在独立队列（n=458；46例接受治疗）中测试预后价值。在neoLUSC肿瘤中，间质浆细胞密度比naivLUSC低72%（p=0.004），间质淋巴细胞密度低48%（p=0.015）；巨噬细胞和粒细胞无显著差异。总TLS和未成熟TLS无差异，而neoLUSC患者肿瘤中的成熟TLS（p=0.034）和肿瘤远端淋巴结中的成熟SLS（p=0.003）较低。在naivLUSC中，TLS周围浆细胞密度与肿瘤淋巴细胞密度相关（rho=0.54，p=0.017），但在neoLUSC肿瘤中不相关（rho=0.07）。在验证队列中，间质浆细胞密度（HR 0.69，p=0.011）和淋巴细胞-浆细胞共定位（HR 0.66，p=0.004）与更长生存相关，新辅助状态与更短生存相关（HR 1.50，p=0.026）。因此，新辅助治疗与更少的成熟淋巴结构和体液免疫区室与肿瘤的较弱耦合相关，而非免疫读数普遍降低。间质浆细胞/共定位轴是一个候选预后生物标志物。

items.title_en: Tissue-like Viscoelasticity Drives Muscle Stem Cell Expansion Through Mechanical Memory Formation
items.title_zh: 类组织黏弹性通过机械记忆形成驱动肌肉干细胞扩增
items.abstract_en: Mechanical cues are potent regulators of stem cell fate, with even transient exposure to substrates with varied elastic stiffness driving persistent changes in cell fate. Such elastic mechanical memory contributes to the loss of regenerative potential in skeletal muscle stem cells (MuSCs) when cultured on rigid substrates, hampering the translation of myogenic cell replacement therapies. Beyond elastic mechanical properties, cells also respond to time-dependent, viscoelastic mechanical properties, such as stress relaxation. However, whether tissue-like viscoelasticity can impart a mechanical memory that directs stem cell fate remains an open question. Accordingly, dual-network hydrogel biomaterials with decoupled control of stiffness, stress relaxation, and adhesive ligand presentation were engineered to recapitulate the viscoelastic mechanical properties of native muscle. Muscle-like viscoelastic substrates promote in vitro MuSC activation and accelerate stem cell expansion, matching in vivo activation timescales. Mechanistically, physiological viscoelasticity promotes focal adhesion stabilization and enhances Rac-Akt signaling, establishing a viscoelastic mechanical memory that supports progenitor expansion and persistent maintenance of a stem-like phenotype. These findings identify matrix viscoelasticity as a potent and persistent regulator of MuSC fate and provide a framework for engineering biomaterials that preserve MuSC stemness and expansion ex vivo.
items.abstract_zh: 机械线索是干细胞命运的有力调控因素，即使短暂暴露于具有不同弹性刚度的基底，也会驱动细胞命运的持久变化。这种弹性机械记忆导致骨骼肌干细胞（MuSCs）在刚性基底上培养时再生潜能丧失，阻碍了肌源性细胞替代疗法的转化。除弹性力学性质外，细胞还响应时间依赖的黏弹性力学性质，例如应力松弛。然而，类组织黏弹性是否能赋予指导干细胞命运的机械记忆，仍是一个未解问题。因此，我们设计了双网络水凝胶生物材料，可解耦控制刚度、应力松弛和黏附配体呈递，以重现天然肌肉的黏弹性力学性质。类肌肉黏弹性基底促进体外 MuSC 激活并加速干细胞扩增，与体内激活时间尺度相匹配。机制上，生理性黏弹性促进黏着斑稳定并增强 Rac-Akt 信号传导，建立一种黏弹性机械记忆，支持祖细胞扩增和干细胞样表型的持续维持。这些发现表明基质黏弹性是 MuSC 命运的有力且持久调控因素，并为设计在体外保存 MuSC 干性和扩增的生物材料提供了框架。

items.title_en: Optical microscopy for pathological imaging: past, present, and future
items.title_zh: 用于病理成像的光学显微术：过去、现在与未来
items.abstract_en: Histopathology, the microscopic examination of stained tissue sections, remains the gold standard for pathology imaging, but its bright-field imaging is largely morphological. Advanced optical microscopy techniques move beyond this by exploiting diverse light-matter interactions, and are increasingly applied to pathological imaging. By capturing signals such as refractive index, polarisation, harmonic generation, Brillouin shift, and molecular vibrations, these microscopy techniques can provide quantitative or semi-quantitative information on tissue structure, mechanics, and chemical or molecular composition. In this review, we summarise the physical principles, key quantitative parameters, and representative pathological applications of seven modalities--optical diffraction tomography, polarisation microscopy, second-harmonic generation microscopy, third-harmonic generation microscopy, Brillouin microscopy, Raman microscopy, and fluorescence microscopy. We also discuss progress in artificial intelligence that supports reconstruction, analysis, and interpretation across these modalities, together with emerging trends in multimodal integration. Overall, this review shows how different optical contrasts can complement routine histopathology, while outlining the challenges and opportunities that will shape their clinical translation.
items.abstract_zh: 组织病理学，即对染色组织切片的显微镜检查，仍是病理成像的金标准，但其明场成像主要提供形态学信息。先进光学显微技术通过利用多样的光—物质相互作用超越这一点，并越来越多地应用于病理成像。通过捕获折射率、偏振、谐波产生、布里渊频移和分子振动等信号，这些显微技术可提供关于组织结构、力学以及化学或分子组成的定量或半定量信息。在本综述中，我们总结七种模态的物理原理、关键定量参数和代表性病理应用——光学衍射层析、偏振显微术、二次谐波产生显微术、三次谐波产生显微术、布里渊显微术、拉曼显微术和荧光显微术。我们还讨论支持这些模态重建、分析和解释的人工智能进展，以及多模态集成的新兴趋势。总体而言，本综述展示不同光学对比度如何补充常规组织病理学，同时概述将塑造其临床转化的挑战与机遇。

items.title_en: Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
items.title_zh: 静态恢复不是动态稳定性：蛋白质基序支架设计的动力学感知基准测试
items.abstract_en: Protein motif scaffolding benchmarks assess whether generative models can build scaffolds around functionally important residues. Their conclusions depend on which motifs are tested and which criteria define success. Existing benchmarks typically use small hand-curated motif sets and static refolding criteria, but protein function often depends on conformational ensembles and transitions. Here, we address both benchmark scope and success criteria. We introduce BILBY-PRO, a systematically derived benchmark of structurally conserved functional motifs from PROSITE-linked experimental structures, comprising 220 cases from 174 PROSITE motif-pattern entries. Evaluating six recent scaffold-generation models reveals distinct patterns in target coverage and unique-solution yield: RFDiffusion and Proteina solve more targets, whereas ESM3 produces more unique successful scaffolds on the targets it solves. We further introduce BILBY-MD, a reference-based all-atom molecular dynamics evaluation framework. Applied to statically solved designs from the original MotifBench benchmark, it compares motif drift, scaffold drift, motif-contact preservation, and motif-dihedral free-energy landscapes against reference simulations. Of 55 statically solved model-problem pairs, 31 satisfy our MD-supported criterion and only 8 pass all checks. Compact, self-contained motifs are often MD-supported, whereas interface-like or context-dependent motifs fail more frequently. Static refolding success therefore provides useful evidence of local motif recovery but does not establish dynamical fidelity of the full scaffold. BILBY highlights three complementary axes of motif-scaffolding evaluation: target coverage, unique-solution yield, and MD-supported dynamical fidelity.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质基序支架设计基准评估生成模型能否围绕功能重要残基构建支架。其结论取决于测试哪些基序以及哪些标准定义成功。现有基准通常使用小型手工整理的基序集和静态重折叠标准，但蛋白质功能往往依赖构象系综和转变。在此，我们同时处理基准范围和成功标准。我们引入 BILBY-PRO，这是一个从与 PROSITE 关联的实验结构中系统推导的结构保守功能基序基准，包含来自 174 个 PROSITE 基序模式条目的 220 个案例。评估六个近期支架生成模型揭示了在目标覆盖率和唯一解产出率上的不同模式：RFDiffusion 和 Proteina 解决更多目标，而 ESM3 在其解决的目标上产生更多唯一成功支架。我们进一步引入 BILBY-MD，一个基于参考的全原子分子动力学评估框架。将其应用于来自原始 MotifBench 基准的静态求解设计，它比较基序漂移、支架漂移、基序接触保持以及基序二面角自由能景观与参考模拟的差异。在 55 个静态求解的模型-问题对中，31 个满足我们 MD 支持的标准，仅 8 个通过所有检查。紧凑、自包含的基序通常获得 MD 支持，而类似界面或依赖上下文的基序更常失败。因此，静态重折叠成功为局部基序恢复提供了有用证据，但不能确立完整支架的动力学保真度。BILBY 突出了基序支架评估的三个互补轴：目标覆盖率、唯一解产出率和 MD 支持的动力学保真度。

items.title_en: Agent4Crypto: A Dual-Reflective and Market-Feedback-Aligned LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for Cryptocurrency Trading
items.title_zh: Agent4Crypto：一种用于加密货币交易的双反思且与市场反馈对齐的基于LLM的多智能体系统
items.abstract_en: Cryptocurrency markets provide a natural testbed for autonomous AI agents because they are digital-native, high-frequency, and machine-speed environments, yet existing methods often struggle with non-stationary market regimes, opaque decisions, and fixed aggregation rules. In this paper, we propose Agent4Crypto, a dual-reflective and market-feedback-aligned multi-agent system. The framework coordinates specialized agents for data collection, analysis, risk assessment, reflection, and trading, synthesizing heterogeneous signals from prices, indicators, news, and charts in an interpretable decision pipeline. Our central design is a trader-centric decision mechanism: three style-specific trader agents, Aggressive, Neutral, and Conservative, generate candidate actions and natural-language rationales from the same market context, while their influence is learned rather than manually fixed. A PPO-based gating policy dynamically allocates trader weights through a dual-reflective feedback process. One reflection stream evaluates post-trade decision quality from realized portfolio outcomes and distills reusable lessons into a Financial ReasoningBank for retrieval in subsequent trader prompts, while the other estimates trader-level counterfactual contribution, indicating which style has recently aligned better with market movements. The PPO state combines Counterfactual Contribution Memory with market features, previous trader weights, and current trader actions, so trader influence adapts across bull, sideways, and bear regimes. Experiments on BTC, ETH, and XRP show that Agent4Crypto improves total return and Sharpe ratio over traditional strategies, machine learning and reinforcement learning baselines, and existing LLM-based trading systems, demonstrating the value of interpretable trader competition and market-feedback-driven adaptation in volatile cryptocurrency markets.
items.abstract_zh: 加密货币市场为自主AI智能体提供了天然测试平台，因为它们是数字原生、高频且机器速度的环境，然而现有方法常常难以应对非平稳市场状态、不透明决策和固定聚合规则。在本文中，我们提出Agent4Crypto，一个双反思且与市场反馈对齐的多智能体系统。该框架协调用于数据收集、分析、风险评估、反思和交易的专门智能体，在可解释的决策流程中综合来自价格、指标、新闻和图表的异构信号。我们的核心设计是以交易者为中心的决策机制：三个风格特定的交易者智能体——激进型、中性型和保守型——从相同市场上下文生成候选动作和自然语言理由，而它们的影响力是学习得到的而非人工固定。基于PPO的门控策略通过双反思反馈过程动态分配交易者权重。一个反思流根据已实现组合结果评估交易后决策质量，并将可复用经验提炼到Financial ReasoningBank中，以便在后续交易者提示中检索；另一个反思流估计交易者层面的反事实贡献，指示哪种风格最近与市场走势更一致。PPO状态结合反事实贡献记忆与市场特征、先前的交易者权重和当前交易者动作，因此交易者影响力在牛市、震荡市和熊市中自适应。在BTC、ETH和XRP上的实验表明，Agent4Crypto在总回报和夏普比率上优于传统策略、机器学习和强化学习基线以及现有基于LLM的交易系统，证明了可解释交易者竞争和市场反馈驱动适应在波动性加密货币市场中的价值。

items.title_en: AutoVLA-D: Learn a Trajectory-Geometric Condition from Reasoning for Autonomous Driving VLA
items.title_zh: AutoVLA-D：为自动驾驶VLA从推理中学习轨迹几何条件
items.abstract_en: Autoregressive VLA planning usually predicts continuous trajectories as the final output, but driving instructions often describe actions rather than ego states, which weakens direct conditioning on the final continuous trajectory. We address this gap with TrajCond, which introduces a discrete trajectory-geometric condition for VLA planning. Specifically, we represent TrajCond as a 1D-Brohan differential action trajectory and learn it with a two-stage training framework before final continuous trajectory prediction. With the simultaneous autoregressive generation of discrete and numeric trajectories, we name our method AutoVLA-D (Double). Experiments on NAVSIM navtest, nuScenes, and NeuroNCAP show that discrete trajectories are weaker as direct outputs but more effective as TrajCond, consistently improving final continuous trajectory prediction across closed-loop and open-loop driving benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D.
items.abstract_zh: 自回归VLA规划通常将连续轨迹作为最终输出进行预测，但驾驶指令通常描述动作而非自车状态，这削弱了对最终连续轨迹的直接条件作用。我们用TrajCond弥补这一空白，它为VLA规划引入离散轨迹几何条件。具体而言，我们将TrajCond表示为一维Brohan差分动作轨迹，并在最终连续轨迹预测之前用两阶段训练框架学习它。由于同时自回归生成离散轨迹和数值轨迹，我们将方法命名为AutoVLA-D（Double）。在NAVSIM navtest、nuScenes和NeuroNCAP上的实验表明，离散轨迹作为直接输出较弱，但作为TrajCond更有效，在闭环和开环驾驶基准上持续改善最终连续轨迹预测。代码见https://github.com/ShivaTeam/AutoVLA-D。

items.title_en: 2D Gum-Net: Unsupervised Dense Elastic Image Registration via Symmetric Correlation and Spectral Pooling
items.title_zh: 2D Gum-Net：通过对称相关和谱池化的无监督稠密弹性图像配准
items.abstract_en: Dense non-rigid registration, the recovery of a pixel-wise deformation field that warps one image into geometric agreement with another, is fundamental across medical imaging, structural biology, and correspondence estimation, yet learning-based approaches face a severe bottleneck: ground-truth deformation fields are notoriously difficult to obtain for real data. We present 2D Gum-Net, an end-to-end architecture that predicts dense elastic deformation fields fully unsupervised. We transfer the Geometric Unsupervised Matching Network (Gum-Net), originally developed for 3D subtomogram alignment in cryo-electron tomography, to 2D elastic registration: all three modules are redesigned in 2D, and the rigid transformation head is replaced by a Dense Spatial Transformer that regresses a sparse control-point grid, lifted to a full-resolution field $Φ$ by bicubic interpolation. Downsampling uses DCT spectral pooling, implemented as frozen-basis matrix multiplications ($\approx 50\times$ GPU speedup), preserving the fine, quasi-periodic structure that max and average pooling destroy. We evaluate on contact-based fingerprints, a challenging testbed for this task: locally self-similar ridge patterns make correspondence maximally ambiguous, skin pressed against a sensor generates authentic large-displacement elastic distortion, and minutiae act as precise landmarks through which an independent matcher externally verifies the topological correctness of predicted fields. Trained purely on synthetic impressions and evaluated zero-shot on real benchmarks, our method improves structural correlation by up to 15.7% on FVC2004 and raises genuine match scores under an independent matcher while leaving imposter scores essentially unchanged. This suggests that the predicted deformations restore true structure without fabricating correspondences.
items.abstract_zh: 稠密非刚性配准——恢复逐像素变形场，使一幅图像变形到与另一幅图像在几何上一致——是医学成像、结构生物学和对应估计中的基础问题，然而基于学习的方法面临严重瓶颈：真实数据的地面真值变形场极难获得。我们提出2D Gum-Net，一种完全无监督地预测稠密弹性变形场的端到端架构。我们将最初为冷冻电子断层扫描中的3D亚断层图对齐开发的几何无监督匹配网络（Gum-Net）迁移到2D弹性配准：所有三个模块均在2D中重新设计，刚性变换头被替换为稠密空间变换器，该变换器回归稀疏控制点网格，并通过双三次插值提升为全分辨率场Φ。下采样使用DCT谱池化，实现为冻结基矩阵乘法（约50倍GPU加速），保留最大池化和平均池化会破坏的精细准周期结构。我们在基于接触的指纹上评估，这是该任务的一个具有挑战性的测试平台：局部自相似脊线模式使对应最大程度歧义，皮肤压在传感器上产生真实的大位移弹性畸变，细节点作为精确标志点，通过独立匹配器外部验证预测场的拓扑正确性。仅用合成印记训练并在真实基准上零样本评估，我们的方法在FVC2004上将结构相关性提高最多15.7%，并在独立匹配器下提高真实匹配分数，同时使冒名分数基本不变。这表明预测的变形恢复了真实结构而没有捏造对应关系。

items.title_en: Accelerometry-Derived REM Sleep Behavior Disorder Score Is Associated with Incident Parkinson's Disease in the UK Biobank
items.title_zh: 加速度计衍生的REM睡眠行为障碍评分与英国生物银行中的新发帕金森病相关
items.abstract_en: Estimating Parkinson's disease (PD) risk years before diagnosis remains an unmet need. We applied a validated machine learning classifier for REM sleep behavior disorder (RBD) detection to 7-day wrist accelerometry data in 87,975 UK Biobank participants followed for 10 years. Participants in the highest RBD risk stratum (>99th percentile) had an approximately fivefold increased hazard of incident PD compared with the lowest-risk group (0-90th percentile), with a dose-dependent relationship across the full score distribution. Among non-converters, higher RBD-classifier scores were associated with baseline cognitive deficits and greater burden of autonomic and psychiatric prodromal features. The association with incident PD remained independent of PD polygenic risk score, while RBD-classifier score and genetic risk were synergistic. The combined high-risk group achieved a positive likelihood ratio of 7.91, approximately threefold higher than questionnaire-based RBD screening. At this High-risk threshold over the 10-year horizon, the classifier showed a sensitivity of 7.4%, specificity of 99.2%, positive predictive value of 7.5%, and negative predictive value of 99.2% for incident PD (N=50,816). These findings support wrist accelerometry as a scalable, high-specificity approach for prodromal PD risk enrichment.
items.abstract_zh: 在诊断前数年估计帕金森病（PD）风险仍是一个未满足的需求。我们将一种经过验证的用于检测REM睡眠行为障碍（RBD）的机器学习分类器应用于87,975名英国生物银行参与者的7天腕部加速度计数据，随访10年。处于最高RBD风险层（>第99百分位数）的参与者与最低风险组（第0-90百分位数）相比，新发PD的风险约增加五倍，且在整个评分分布上呈剂量依赖关系。在未转化者中，较高的RBD分类器评分与基线认知缺陷以及自主神经和精神前驱特征的更大负担相关。与新发PD的关联独立于PD多基因风险评分，而RBD分类器评分和遗传风险具有协同作用。联合高风险组的阳性似然比为7.91，约为基于问卷的RBD筛查的三倍。在10年时间范围内的这一高风险阈值下，该分类器对新发PD的敏感性为7.4%，特异性为99.2%，阳性预测值为7.5%，阴性预测值为99.2%（N=50,816）。这些发现支持腕部加速度计作为一种可扩展、高特异性的方法，用于前驱期PD风险富集。

items.title_en: Neutral-atom quantum features as complementary structural encodings for graph learning
items.title_zh: 中性原子量子特征作为图学习的互补结构编码
items.abstract_en: Structural descriptors provide graph neural networks (GNNs) with positional and topological inductive biases. However, widely used classical encodings based on random walks or Laplacian spectra emphasize specific structural statistics of a graph, leaving room for alternative descriptors. Neutral-atom quantum processing units (QPUs) can realize graph-dependent Rydberg Hamiltonians, allowing graph topology to be probed through dynamical correlation measurements. In this work, we use these measurements as quantum graph features (QGFs), providing a complementary, hardware-derived family of structural encoding that is not accurately described by classical features derived from Laplacian and adjacency matrices, even when supplemented with an extended set of random-walk, geometric descriptors and classical physical models. By appropriately selecting the quench parameters of the Hamiltonian, we access two characteristic correlation regimes with distinct structural signatures: antiferromagnetic-like and ferromagnetic-like. On an intrinsic information benchmark of 15 topological and spectral probing tasks, quantum and hybrid quantum-classical features match or surpass classical descriptors on local topological properties. When supplied to message-passing, attention, and graph-transformer backbones, hybrid quantum-classical features yield improvements that are within cross-fold noise on most cells but sign-consistent across architectures. When comparing noiseless, shot-sampled emulation-derived quantum features with a neutral-atom QPU implementation, the downstream hybrid results with compressed hardware features match their emulated counterparts within $0.01$ F$_1$ on all backbones. On a synthetic family of ladder graphs, QGFs distinguish two specific classes, outperforming the strongest classical structural descriptors by a margin exceeding cross-fold variability.
items.abstract_zh: 结构描述符为图神经网络（GNN）提供位置和拓扑归纳偏置。然而，基于随机游走或拉普拉斯谱的广泛使用的经典编码强调图的特定结构统计量，为替代描述符留下了空间。中性原子量子处理单元（QPU）可以实现依赖于图的里德伯哈密顿量，从而允许通过动力学关联测量来探测图拓扑。在这项工作中，我们将这些测量用作量子图特征（QGF），提供了一类互补的、由硬件导出的结构编码；即使补充扩展的随机游走、几何描述符和经典物理模型，这些特征也无法由从拉普拉斯矩阵和邻接矩阵导出的经典特征准确描述。通过适当选择哈密顿量的淬火参数，我们获得两个具有不同结构特征的相关区域：类反铁磁和类铁磁。在包含 15 个拓扑和谱探测任务的内禀信息基准上，量子和混合量子-经典特征在局部拓扑性质上匹配或超过经典描述符。当提供给消息传递、注意力和图 Transformer 骨干网络时，混合量子-经典特征带来的改进在大多数单元格上处于交叉折噪声范围内，但在不同架构间符号一致。在将无噪声、散粒采样仿真导出的量子特征与中性原子 QPU 实现进行比较时，使用压缩硬件特征的下游混合结果在所有骨干网络上与仿真对应结果的 F$_1$ 差距在 $0.01$ 以内。在一组合成的梯形图族上，QGF 能区分两个特定类别，以超过交叉折变异性的幅度优于最强的经典结构描述符。

items.title_en: Certify, Report, or Refuse: Harm-Constrained Conformal Prediction for Clinical Actions
items.title_zh: 认证、报告或拒绝：面向临床动作的危害约束共形预测
items.abstract_en: Routing a melanoma case to routine follow-up is a serious action error that diagnostic coverage alone does not rule out. We present Harm-Constrained Risk-Optimal Conformal Prediction (HC-ROCP), a training-free framework that uses frozen classifier probabilities and adds a harm penalty when choosing prediction sets and actions. We test the resulting policies on disjoint calibration splits with multiplicity adjustment. HC-ROCP certifies supported claims, reports descriptive fallback policies, and refuses unsupported subgroup claims. We evaluate these outputs retrospectively on COVID-19 radiographs, ISIC 2019 dermoscopy, and EyePACS-to-APTOS retinopathy transfer. Across ten calibration seeds, HC-ROCP reduces COVID-19 severe-action errors from the exact risk-optimal baseline's 4.68\% to 0.54\%. At a 5\% budget, global claims are certified for COVID-19 and ISIC, but the rare squamous-cell-carcinoma claim is refused. At 1\%, all settings receive descriptive reports. For each budget, we also report the minimum severe-case count needed to pass the global harm gate with zero errors, providing a starting point for further data collection.
items.abstract_zh: 将黑色素瘤病例分诊为常规随访是一种严重的动作错误，仅靠诊断覆盖率并不能排除。我们提出危害约束风险最优共形预测（HC-ROCP），一个无需训练的框架，使用冻结的分类器概率，并在选择预测集和动作时加入危害惩罚。我们在不相交的校准划分上测试所得策略，并进行多重性调整。HC-ROCP认证有支持的声明，报告描述性回退策略，并拒绝无支持的亚组声明。我们在COVID-19放射影像、ISIC 2019皮肤镜和EyePACS到APTOS视网膜病变迁移上回顾性评估这些输出。在十个校准种子中，HC-ROCP将COVID-19严重动作错误从精确风险最优基线的4.68%降低到0.54%。在5%预算下，COVID-19和ISIC的全局声明被认证，但罕见的鳞状细胞癌声明被拒绝。在1%下，所有设置均获得描述性报告。对于每个预算，我们还报告以零错误通过全局危害门所需的最少严重病例数，为进一步数据收集提供起点。

items.title_en: The Deception Archive as a repository of standardized datasets for large-scale verbal deception detection research
items.title_zh: Deception Archive：作为大规模言语欺骗检测研究标准化数据集存储库
items.abstract_en: Computational advances in natural language processing and machine learning have substantially expanded the use of automated approaches in verbal deception research. However, existing verbal deception datasets remain fragmented across disciplines, as they are often difficult to identify, access, and reuse, limiting cross-study comparisons and the development of robust computational models. We present the Deception Archive, a curated and standardized repository of publicly available verbal deception datasets built upon a large-scale systematic review. Eligible datasets were retrieved, manually inspected, and standardized following a structured data curation workflow. The current repository comprises 41 publicly available datasets containing 387,995 truthful or deceptive statements. The archive represents a heterogeneous repository (e.g., in data size, topic of investigation, ground-truth, etc.) and a living resource for integrating newly available deception datasets over time. By providing centralized access to standardized datasets and accompanying metadata, the Deception Archive facilitates dataset discovery, cross-dataset validation, and reproducible evaluation of computational models.
items.abstract_zh: 自然语言处理和机器学习的计算进展大幅扩展了自动化方法在言语欺骗研究中的应用。然而，现有的言语欺骗数据集仍分散于各学科，往往难以识别、获取和重用，限制了跨研究比较和稳健计算模型的开发。我们提出 Deception Archive，这是一个基于大规模系统综述构建的、经过整理和标准化的公开可用言语欺骗数据集存储库。符合条件的数据集经检索、人工检查，并按照结构化数据整理工作流程进行标准化。当前存储库包含 41 个公开可用数据集，涵盖 387,995 条真实或欺骗性陈述。该存档是一个异质性存储库（例如在数据规模、研究主题、真实标签等方面），也是一个随时间整合新可用欺骗数据集的活资源。通过提供对标准化数据集及配套元数据的集中访问，Deception Archive 促进了数据集发现、跨数据集验证以及计算模型的可复现评估。

items.title_en: Graph-Based RL for Sequential Rendezvous Planning with Multiple Patrolling USVs
items.title_zh: 基于图的强化学习用于多艘巡逻无人水面艇的序贯会合规划
items.abstract_en: In patrol missions involving multiple unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), a designated command USV can support fleet management by sequentially rendezvousing with each patrolling USV. These operations require motion-feasible route planning and priority-aware rendezvous sequencing, with the objective of minimizing mission completion time and total tardiness relative to priority-dependent due dates. We propose a framework combining grid-based path planning, surrogate travel-time prediction, and graph-based reinforcement learning. The path planner accounts for ocean currents and approximates turn-rate constraints through multi-stage maneuvers, with path feasibility empirically validated through trajectory-tracking simulations. For rendezvous sequencing, a Feasible Transition Graph (FTG) represents candidate rendezvous events and temporally feasible transitions, enabling a graph neural network to exploit spatiotemporal rendezvous relationships for policy learning. A surrogate predicts travel times from compact current and motion features to avoid repeated path searches during FTG construction and policy training. Evaluation using grid-based path planning shows statistically significant average objective reductions of 10.5%, 3.5%, and 1.5% compared with greedy, MLP-RL, and 2-step lookahead greedy, respectively. The policy achieves these improvements while requiring approximately 1/35 of the latter's computation time. It maintains its advantage over MLP-RL under unseen priority-tier settings, with larger gains as fleet size increases.
items.abstract_zh: 在涉及多艘无人水面艇（USV）的巡逻任务中，指定的指挥 USV 可通过依次与每艘巡逻 USV 会合来支持船队管理。这些操作需要运动可行的路线规划和优先级感知的会合排序，目标是最小化任务完成时间以及相对于依赖优先级的截止时间的总延迟。我们提出一个结合基于网格的路径规划、代理旅行时间预测和基于图的强化学习的框架。路径规划器考虑洋流，并通过多阶段机动近似转向率约束，路径可行性通过轨迹跟踪仿真进行经验验证。对于会合排序，可行转移图（FTG）表示候选会合事件和时间上可行的转移，使图神经网络能够利用时空会合关系进行策略学习。代理模型从紧凑的洋流和运动特征预测旅行时间，以避免在 FTG 构建和策略训练期间重复进行路径搜索。使用基于网格的路径规划的评估显示，与贪心、MLP-RL 和 2 步前瞻贪心相比，平均目标分别统计显著降低 10.5%、3.5% 和 1.5%。该策略在取得这些改进的同时，所需计算时间约为后者的 1/35。在未见的优先级层级设置下，它保持相对于 MLP-RL 的优势，且随着船队规模增大收益更大。

items.title_en: Differentiable Inverse Rendering Recovers Intrinsic Properties from Intravascular Optical Coherence Tomography
items.title_zh: 可微逆渲染从血管内光学相干断层扫描中恢复内在特性
items.abstract_en: Medical images encode intrinsic tissue properties that indicate disease progression, yet these properties remain entangled with the system-dependent physics of image formation. Differentiable inverse rendering asks whether they are recoverable by inverting the imaging system's forward physics rather than through post-hoc correction. We address this in optical coherence tomography (OCT), focusing on the optical attenuation coefficient, a per-pixel marker of pathology and cellular composition. Conventional recovery relies on closed-form inversions limited to simplified light-tissue models, or learned methods coupled to specific imaging configurations. We instead recover per-pixel attenuation from a single OCT image by gradient descent through a differentiable physics-based forward model. We verified the method against analytical solutions, validated it on five in vitro phantoms, and applied it without modification to 29{,}269 clinical intravascular OCT images from 128 patients. The inversion needs no training data or segmentations and is portable across platforms and retrospective archives. Replacing the forward model or recovering another optical parameter leaves the optimization procedure unchanged. We demonstrate per-pixel recovery is tractable because gradient information scales to this high-dimensional problem, where gradient-free methods become intractable. Our work supports quantitative tissue characterization from OCT images and provides a framework for extension across imaging modalities and organ systems.
items.abstract_zh: 医学图像编码了指示疾病进展的组织内在特性，然而这些特性仍与成像形成中依赖系统的物理过程纠缠在一起。可微逆渲染提出的问题是：能否通过反演成像系统的正向物理过程，而非通过事后校正来恢复这些特性。我们在光学相干断层扫描（OCT）中处理这一问题，重点关注光学衰减系数——一种反映病理和细胞组成的逐像素标志物。传统恢复依赖于仅限于简化光-组织模型的闭式反演，或与特定成像配置耦合的学习方法。我们转而通过可微的基于物理的正向模型进行梯度下降，从单张 OCT 图像中恢复逐像素衰减。我们对照解析解验证了该方法，在五个体外体模上进行了验证，并将其未经修改地应用于来自 128 名患者的 29,269 张临床血管内 OCT 图像。该反演不需要训练数据或分割，并且可跨平台和回顾性档案移植。替换正向模型或恢复另一个光学参数不会改变优化过程。我们证明逐像素恢复是可行的，因为梯度信息可扩展到这一高维问题，而无梯度方法在此变得难以处理。我们的工作支持从 OCT 图像进行定量组织表征，并提供了一个可扩展到其他成像模态和器官系统的框架。

items.title_en: PRISM: probabilistic cell-type resolution with integrated spatial modelling for simultaneous ambient RNA decontamination and doublet correction in spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: PRISM：集成空间建模的概率细胞类型解析，用于空间转录组学中同时进行环境 RNA 去污染与双细胞校正
items.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics count matrices are confounded by ambient RNA contamination and cell-segmentation doublets, two artifacts that co-occur but are rarely modelled jointly. We present PRISM, an Expectation-Maximization framework that simultaneously (i) assigns each cell a probabilistic cell-type identity, (ii) detects doublets via log-likelihood ratio testing of two-component mixtures, and (iii) estimates a per-cell contamination fraction anchored to a spatially resolved ambient profile. In an in silico benchmark of 40,800 simulated cells, PRISM recovers with Pearson r=1.000 across all contamination levels (0.05 to 0.50) and UMI depths (500 to 5,000), with zero doublet false positives and 100% singlet accuracy. Applied to a Visium HD mouse cerebellum dataset (four samples, 125,289 cells, 17 reference types) from a metachromatic leukodystrophy (MLD) model, PRISM identifies a median =0.60, flags 67.4% doublets (driven by the densely packed cerebellar granule layer), eliminates spurious myelin signal from microglia (0.82% to 0.00%), and doubles oligodendrocyte myelin purity (2.8% to 5.6%). PRISM runs on commodity CPUs in under 15 minutes and returns decontaminated integer count matrices for every measured gene.
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组计数矩阵受到环境 RNA 污染和细胞分割双细胞（doublets）混杂，这两种伪影同时发生但很少被联合建模。我们提出 PRISM，一种期望最大化框架，同时 (i) 为每个细胞分配概率性细胞类型身份，(ii) 通过双组分混合的对数似然比检验检测双细胞，(iii) 估计以空间解析的环境谱为锚定的每个细胞污染比例。在 40,800 个模拟细胞的计算机基准中，PRISM 在所有污染水平（0.05 至 0.50）和 UMI 深度（500 至 5,000）下以 Pearson r=1.000 恢复，双细胞假阳性为零，单细胞准确率为 100%。应用于来自异染性脑白质营养不良 (MLD) 模型的 Visium HD 小鼠小脑数据集（四个样本、125,289 个细胞、17 种参考类型），PRISM 识别出中位数 = 0.60，标记 67.4% 的双细胞（由密集排列的小脑颗粒层驱动），消除小胶质细胞的虚假髓鞘信号（0.82% 至 0.00%），并将少突胶质细胞髓鞘纯度提高一倍（2.8% 至 5.6%）。PRISM 在普通 CPU 上运行时间不到 15 分钟，并为每个测量基因返回去污染后的整数计数矩阵。

items.title_en: A Passive Intelligent Metasurface: A Network Model
items.title_zh: 无源智能超表面：一种网络模型
items.abstract_en: Intelligent metasurfaces enable advanced wave manipulation, including negative refraction, focusing, beam splitting and beam steering, with significant potential for practical applications. However, conventional approaches often rely on active metamaterials with gain, or demand computationally intensive solutions of inverse problems to find the optimal configuration. In this work, we use the scattering framework of quantum graph theory to derive an exact, analytic expression for configuration of a passive metasurface that produces a prescribed reflected wave field. The metasurface terminates a periodic lattice of waveguides and consists of an array of channels, each a tube of length $\ell_m$ ending in a vertex whose scattering parameter $λ_m$ sets how much of the wave is lost to the wall. For any prescribed incident and reflected field, the exact lengths and scattering parameters follow channel by channel, in closed form, from the ratio of the wave amplitudes returning to and leaving the lattice, and the metasurface is passive whenever this ratio does not exceed unity in modulus. We demonstrate the construction for both a one-dimensional and a two-dimensional metasurface. The one-dimensional metasurface terminates a two-dimensional lattice and steers, splits or perfectly absorbs Gaussian beams. The two-dimensional metasurface terminates a three-dimensional lattice and generates a prescribed image in a plane inside the lattice. In each case, we obtain the exact boundary properties that produce the effect.
items.abstract_zh: 智能超表面可实现先进的波操控，包括负折射、聚焦、分束和波束偏转，具有重要的实际应用潜力。然而，传统方法通常依赖具有增益的有源超材料，或需要计算密集的逆问题求解来寻找最优配置。在本工作中，我们使用量子图论的散射框架，推导出可产生指定反射波场的无源超表面配置的精确解析表达式。该超表面端接波导的周期晶格，并由通道阵列组成，每个通道是一根长度为 ℓ_m 的管，末端为一个顶点，其散射参数 λ_m 决定有多少波损失到壁。对于任意指定的入射场和反射场，精确的长度和散射参数可逐通道地以闭式形式由返回晶格与离开晶格的波幅之比得到，且只要该比的模不超过 1，超表面即为无源。我们展示了一维和二维超表面的构造。一维超表面端接二维晶格，并对高斯光束进行偏转、分束或完美吸收。二维超表面端接三维晶格，并在晶格内部的平面上生成指定图像。在每种情况下，我们都获得了产生该效应的精确边界属性。

items.title_en: VNA-Only Calibration of Waveguide Thermistor Mounts with Self-Consistent Determination of the Thermistor-Port Impedance
items.title_zh: 仅使用 VNA 的波导热敏电阻座校准及热敏电阻端口阻抗的自洽确定
items.abstract_en: A method is presented for determining the calibration factor and the effective efficiency of waveguide thermistor mounts from vector-network-analyzer reflection data alone, without a microcalorimeter, extending the three reflection-coefficient method of the coaxial case. In waveguide the thermistor is coupled to the line through a matching structure and the reference impedance of the thermistor port, $Z_0$, is not known a priori; it is inferred through a power-consistency relation between pairs of states, under the convention that it is real. The method reproduces the factory certificates (U = 2 %) of four K486A mounts within 1.0 % rms and the PTB-traceable values (U = 0.85 to 0.98 %) of a fifth within 0.34 % rms; its expanded measurement uncertainty is 0.5 to 1.16 % (k = 2) for the best specimen and below 2 % for the five. A mount with its waveguide-to-coaxial adapter is calibrated directly, without characterizing the adapter, from the model factor of the mount and the geometric factor measured through the adapter. The scattering matrix implied by the solution is not passive; a minimum-norm correction of the thermistor impedances along the two directions invisible to the calibration factor - the ratios of the efficiencies of the three states - brings it to the floor of passivity, where the efficiency depends on the load only through its mismatch factor, leaves the result unchanged, and gives the sensitivity of the efficiency to the bias resistance in closed form: below $4\times10^{-5}$ $Ω^{-1}$ in band mean, proportional to the mismatch of the operating state and to the loss of the mount.
items.abstract_zh: 提出一种仅根据矢量网络分析仪反射数据确定波导热敏电阻座的校准因子和有效效率的方法，无需微量热计，扩展了同轴情形下的三反射系数法。在波导中，热敏电阻通过匹配结构与线路耦合，热敏电阻端口的参考阻抗 Z_0 并非先验已知；在假定其为实数的约定下，通过成对状态之间的功率一致性关系推断得到。该方法在 1.0 % rms 以内复现四个 K486A 座的出厂证书值（U = 2 %），并在 0.34 % rms 以内复现第五个座的可溯源至 PTB 的值（U = 0.85 至 0.98 %）；对于最佳样本，其扩展测量不确定度为 0.5 至 1.16 %（k = 2），五个样本均低于 2 %。对于带有波导-同轴适配器的座，可直接校准，无需表征适配器，只需使用座的模型因子和通过适配器测得的几何因子。该解所隐含的散射矩阵不是无源的；沿校准因子不可见的两个方向（三个状态效率之比）对热敏电阻阻抗进行最小范数校正，使其达到无源性下限；此时效率仅通过失配因子依赖于负载，结果保持不变，并以闭式形式给出效率对偏置电阻的灵敏度：带内平均低于 4×10^{-5} Ω^{-1}，且与工作状态的失配和座的损耗成正比。

items.title_en: Blind Variation, Selective Retention: Improving Creative Idea Generation in AI Scientists
items.title_zh: 盲变异与选择性保留：改进 AI 科学家的创造性想法生成
items.abstract_en: Scientific discovery requires ideas that are original, useful, and non-obvious. Yet AI scientists are typically given as much task information as possible during idea generation, which can anchor generation toward familiar approaches. Inspired by the cognitive framework of Blind Variation and Selective Retention (BVSR), we propose a discovery framework that separates these two roles of information: it generates proposals under deliberately limited task information to broaden exploration, then learns from proposals previously verified on the same task and their outcomes to retain promising candidates for costly empirical evaluation. We evaluate BVSR across five proposer models and 12 scientific tasks. Limiting task information substantially increases proposal originality and non-obviousness, and produces a larger share of highly creative and high-utility proposals than existing state-of-the-art prompting-based baselines. Learning from prior proposal outcomes on the task further improves candidate selection, discarding half of the candidates while retaining most top-performing proposals. When incorporated into existing AI-scientist workflows, BVSR achieves stronger discoveries across gene expression analysis, drug response prediction, anomaly detection, scaling law discovery, and brain activity prediction. These results suggest that effective AI scientists should use information differently across stages of discovery: constrain task-specific information during exploration while exploiting accumulated empirical experience on the task.
items.abstract_zh: 科学发现需要具有原创性、有用且非显而易见的想法。然而，AI 科学家在想法生成过程中通常被给予尽可能多的任务信息，这可能使生成锚定于熟悉的方法。受盲变异与选择性保留（BVSR）认知框架启发，我们提出一个发现框架，将信息的这两种作用分离：在有意限制任务信息的条件下生成提案以拓宽探索，然后从同一任务上先前验证过的提案及其结果中学习，以保留有前景的候选方案用于昂贵的实证评估。我们在五个提案者模型和 12 个科学任务上评估 BVSR。限制任务信息大幅提高了提案的原创性和非显而易见性，并比现有最先进的基于提示的基线产生更大比例的高创造性和高效用提案。从任务上先前提案结果中学习进一步改善了候选选择，丢弃一半候选方案的同时保留大多数表现最佳的提案。当纳入现有 AI 科学家工作流程时，BVSR 在基因表达分析、药物反应预测、异常检测、缩放定律发现和大脑活动预测中取得更强的发现。这些结果表明，有效的 AI 科学家应在发现的不同阶段以不同方式使用信息：在探索期间约束任务特定信息，同时利用该任务上积累的经验。

items.title_en: Co-Creating Neurorehabilitation Technology Alongside Lived Experience Experts: A Participatory Design Workshop
items.title_zh: 与生活经验专家共同创建神经康复技术：一项参与式设计工作坊
items.abstract_en: Involving patients' lived experience (LE) early in neurorehabilitation technology design can improve the relevance and effectiveness of solutions, yet LE experts are often involved only when finished prototypes are tested. We present and evaluate a participatory design (PD) workshop for early LE involvement, examine how LE contributions influence design processes and outcomes, and provide recommendations for similar approaches. We conducted a PD workshop at the 6th International Conference on NeuroRehabilitation. Five people who have had a stroke (LE experts) and 18 workshop attendees (including the LE experts' caregivers) were organized into five groups. Following the Discover, Define, and Develop phases of the Double Diamond model, each group used Journey Maps and Data Collection Notebooks to co-create a solution for an objective specified by an LE expert. Journey Maps were thematically analyzed, and group audio transcripts underwent structured extraction using a large language model. LE input shifted discussions from discipline-based assumptions toward priorities grounded in lived experience, including fear, confidence, sensory discomfort, fatigue, aesthetics, and independence. Narrow objectives, such as opening a blister pack, produced task-specific solutions, whereas broader objectives generated device concepts, including sensory feedback for cycling and a stimulation-equipped cooking splint. Satisfaction was high among attendees and LE experts. All workshop tools and protocols are shared to support adoption. The workshop offers a practical foundation for involving LE experts early in neurorehabilitation technology development. Future iterations should better capture psychological and social dimensions, allow more reflection, and include the full range of relevant stakeholders through sustained transdisciplinary engagement between researchers and the LE community.
items.abstract_zh: 在神经康复技术设计的早期纳入患者的生活经验（LE）可以提高解决方案的相关性和有效性，然而 LE 专家往往只在成品原型测试时才被纳入。我们展示并评估了一个用于早期纳入 LE 的参与式设计（PD）工作坊，考察 LE 的贡献如何影响设计过程和结果，并为类似方法提供建议。我们在第六届国际神经康复会议上举办了一个 PD 工作坊。五名曾患卒中者（LE 专家）和 18 名工作坊参与者（包括 LE 专家的照护者）被组织成五个小组。遵循双钻模型的发现、定义和开发阶段，每组使用旅程地图和数据收集笔记本，针对 LE 专家指定的目标共同创建解决方案。对旅程地图进行了主题分析，并使用大语言模型对小组音频转录进行结构化提取。LE 的输入将讨论从基于学科的假设转向以生活经验为基础的优先事项，包括恐惧、信心、感觉不适、疲劳、美学和独立性。狭窄的目标（例如打开泡罩包装）产生了任务特定的解决方案，而更广泛的目标产生了设备概念，包括骑行中的感觉反馈和配备刺激的烹饪支具。参与者和 LE 专家的满意度很高。所有工作坊工具和协议均已共享以支持采用。该工作坊为在神经康复技术开发早期纳入 LE 专家提供了实践基础。未来的迭代应更好地捕捉心理和社会维度，允许更多反思，并通过研究人员与 LE 社区之间持续的跨学科参与纳入全部相关利益相关者。
