items.title_en: Multi-Node Transformers for Object Detection and Captioning Across Distributed Edge Networks
items.title_zh: 用于分布式边缘网络目标检测与区域描述的多节点Transformer
items.abstract_en: This paper presents a unified transformer-based framework for object detection and dense region captioning across distributed edge networks. The architecture uses a shared visual encoder followed by detection, region extraction, and autoregressive language-decoding stages, allowing localization and region description to reuse the same image features. This design removes the second image-encoding path required by decoupled detection and captioning pipelines. To support execution on resource-limited devices, a workload-allocation formulation assigns model stages and input streams across connected edge nodes while accounting for execution time, memory capacity, processor utilization, power limits, and intermediate tensor transfer cost. The framework is evaluated on a six-device edge testbed comprising four NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano and Orin NX inference nodes and two Raspberry Pi 5 auxiliary CPU nodes, with TensorRT FP16 and INT8 execution on the NVIDIA devices. On a Jetson Orin Nano, the unified INT8 model achieves 38.1 FPS with 3.5 GB peak memory use and 11.8 W measured power. Under four concurrent streams, the proposed allocation achieves 35.2 FPS and 28.4 ms mean end-to-end latency with an internode transfer rate of 6.8 MB/s.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个统一的基于Transformer的框架，用于跨分布式边缘网络的目标检测与密集区域描述。该架构使用共享视觉编码器，随后是检测、区域提取和自回归语言解码阶段，使定位和区域描述能够复用相同的图像特征。该设计去除了解耦的检测与描述流水线所需的第二条图像编码路径。为支持在资源受限设备上执行，一种工作负载分配公式将模型阶段和输入流分配到相连的边缘节点，同时考虑执行时间、内存容量、处理器利用率、功耗限制和中间张量传输成本。该框架在由四个NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano和Orin NX推理节点以及两个Raspberry Pi 5辅助CPU节点组成的六设备边缘测试床上评估，并在NVIDIA设备上采用TensorRT FP16和INT8执行。在Jetson Orin Nano上，统一的INT8模型达到38.1 FPS，峰值内存使用3.5 GB，测得功耗11.8 W。在四个并发流下，所提出的分配达到35.2 FPS和28.4 ms平均端到端延迟，节点间传输速率为6.8 MB/s。

items.title_en: Implementing a Group Education Model for People with Type 2 Diabetes in a Socioeconomically Deprived Primary Care Population: A Quality Improvement Report
items.title_zh: 在社会经济弱势初级保健人群中实施2型糖尿病群体教育模式：一项质量改进报告
items.abstract_en: People with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) receiving injectable therapies require ongoing education and support to optimise self-management and glycaemic control. Group education may offer a cost-effective approach that combines professional guidance with peer support. Homewell Practice serves a socioeconomically deprived population in Hampshire with significant health inequalities. Many patients receiving insulin or GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy had poor glycaemic control, frailty, or increased risk of hospital admission. Traditional one-to-one consultations provided limited opportunities for peer learning and support. A 12-month quality improvement project was conducted between May 2022 and April 2023. Adults with T2DM receiving injectable therapy were invited to attend monthly community-based education sessions. Attendance data, HbA1c outcomes and patient feedback were collected and analysed descriptively. Patient-centred group sessions were delivered using adult-learning principles and peer discussion. Topics included insulin titration, hypoglycaemia management, nutrition, glycaemic targets and diabetes complications. Fifteen patients attended at least one session. Improvements in glycaemic control were associated with repeated attendance. Mean HbA1c reduction was 12.4% in patients attending four or more sessions, compared with 5.6% for those attending three sessions and 2.4% for those attending two sessions. Patients attending only one session demonstrated a 1.8% increase in HbA1c. All questionnaire respondents (9/9, 100%) reported improved understanding of diabetes and found the sessions useful; 8/9 would recommend the programme. Peer support was identified as the most valued aspect of participation. Attendance remained lower than anticipated, particularly among patients with multiple comorbidities and mental health needs. Group education for adults receiving injectable diabetes therapy was associated with high patient satisfaction and improved glycaemic outcomes among regular attendees. A hybrid model combining group education with individualised support may improve accessibility and engagement for higher-need patients.
items.abstract_zh: 接受注射治疗的2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者需要持续教育和支持，以优化自我管理和血糖控制。群体教育可能提供一种将专业指导与同伴支持相结合的成本效益较高的方法。Homewell Practice服务于汉普郡一个社会经济贫困人群，该人群存在显著健康不平等。许多接受胰岛素或GLP-1受体激动剂治疗的患者血糖控制不佳、存在衰弱或住院风险增加。传统一对一咨询提供的同伴学习和支持机会有限。2022年5月至2023年4月开展了一项为期12个月的质量改进项目。接受注射治疗的T2DM成人被邀请参加每月一次社区教育课程。收集出勤数据、HbA1c结局和患者反馈并进行描述性分析。以患者为中心的团体课程采用成人学习原则和同伴讨论。主题包括胰岛素剂量调整、低血糖管理、营养、血糖目标和糖尿病并发症。15名患者至少参加了一次课程。血糖控制的改善与重复参加相关。参加四次或以上课程的患者平均HbA1c降低12.4%，而参加三次课程者为5.6%，参加两次课程者为2.4%。仅参加一次课程的患者HbA1c增加1.8%。所有问卷受访者（9/9，100%）报告对糖尿病的理解有所改善并认为课程有用；8/9会推荐该计划。同伴支持被认定为参与中最受重视的方面。出勤率仍低于预期，尤其是在有多种合并症和心理健康需求的患者中。针对接受糖尿病注射治疗的成人的团体教育与高患者满意度和规律参加者血糖结局改善相关。将团体教育与个性化支持相结合的混合模式可能改善高需求患者的可及性和参与度。

items.title_en: Chiral waveguide model for error-correctable quantum computation
items.title_zh: 用于可纠错量子计算的手性波导模型
items.abstract_en: We develop a first-principles framework connecting microscopic waveguide scattering to quantum error correction and algorithmic performance. For polarization-encoded single photons interacting with an ensemble of two-level atoms in a chiral waveguide, we derive an effective polarization quantum channel by tracing out the frequency degree of freedom. Using this channel as the physical noise model for a rotated planar code, we observe threshold behavior as the number of atoms $N$ and the atom-waveguide coupling strength $Γ$ are varied. An asymptotic analysis of the microscopic scattering model explains the threshold scaling with $NΓ/σ$, where $σ$ is the photon spectral bandwidth. For identical, lossless atoms with symmetric real coupling and a photon spectrum centered at resonance, the effective noise is strongly biased toward $X$ errors. We then incorporate the resulting logical errors into quantum phase estimation and demonstrate that the noise bias can guide circuit design. In particular, a Hadamard-basis implementation reduces sensitivity to the dominant error, improving algorithmic performance.
items.abstract_zh: 我们建立了一个第一性原理框架，将微观波导散射与量子纠错及算法性能联系起来。对于手性波导中与二能级原子系综相互作用的偏振编码单光子，我们通过对频率自由度求迹推导出有效偏振量子信道。将该信道用作旋转平面码的物理噪声模型，我们观察到阈值行为随原子数$N$和原子-波导耦合强度$Γ$的变化。对微观散射模型的渐近分析解释了阈值随$NΓ/σ$的缩放关系，其中$σ$为光子光谱带宽。对于具有对称实耦合且光子谱以共振为中心的相同无损耗原子，有效噪声强烈偏向$X$错误。随后我们将由此产生的逻辑错误纳入量子相位估计，并证明噪声偏置可以指导电路设计。特别是，Hadamard基实现降低了对主导错误的敏感性，从而改善算法性能。

items.title_en: Split-Ring Couplers for On-Skin Wi-Fi Communication via an SSPP Waveguide Textile
items.title_zh: 用于皮肤表面Wi-Fi通信的开口环耦合器：基于SSPP波导织物
items.abstract_en: Textile spoof surface plasmon polariton (SSPP) waveguides offer guided on-body links, but their body-facing ground conductors obstruct coupling from on-skin wireless nodes. This letter presents a split-ring coupling interface using local ground recesses at the textile terminations, without patterned garment-side launchers. The capacitively loaded rings are supported by polydimethylsiloxane carriers with a thickness of 2~mm. An image-current model and full-wave simulations examine the effect of backing-ground spacing and determine the recess geometry. For a 450~mm textile waveguide on a water-filled body phantom, the measured $S_{21}$ at 2.45 GHz was $-$18.8~dB, versus $-$60.9~dB without the textile. A 625-position scan showed a maximum 5.1 dB reduction relative to the nominal position within the measured joint $\pm$5~mm placement region. A separate two-node IEEE~802.11n test demonstrated a 65~Mb/s physical-layer (PHY) rate with zero packet errors among 300 frames at $-$20~dBm transmit power through the coupler link. These results establish high-rate, placement-tolerant on-skin Wi-Fi communication through an SSPP waveguide textile.
items.abstract_zh: 织物伪表面等离激元极化激元（SSPP）波导可提供体表引导链路，但其面向身体的地导体阻碍了来自皮肤表面无线节点的耦合。本文提出一种开口环耦合接口，在织物终端使用局部地平面凹槽，而无需图案化衣物侧发射器。容性加载环由厚度为2 mm的聚二甲基硅氧烷载体支撑。镜像电流模型和全波仿真考察背地间距的影响并确定凹槽几何结构。对于水填充体模上的450 mm织物波导，在2.45 GHz测得的$S_{21}$为$-$18.8 dB，而无织物时为$-$60.9 dB。625个位置扫描显示，在被测关节$\pm$5 mm放置区域内，相对于标称位置的最大下降为5.1 dB。一项单独的两节点IEEE 802.11n测试表明，通过耦合器链路在$-$20 dBm发射功率下，物理层（PHY）速率为65 Mb/s，300帧中零误包。这些结果确立了通过SSPP波导织物实现高速、容忍放置偏差的皮肤表面Wi-Fi通信。

items.title_en: TS-GEAR: Taobao Shangou GEnerative Ad Retrieval
items.title_zh: TS-GEAR：淘宝闪购生成式广告检索
items.abstract_en: On-demand delivery platforms such as DoorDash and Uber Eats impose a constraint absent in traditional e-commerce: merchants beyond the user's delivery range are invalid candidates rather than merely low-ranked. Generative retrieval has recently shown strong potential in large-scale retrieval systems. Adapting it to this setting, however, poses three challenges. First, existing semantic IDs encode geography only as a soft signal, so reachability can only rely on a non-differentiable post-generation hard truncation. Second, user preferences vary substantially across both regions and queries, so aggregating historical behaviors without conditioning on geography and the current query yields biased interest estimates. Third, the retrieved candidate set is evaluated by its collective value, yet autoregressive training scores each sequence independently, with no set-level signal to discourage redundant near-duplicates. To address the challenges, we propose TS-GEAR, a unified generative retrieval framework for on-demand delivery: (1) Geo-Semantic ID splits merchant identifiers into geographic prefixes and semantic suffixes, making reachability a prediction target rather than a post-hoc filter; (2) Query-Geo Target Attention aggregates historical behaviors using the real-time query and location as dual targets, while encoding each behavior's own location into its attention key; (3) GMPO (Group Marginal Policy Optimization) rewrites advantages using a deduplicated group reward and marginal advantage within GRPO, avoiding auxiliary diversity objectives. Deployed online with a lightweight 0.1B backbone, TS-GEAR serves over 150 million queries per day in the search advertising pipeline of Taobao Shangou, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art generative retrieval methods on both HitRate and geographic validity, and achieving 3.8% gains in ad impressions and 4.2% in ad revenue.
items.abstract_zh: DoorDash和Uber Eats等即时配送平台施加了传统电子商务中不存在的一项约束：超出用户配送范围的商家是无效候选，而不仅仅是排名较低。生成式检索最近在大规模检索系统中展现出强大潜力。然而，将其适配到这一场景面临三个挑战。第一，现有语义ID仅将地理信息编码为软信号，因此可达性只能依赖生成后的不可微分硬截断。第二，用户偏好在不同区域和查询之间差异很大，因此在不以地理信息和当前查询为条件的情况下聚合历史行为会产生有偏的兴趣估计。第三，检索到的候选集按集合价值评估，但自回归训练独立地对每个序列打分，没有集合级信号来抑制冗余的近似重复项。为应对这些挑战，我们提出TS-GEAR，一个面向即时配送的统一生成式检索框架：（1）Geo-Semantic ID将商家标识符拆分为地理前缀和语义后缀，使可达性成为预测目标而非事后过滤器；（2）Query-Geo Target Attention以实时查询和位置作为双重目标聚合历史行为，同时将每个行为自身位置编码进其注意力键中；（3）GMPO（Group Marginal Policy Optimization）在GRPO内使用去重组奖励和边际优势重写优势，避免辅助多样性目标。TS-GEAR以轻量级0.1B骨干模型在线部署，在淘宝闪购的搜索广告链路中每天服务超过1.5亿次查询，在HitRate和地理有效性上持续优于最先进的生成式检索方法，并在广告曝光量上获得3.8%的提升、广告收入上获得4.2%的提升。

items.title_en: SCALE: Small-Model-First Concept Abstraction with LLM-Guided Experience Internalization
items.title_zh: SCALE：小模型优先的概念抽象与LLM引导的经验内化
items.abstract_en: Autonomous agents must continually acquire reusable knowledge from experience without relying on costly large language model (LLM) reasoning for every decision. However, existing experience-based approaches often struggle to transform accumulated observations and reasoning into compact knowledge that lightweight models can independently apply. This paper proposes SCALE, a small-model-first framework that integrates selective LLM reasoning, experience-driven concept abstraction, and knowledge internalization. A lightweight model handles routine predictions, while prediction errors and accumulated cross-episode evidence selectively trigger LLM reflection. The LLM analyzes relevant historical experiences, generates positive and negative counterfactual examples, and proposes reusable concept hypotheses. Independently validated concepts are progressively incorporated into hierarchical neural representations, enabling lightweight models to exploit increasingly abstract knowledge. Meanwhile, mastered experiences are excluded from active memory while their original records remain available in a complete archive. Experiments across ten random seeds show that historical recall improves held-out accuracy from 87.11% to 98.28%, hierarchical concept knowledge increases difficult-case accuracy from 55.33% to 66.47%, and abstract archiving reduces active experience records from 6,000 to 1,528.
items.abstract_zh: 自主智能体必须持续从经验中获取可复用知识，而不必为每个决策依赖昂贵的大语言模型（LLM）推理。然而，现有的基于经验的方法往往难以将累积的观察和推理转化为轻量级模型可独立应用的紧凑知识。本文提出SCALE，一个整合选择性LLM推理、经验驱动的概念抽象和知识内化的小模型优先框架。轻量级模型处理常规预测，而预测错误和累积的跨回合证据选择性触发LLM反思。LLM分析相关历史经验，生成正向和负向反事实示例，并提出可复用概念假设。经过独立验证的概念逐步纳入分层神经表示，使轻量级模型能够利用越来越抽象的知识。同时，已掌握的经验从活跃记忆中排除，而其原始记录仍保留在完整档案中。在十个随机种子上的实验表明，历史召回将留出集准确率从87.11%提高到98.28%，分层概念知识将困难案例准确率从55.33%提高到66.47%，抽象归档将活跃经验记录从6,000条减少到1,528条。

items.title_en: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
items.title_zh: WorldFoundry：面向世界智能的统一基础设施
items.abstract_en: Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions. We define a generative world model as a predictive dynamical system that maintains a persistent, history-conditioned representation of an environment, updates that representation in response to actions or interventions, and generates temporally coherent trajectories that reflect outcomes under observed and counterfactual interventions. From this definition, we derive an intelligence-oriented framework spanning perceptual grounding, persistent state modeling, controllable transformation, dynamics-aware prediction, and closed-loop interaction. We present WorldFoundry, open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation across video, 3D and 4D, embodied action, and interactive world systems. WorldFoundry unifies model and benchmark discovery, runtime and asset preparation, execution orchestration, artifact management, and interactive visualization, while modality-specific adapters preserve native inputs, execution semantics, output representations, and evaluation protocols. Explicit manifests, durable artifact contracts, and evidence-aware scorecards separate execution readiness from evaluative claims, making each claim traceable to its supporting artifacts. The catalog contains 270 model entries, 74 benchmarks, and 62 registered metric entries, with readiness and execution evidence recorded separately. WorldFoundry enables reproducible comparison of persistent, controllable dynamics across heterogeneous systems, advancing the field from perceptual synthesis toward measurable world intelligence.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉生成模型日益模糊了合成观测与模拟环境之间的界限。然而，仅凭视觉逼真度并不构成成功的世界建模：有说服力的输出可能缺乏持久状态、物理动力学或对交互的因果一致响应。我们将生成式世界模型定义为一个预测性动力系统：它维护环境的一种持久的、以历史为条件的表示，响应动作或干预更新该表示，并生成时间上连贯的轨迹，以反映在观测干预和反事实干预下的结果。根据这一定义，我们推导出一个面向智能的框架，涵盖感知基础、持久状态建模、可控变换、动力学感知预测和闭环交互。我们提出WorldFoundry，这是一个开源基础设施，用于跨视频、3D和4D、具身动作以及交互式世界系统进行可复现的推理与评估。WorldFoundry统一了模型与基准发现、运行时与资产准备、执行编排、产物管理以及交互式可视化，同时模态特定适配器保留原生输入、执行语义、输出表示和评估协议。显式清单、持久产物契约和证据感知评分卡将执行就绪性与评估性主张区分开来，使每项主张都可追溯到其支持产物。该目录包含270个模型条目、74个基准和62个注册指标条目，就绪性与执行证据分别记录。WorldFoundry能够对异构系统中持久、可控的动力学进行可复现比较，推动该领域从感知合成迈向可度量的世界智能。

items.title_en: Integrated genotyping, annotation and epigenetic characterization of transposable elements with GraffiTE
items.title_zh: 使用 GraffiTE 对转座元件进行整合的基因分型、注释与表观遗传表征
items.abstract_en: Genotyping, annotating and characterizing TE variation leaped forward with long-read sequencing (LRS) and de novo assembly. LRS techniques also reveal CpG methylation, which enables measuring the impact of TEs on epigenomes and sheds light on the role of TEs as regulatory sequences. Yet, TE genotyping tools discard the valuable allele-specific epigenetic information. We introduce GraffiTE v1.1, the first Nextflow pipeline that genotypes SVs, annotates polymorphic mobile elements (MEI), and maps epigenetic data to TEs using pangenome graphs in one command. GraffiTE v1.1 is designed to map any epigenetic information that is based on LRS stencils, including Fiber-seq. We demonstrate the capabilities of GraffiTE v1.1 by analyzing genomes and methylomes obtained from 20 Quebec residents of French-Canadian descent. In these genomes, TE annotation yields 4,908 Alu, 704 LINE1, 112 SVA and 21 HERVK (HML-2) distinct polymorphic mobile elements (MEIs). We also identify 10 fixed HERVK insertions that vary between solo LTR and provirus, or in proviral copy number. We determine that these MEIs contribute 144,748 additional CpGs not present in the reference. From this, we identify 480 Alus, 67 LINE1s, 12 SVAs and 2 HERVKs in hypomethylated states. We note that Alus and SVAs are more methylated than other LINE1 and HERVK. Lastly, MEIs dating reported a mean of age 1.08 Mya (median: 640 kya) and beta regression identified a moderate demethylating effect of age on MEIs (effect: -0.069 log-odds per log10 years, P < 6.08 x 10-19). Our results show that the methylation level of a LINE1 MEI is expected to decrease from 86.4% to 80.8% in the first Mya. In conclusion, GraffiTE v1.1 genotypes SVs, annotates MEI, and characterizes their epigenetic state at the scale of populations by leveraging the full potential of LRS. While we showcase its application in human data, the pipeline can be deployed in any model for which a TE library is available.
items.abstract_zh: 长读长测序（LRS）和从头组装推动了转座元件（TE）变异的基因分型、注释与表征的飞跃。LRS 技术还揭示 CpG 甲基化，从而能够测量 TE 对表观基因组的影响，并阐明 TE 作为调控序列的作用。然而，TE 基因分型工具丢弃了有价值的等位基因特异性表观遗传信息。我们推出 GraffiTE v1.1，这是首个可通过一条命令完成 SV 基因分型、多态移动元件（MEI）注释以及利用泛基因组图将表观遗传数据映射到 TE 的 Nextflow 流水线。GraffiTE v1.1 旨在映射任何基于 LRS stencil 的表观遗传信息，包括 Fiber-seq。我们通过分析来自 20 名法裔加拿大血统魁北克居民的基因组和甲基化组，展示了 GraffiTE v1.1 的能力。在这些基因组中，TE 注释得到 4,908 个 Alu、704 个 LINE1、112 个 SVA 和 21 个 HERVK（HML-2）不同的多态移动元件（MEI）。我们还鉴定出 10 个固定的 HERVK 插入，它们在单独 LTR 与原病毒之间、或在前病毒拷贝数上存在差异。我们确定这些 MEI 贡献了参考序列中不存在的 144,748 个额外 CpG。由此，我们鉴定出 480 个 Alu、67 个 LINE1、12 个 SVA 和 2 个 HERVK 处于低甲基化状态。我们注意到 Alu 和 SVA 的甲基化程度高于其他 LINE1 和 HERVK。最后，MEI 定年报告平均年龄为 1.08 Mya（中位数：640 kya），beta 回归发现年龄对 MEI 具有中等程度的去甲基化效应（效应：每 log10 年 -0.069 log-odds，P < 6.08 x 10-19）。我们的结果表明，一个 LINE1 MEI 的甲基化水平预计在第一个 Mya 内从 86.4% 降至 80.8%。总之，GraffiTE v1.1 通过充分利用 LRS 的潜力，在群体尺度上对 SV 进行基因分型、注释 MEI 并表征其表观遗传状态。虽然我们展示了其在人类数据中的应用，但该流水线可部署于任何有可用 TE 库的模型。

items.title_en: The simulability frontiers of photonic quantum computing
items.title_zh: 光子量子计算的可模拟性前沿
items.abstract_en: Estimates of when photonic devices outgrow classical simulation are hard to compare: even for single-photon boson sampling, quoted thresholds range from 50 to 98 photons, as they rest on different tasks and assumptions. We propose as a common unit the time a classical computer needs to draw one sample from the device's exact output distribution, up to floating-point rounding. Only exactness applies equally to every kind of light, since the cost of approximate sampling depends on the accuracy required. The simulability frontier is the device size at which our fastest exact sampler produces one sample per second on a fixed machine; this device size increases with better hardware and algorithms. As the time per sample grows exponentially with the number of detected photons, doubling the machine speed moves the frontier by about one photon, whereas a better algorithm changes the growth rate. We measure the frontier with photonic-engines, an open-source GPU library of exact samplers for single photons, entangled photons from quantum emitters, vacuum-single-photon superpositions and squeezed light. Each sampler is validated against a simulator sharing no code with it. On one NVIDIA H100 GPU, with Haar-random interferometers, twice as many modes as photonic inputs and photon-number-resolving detectors, the frontier lies at 38.3 single photons and at 31.0 entangled photons from one emitter. For squeezed light, a timing model fitted to measurements places it at 41.5 squeezed photonic inputs of mean photon number 0.5. For our samplers, coherence alone makes simulation harder: sources that emit a photon with probability one half reach 64.2 when vacuum and photon are mixed incoherently, as for lossy single photons, but only 50.0 when they are in coherent superposition. Feed-forward from mid-circuit measurement of up to three modes lowers the single-photon frontier only from 38.3 to 38.1.
items.abstract_zh: 关于光子器件何时超出经典模拟能力的估计难以比较：即使对于单光子玻色采样，所引用的阈值也从50个光子到98个光子不等，因为它们基于不同任务和假设。我们提出一个共同单位：经典计算机从器件的精确输出分布中抽取一个样本所需的时间，精确到浮点舍入。只有精确性同等适用于每一种光，因为近似采样的成本取决于所需精度。可模拟性前沿是指在固定机器上，我们最快的精确采样器每秒产生一个样本时的设备规模；该设备规模随更好的硬件和算法而增大。由于每个样本的时间随探测光子数呈指数增长，机器速度翻倍会使前沿移动约一个光子，而更好的算法会改变增长率。我们使用photonic-engines来测量该前沿，这是一个开源GPU库，包含用于单光子、来自量子发射器的纠缠光子、真空-单光子叠加态和压缩光的精确采样器。每个采样器都通过一个与其不共享代码的模拟器进行验证。在一块NVIDIA H100 GPU上，使用Haar随机干涉仪、模式数为光子输入数两倍以及光子数分辨探测器时，前沿位于38.3个单光子和来自一个发射器的31.0个纠缠光子。对于压缩光，根据测量拟合的时序模型将其置于平均光子数为0.5的41.5个压缩光子输入。对于我们的采样器，仅相干性本身就会使模拟更困难：以二分之一概率发射光子的光源，在真空与光子非相干混合时（如有损单光子）达到64.2，但当它们处于相干叠加时仅为50.0。来自最多三个模式的线路中测量的前馈仅将单光子前沿从38.3降低到38.1。

items.title_en: Joint LSFC and Nakagami-m Estimation From Downlink SINR in GZF-Precoded CF-mMIMO
items.title_zh: GZF预编码CF-mMIMO中基于下行SINR的LSFC与Nakagami-m联合估计
items.abstract_en: Accurate characterization of the instantaneous signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) is important for reliability-sensitive cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (CF-mMIMO) systems. This paper proposes a joint estimation method for link-specific large-scale fading coefficients (LSFCs) and a common Nakagami-$m$ shape parameter using power and downlink SINR measurements. A tractable SINR distribution is first derived under global zero-forcing (GZF) precoding, Nakagami-$m$ fading, and link-level fractional power control (FPC). Based on the derived probability density function (PDF), a model-driven neural network (NN) is developed to solve the resulting maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE) problem. Simulations show that the reconstructed SINR distributions obtained with the estimated parameters closely match the empirical distributions. With $2 \times 10^{5}$ samples, the proposed method achieves an LSFC root-mean-square error (RMSE) of approximately 1.0 dB and an $m$ RMSE of approximately 0.085.
items.abstract_zh: 准确表征瞬时信干噪比（SINR）对于可靠性敏感的无蜂窝大规模多输入多输出（CF-mMIMO）系统很重要。本文提出一种联合估计方法，利用功率与下行SINR测量来估计链路特定大尺度衰落系数（LSFC）和一个公共Nakagami-m形状参数。首先在全局迫零（GZF）预编码、Nakagami-m衰落和链路级分数功率控制（FPC）下推导出一个可处理的SINR分布。基于推导出的概率密度函数（PDF），开发了一个模型驱动神经网络（NN）来求解由此产生的最大似然估计（MLE）问题。仿真表明，使用估计参数得到的重构SINR分布与经验分布密切吻合。在2×10^5个样本下，所提方法的LSFC均方根误差（RMSE）约为1.0 dB，m的RMSE约为0.085。

items.title_en: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
items.title_zh: Infrathon：面向真实世界长时程AI基础设施优化的语言智能体基准测试
items.abstract_en: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets. These findings indicate that shorter evaluations can overlook both optimization gains and changes in relative model performance. We also find agents can discover solutions that outperform human-designed baselines: Claude Opus 5.5 increases the mean KV-cache compression ratio from 6.82% with the human-designed Quant-VideoGen codec to 19.86%. Analysis of agent trajectories identifies task violations, unreliable testing, and premature completion as barriers to sustained improvement. Together, Our Infrathon framework provide resources for constructing long-horizon tasks, evaluating frontier agents, and discovering good infrastructure solutions.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究前沿智能体能否在长时程内持续改进真实世界的AI基础设施。我们引入Infrathon，这是一个涵盖不同层次的多样化、长时程AI基础设施优化任务基准。我们在24小时预算下对六个模型进行了150次运行评估，总计超过10,000 GPU小时。结果表明，模型排名随评估时程而变化，同时150次运行中有135次在预算后半段取得了进一步改进。这些发现表明，较短的评估可能同时忽略优化收益和相对模型表现的变化。我们还发现，智能体能够发现优于人工设计基线的解决方案：Claude Opus 5.5将平均KV缓存压缩率从人工设计的Quant-VideoGen编解码器的6.82%提高到19.86%。对智能体轨迹的分析识别出任务违规、不可靠测试和过早完成是持续改进的障碍。总之，我们的Infrathon框架为构建长时程任务、评估前沿智能体和发现良好基础设施解决方案提供了资源。

items.title_en: Review the Episodes, Refine the Lessons: Simple Memory Evolution for Embodied Agents
items.title_zh: 回顾片段，提炼经验：具身智能体的简单记忆演化
items.abstract_en: Recent studies of embodied agents based on frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) develop harness engineering around the MLLM, such as harnesses with post-trained policies and recursive self-improvement loops. Yet whether these additions exceed the native capability of the MLLM remains unexplored. We introduce SimplEvo to explore how far an MLLM can improve under direct control when it retains its execution experience in self-written text memories. It requires no weight updates, post-trained policies, or privileged information. The MLLM writes a coordinate-free task memory once from a single demonstration. Under a strict train-test protocol, it then creates a bounded working memory on training episodes only and refines it after each episode with lessons on procedure, completion, and recovery. Both memories stay fixed at test time. On EBench, SimplEvo lifts the success rate (SR) of GPT-6-Astra under direct control from 46.7% to 81.7%, and tops the RoboDojo leaderboard with 69.63% SR and a score of 75.32. Compared with memories that also store past visual frames, SimplEvo reaches a similar SR with text memory alone while using fewer tokens. With its memories fixed, SimplEvo also generalizes to unseen layouts and randomized scene configurations. Moreover, the working memory transfers across models: written by GPT-6-Astra, it can be reused as is by weaker MLLMs and improve their performance without any adaptation of their own.
items.abstract_zh: 最近基于前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的具身智能体研究，围绕MLLM开发harness工程，例如带有后训练策略和递归自我改进循环的harness。然而，这些附加组件是否超越MLLM的原生能力仍未得到探索。我们引入SimplEvo，以探索当MLLM将执行经验保留在自写文本记忆中时，在直接控制下能改进到何种程度。它不需要权重更新、后训练策略或特权信息。MLLM从单次演示中一次性写入无坐标任务记忆。在严格的训练-测试协议下，它随后仅在训练片段上创建有界工作记忆，并在每个片段后根据关于流程、完成和恢复的经验对其进行提炼。两种记忆在测试时均保持固定。在EBench上，SimplEvo将直接控制下GPT-6-Astra的成功率（SR）从46.7%提升到81.7%，并以69.63%的SR和75.32的分数位居RoboDojo排行榜榜首。与同时存储过去视觉帧的记忆相比，SimplEvo仅用文本记忆就达到相近SR，同时使用更少token。由于其记忆固定，SimplEvo还能泛化到未见布局和随机化场景配置。此外，工作记忆可跨模型迁移：由GPT-6-Astra写入的工作记忆可原样被较弱MLLM复用，并在其自身无需任何适配的情况下提升性能。

items.title_en: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
items.title_zh: SplatAnything：面向任意场景的前馈3DGS高斯间距归一化
items.abstract_en: We identify a key limitation of existing feed-forward 3DGS methods: Gaussian attributes are typically predicted in a radial-distance-normalized space that canonicalizes a global radial statistic of the reconstructed geometry, while the spacing between neighboring Gaussian centers can still vary substantially across scene scales and camera configurations. This mismatch induces systematic shifts in Gaussian-scale targets, leading to ambiguous supervision. To address this, we propose SplatAnything with Gaussian Spacing Normalization (GSNorm), which canonicalizes a robust scene-level statistic of Gaussian spacing to provide a more consistent spatial reference for Gaussian prediction. To rigorously assess our method, we further establish a systematic benchmark spanning diverse datasets, input sparsity levels, and challenging extrapolated viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SplatAnything achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly strong gains under substantial variations in scene scale and viewpoint.
items.abstract_zh: 我们指出已有前馈3DGS方法的一个关键局限：高斯属性通常在径向距离归一化空间中预测，该空间将重建几何的一个全局径向统计量规范化，而相邻高斯中心之间的间距在不同场景尺度和相机配置下仍可能显著变化。这种不匹配会导致高斯尺度目标出现系统性偏移，从而产生模糊的监督。为解决该问题，我们提出SplatAnything，并引入高斯间距归一化（GSNorm），它将高斯间距的一个稳健场景级统计量规范化，从而为高斯预测提供更一致的空间参考。为严格评估我们的方法，我们进一步建立了一个系统基准，涵盖多样数据集、输入稀疏度水平以及具有挑战性的外推视角。大量实验表明，SplatAnything达到最先进性能，在场景尺度和视角发生显著变化时增益尤为明显。

items.title_en: Core MCC of Arabidopsis thaliana: structural dissection provides new insights into Mad2, BubR1 and CDC20
items.title_zh: 拟南芥核心 MCC：结构解析为 Mad2、BubR1 和 CDC20 提供新见解
items.abstract_en: The spindle assembly checkpoint (SAC) is a mechanism executed mainly by the mitotic checkpoint complex (MCC) to monitor the anchoring of mitotic spindle microtubules to ensure correct chromosome segregation. Although knowledge of protein-protein interactions in the plant cell cycle has progressed in recent years, information on the SAC mechanism in this context remains scarce. Here, we used bigBac, chemical crosslinking, mass spectrometry and structural analysis to identify protein-protein interactions (PPIs) among AtCDC20, AtBubR1 (BMF2) and AtMad2, which are components of the core MCC26 in A. thaliana. Fifty-three nonredundant crosslinks were identified, with multiple binding sites in different domains and subdomains of these proteins, such as the {beta}-propeller (AtCDC20), tetratricopeptide domain, and KEN boxes, including a new KET box (AtBubR1) and Horma domain (AtMad2). We also identified a hierarchy of interactions between these three proteins, with the potential to regulate signalling through the SAC molecular mechanism. Interactions that characterize the Mad2 tetramer, with the coupling of two dimers, were also identified. No PPIs were identified for AtBub1 (BMF1) or AtBub3:1, revealing a significant difference in MCC formation compared with that in other eukaryotes. Our findings provide a structural basis for core MCC formation in A. thaliana and offer new insights into the proteins CDC20, BubR1 and Mad2 in the context of the SAC.
items.abstract_zh: 纺锤体组装检查点（SAC）是一种主要由有丝分裂检查点复合体（MCC）执行的机制，用于监测有丝分裂纺锤体微管的锚定，以确保染色体正确分离。尽管近年来植物细胞周期中蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的知识有所进展，但该背景下关于 SAC 机制的信息仍然稀少。在这里，我们使用 bigBac、化学交联、质谱和结构分析来鉴定拟南芥核心 MCC26 组分 AtCDC20、AtBubR1（BMF2）和 AtMad2 之间的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）。共鉴定出 53 个非冗余交联，在这些蛋白质的不同结构域和亚结构域中存在多个结合位点，例如 β-螺旋桨（AtCDC20）、四三肽重复结构域和 KEN 框，包括一个新的 KET 框（AtBubR1）和 Horma 结构域（AtMad2）。我们还鉴定了这三种蛋白质之间的相互作用层级，其具有通过 SAC 分子机制调节信号传导的潜力。还鉴定了表征 Mad2 四聚体（由两个二聚体偶联）的相互作用。未鉴定到 AtBub1（BMF1）或 AtBub3:1 的 PPI，揭示了与其他真核生物相比 MCC 形成的显著差异。我们的发现为拟南芥核心 MCC 的形成提供了结构基础，并为 SAC 背景下的 CDC20、BubR1 和 Mad2 蛋白提供了新见解。

items.title_en: The hidden symmetry operators of the asymmetric quantum Rabi model and its two-photon and two-mode variants in closed form
items.title_zh: 非对称量子Rabi模型及其双光子和双模变体的隐藏对称算符的闭式形式
items.abstract_en: The asymmetric quantum Rabi model, a two-level system with splitting $Δ$ and bias $ε$ coupled with strength $g$ to a boson mode, has level crossings when $ε$ is an integer multiple $N$ of the mode frequency. They are due to a hidden symmetry operator $J$, for which no general formula has been available. Here we obtain $J$ in closed form for every $N$. We find that $J$ is given by the parity of the symmetric model times the continuant (ordered tridiagonal determinant) of $N$ first-order operators, which are the Hamiltonians at the intermediate biases $N-1,N-3,\dots,1-N$ minus a common number operator. The symmetry is thus a staircase of $N$ bias steps that closes on the mirror image of the model precisely at integer bias. The proof uses induction on two commutation relations. The same relations hold in the asymmetric two-photon and two-mode models, written with the generators of $\mathfrak{su}(1,1)$, so that the same continuant gives their symmetry operators for every order, previously known only for the lowest ones. We also relate the closed formula for $J$ to the known recursion relations for its coefficients and give their terms of lowest order in $Δ$ explicitly.
items.abstract_zh: 非对称量子Rabi模型是一个具有分裂Δ和偏置ε、以强度g耦合到一个玻色模式的二能级系统；当ε为模式频率的整数倍N时，它会出现能级交叉。这些交叉源于一个隐藏对称算符J，而此前尚无其通用公式。这里我们给出对每个N都成立的J闭式形式。我们发现，J由对称模型的宇称乘以N个一阶算符的continuant（有序三对角行列式）给出，这些一阶算符是中间偏置N-1,N-3,...,1-N处的哈密顿量减去一个共同的粒子数算符。因此，该对称性是由N个偏置台阶构成的阶梯，并恰在整数偏置处闭合到模型的镜像。证明通过对两个对易关系进行归纳完成。同样的关系在非对称双光子和双模模型中也成立，这些模型用su(1,1)的生成元写出，因此同一个continuant给出它们在每一阶的对称算符，而此前仅已知最低阶的对称算符。我们还将J的闭式公式与其系数的已知递推关系联系起来，并显式给出它们在Δ中的最低阶项。

items.title_en: Performance Analysis of Entanglement Swapping DV-QKD over MIMO FSO Channels
items.title_zh: MIMO FSO信道中纠缠交换DV-QKD的性能分析
items.abstract_en: This paper studies multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) free-space optical (FSO) quantum communication systems employing polarization-encoded discrete-variable quantum key distribution (DV-QKD), based on entanglement swapping, with the goal of extending secure communications beyond the reach of a direct link. The FSO channels are subject to atmospheric absorption, diffraction, beam wander, pointing errors, and turbulence-induced fading, while background noise and detector imperfections degrade the performance. An eavesdropper controlling the channels and the relay is also considered. To analyze the performance of the considered system, both hops MIMO channels are decomposed into parallel spatial eigenchannels via singular value decomposition (SVD), photon loss is modeled using Kraus operators, and a threshold-detector model is developed for the relay. Based on these models, closed-form per-eigenchannel expressions for the relay gain are derived, which are then used to obtain expressions for the quantum bit error rate (QBER) and the secret key rate (SKR). Numerical results demonstrate that entanglement swapping maintains a low QBER over longer distances than direct transmission, extending the communication range beyond the noise-limited cutoff of the direct link, at the cost of a lower SKR at short distances. The crossover distance beyond which entanglement swapping prevails is determined mainly by the background noise and the detector technology, and it is demonstrated to increase with MIMO configurations. Moreover, the reach gain is shown to be maximized for a midpoint relay. Finally, since each swapping event requires a single-pair emission from both sources, a near-deterministic entangled-photon source is required, which spontaneous parametric down-conversion sources do not provide at practical key rates, whereas MIMO substantially relaxes this requirement.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究采用偏振编码离散变量量子密钥分发（DV-QKD）、基于纠缠交换的多输入多输出（MIMO）自由空间光（FSO）量子通信系统，目标是使安全通信扩展到直连链路可达范围之外。FSO信道受到大气吸收、衍射、光束漂移、指向误差和湍流引起衰落的影响，同时背景噪声和探测器不完美会降低性能。还考虑了控制信道和中继的窃听者。为分析所考虑系统的性能，通过奇异值分解（SVD）将两跳MIMO信道分解为并行空间本征信道，使用Kraus算子对光子损耗建模，并为中继建立阈值探测器模型。基于这些模型，推导了中继增益的每个本征信道的闭式表达式，然后用于获得量子比特误码率（QBER）和密钥率（SKR）的表达式。数值结果表明，与直接传输相比，纠缠交换能在更长距离上保持低QBER，将通信范围扩展到直连链路受噪声限制的截止距离之外，代价是短距离处SKR较低。纠缠交换占优所对应的交叉距离主要由背景噪声和探测器技术决定，并证明其随MIMO配置增加而增大。此外，结果表明，当中继位于中点时，可达距离增益最大化。最后，由于每次交换事件要求两个源各发射单对光子，因此需要近确定性的纠缠光子源；自发参量下转换源在实际密钥率下无法提供这种源，而MIMO显著放宽了该要求。

items.title_en: AOP-Smart-Finder: A High-Throughput Human-AI Hybrid Framework for AOP Discovery and Evidence Mapping from Large-Scale Literature
items.title_zh: AOP-Smart-Finder：一种用于大规模文献中AOP发现与证据映射的高通量人类-AI混合框架
items.abstract_en: The rapid growth of scientific literature and the high heterogeneity of biological terminology and mechanistic descriptions make it difficult for researchers to integrate scattered research evidence, identify connections among biological events, and construct mechanistic networks. Here, we developed a high-throughput human-AI hybrid framework, AOP-Smart-Finder, for biological event discovery, relationship mining, and Adverse Outcome Pathway (AOP) construction and evidence mapping from large-scale literature. This framework integrates Large Language Models (LLMs), AOP-Smart retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) technology, and Python-based automation, supporting two analysis modes: one based on a single compound and the other based on a predefined set of biological events. In the di(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) case, the system processed 12,983 articles within 30 min and included 1,093 of them, from which it extracted 1,589 biological events (including 458 official key events [KEs] and 1,131 candidate KEs) and 2,519 key event relationships (KERs). In the amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) case, the system identified 55 stressors from 437 articles and extracted 278 biological events and 548 event relationships. Following manual curation and Weight of Evidence (WoE) evaluation, a mechanistic network comprising 16 KEs and 23 KERs was ultimately constructed. This framework can either use existing AOPs as knowledge guidance for mechanistic expansion and evidence supplementation, or discover novel event connections and construct mechanistic networks around user-specified research topics. It provides a high-throughput, traceable, human-AI hybrid methodology for complex biological mechanism elucidation and AOP discovery driven by large-scale literature.
items.abstract_zh: 科学文献的快速增长以及生物学术语和机制描述的高度异质性，使研究人员难以整合分散的研究证据、识别生物事件之间的联系并构建机制网络。在此，我们开发了一个高通量人类-AI混合框架AOP-Smart-Finder，用于从大规模文献中进行生物事件发现、关系挖掘以及不良结局通路（AOP）构建和证据映射。该框架集成了大语言模型（LLM）、AOP-Smart检索增强生成（RAG）技术和基于Python的自动化，支持两种分析模式：一种基于单一化合物，另一种基于预定义的生物事件集合。在邻苯二甲酸二(2-乙基己基)酯（DEHP）案例中，系统在30分钟内处理了12,983篇文章，并纳入其中1,093篇，从中提取了1,589个生物事件（包括458个官方关键事件[KE]和1,131个候选KE）以及2,519个关键事件关系（KER）。在肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）案例中，系统从437篇文章中识别出55种应激源，并提取了278个生物事件和548个事件关系。经人工审编和证据权重（WoE）评估后，最终构建了一个包含16个KE和23个KER的机制网络。该框架既可利用现有AOP作为知识引导，进行机制扩展和证据补充，也可发现新的事件联系，并围绕用户指定的研究主题构建机制网络。它为大规模文献驱动的复杂生物机制阐释和AOP发现提供了一种高通量、可追溯的人类-AI混合方法。

items.title_en: Floquet-Parameterized Koopman-MPC for Tracking Periodic Orbits
items.title_zh: 用于周期轨道跟踪的Floquet参数化Koopman-MPC
items.abstract_en: Designing real-time control for nonlinear systems to track periodic orbits can be challenging, especially for complex and coupled dynamical systems (e.g., tethered kites), where the true model parameters are hard to obtain. To address this, we propose a physics-informed Koopman learning approach that incorporates periodic-orbit stability directly into the learned linear predictor. The approach combines the underlying periodic structure of the dynamics along with periodic state-input trajectory data to learn physically consistent linear predictors (in lifted/observable space). We leverage Floquet theory, which studies the stability of periodic orbits in nonlinear systems, to obtain the periodic stability information of a given orbit via a monodromy matrix (i.e., the state transition matrix over an entire period). Subsequently, we impose open-loop monodromy constraints to learn Floquet-parameterized linear predictors using a least-squares Extended Dynamic Mode Decomposition (EDMD) formulation, thereby constraining the search space and aiding in Koopman learning. We then utilize these linear predictors to design a model predictive control (MPC) law for tracking periodic references. Finally, we evaluate the designed framework on a cartpole system under periodic forcing and compare it against a purely data-driven baseline.
items.abstract_zh: 为非线性系统设计跟踪周期轨道的实时控制可能具有挑战性，尤其是对于复杂且耦合的动力系统（例如系留风筝），其真实模型参数难以获得。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种物理信息Koopman学习方法，将周期轨道稳定性直接纳入所学习的线性预测器。该方法将动力系统潜在的周期结构与周期性状态-输入轨迹数据相结合，以（在提升/可观测空间中）学习物理一致的线性预测器。我们利用Floquet理论（该理论研究非线性系统中周期轨道的稳定性），通过单值矩阵（即整个周期上的状态转移矩阵）获得给定轨道的周期稳定性信息。随后，我们施加开环单值矩阵约束，使用最小二乘扩展动态模式分解（EDMD）公式学习Floquet参数化线性预测器，从而约束搜索空间并辅助Koopman学习。然后，我们利用这些线性预测器设计模型预测控制（MPC）律，以跟踪周期参考。最后，我们在周期性外力作用下的台车-杆系统上评估所设计的框架，并将其与纯数据驱动基线进行比较。

items.title_en: Complementarity-Driven Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment for Zero-Shot EEG-to-Image Retrieval
items.title_zh: 用于零样本EEG到图像检索的互补性驱动双教师分层对齐
items.abstract_en: Decoding visual information from EEG is central to brain--computer interfaces and brain-inspired intelligence, and contrastive alignment with pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) has become the dominant paradigm. However, existing methods align EEG solely with CLIP-family VFMs, leaving hierarchical visual information in neural responses under-exploited. To address this gap, we formulate a mechanism-paradigm correspondence view linking hierarchical visual processing (from appearance to semantics) to the complementary biases of cross-paradigm VFMs, with image-only models (e.g., DINO) and image--text models (e.g., CLIP) capturing distinct facets of this hierarchy. Guided by this view, we propose the Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment (DTHA) framework. Concretely, a shared EEG encoder is supervised by frozen multi-blur CLIP and shallow DINOv2 teachers via dual-branch contrastive alignment, so each branch fully supervises the visual cues it emphasizes. A fused-retrieval objective learns adaptive weights to combine their complementary visual representations for zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval. For the shared EEG encoder, we introduce the Attentive Modulated Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder (AMSPBE), combining temporo-spatial attention with a learnable scalp-pattern bank for accurate, interpretable visual feature extraction, while modeling regional temporal dynamics and filter-bank topographies. On THINGS-EEG zero-shot retrieval, DTHA achieves 92.4% Top-1 accuracy, exceeding prior state of the art by 12.4 percentage points. Spatial, spectral, and representational-similarity analyses, together with THINGS-MEG evaluation, validate DTHA's effectiveness, biological plausibility, and cross-modality generalization. This complementarity-driven perspective shows that supervision from cross-paradigm VFMs enables more complete extraction of hierarchical visual information from brain activity.
items.abstract_zh: 从EEG解码视觉信息是脑机接口和类脑智能的核心，与预训练视觉基础模型（VFM）进行对比对齐已成为主导范式。然而，现有方法仅将EEG与CLIP系列VFM对齐，使神经响应中的分层视觉信息未得到充分利用。为弥补这一空白，我们提出一种机制-范式对应观点，将分层视觉处理（从外观到语义）与跨范式VFM的互补偏置联系起来，其中仅图像模型（例如DINO）和图像-文本模型（例如CLIP）捕获该层次结构的不同侧面。在此观点指导下，我们提出双教师分层对齐（DTHA）框架。具体而言，共享EEG编码器由冻结的多模糊CLIP和浅层DINOv2教师通过双分支对比对齐进行监督，使每个分支充分监督其强调的视觉线索。一种融合检索目标学习自适应权重，以结合它们互补的视觉表示，用于零样本EEG到图像检索。对于共享EEG编码器，我们引入注意力调制头皮模式库编码器（AMSPBE），将时空间注意力与可学习头皮模式库相结合，以实现准确、可解释的视觉特征提取，同时建模区域时间动态和滤波器组拓扑。在THINGS-EEG零样本检索上，DTHA达到92.4%的Top-1准确率，超过先前最先进方法12.4个百分点。空间、频谱和表示相似性分析以及THINGS-MEG评估验证了DTHA的有效性、生物合理性和跨模态泛化能力。这种互补性驱动的视角表明，来自跨范式VFM的监督能够从大脑活动中更完整地提取分层视觉信息。

items.title_en: Stress-adapted endophytic Pseudomonas strains isolated from unmanaged lupin promote potato growth and suppress verticillium wilt through complementary biocontrol and plant growth-promoting mechanisms
items.title_zh: 从未经管理的羽扇豆中分离的逆境适应型内生假单胞菌菌株通过互补的生物防治和植物促生机制促进马铃薯生长并抑制黄萎病
items.abstract_en: Verticillium wilt, primarily caused by Verticillium dahliae, is among the most destructive soil borne diseases impacting global potato production. Fungal propagules remain viable in soil for extended periods, and conventional control measures often show limited efficacy. These challenges underscore the necessity for sustainable disease management strategies. We evaluated two stress adapted endophytic Pseudomonas strains, B18 and B14, isolated from unmanaged wild Lupinus roots in Quebec, Canada, for their plant growth promoting and biocontrol potential against Verticillium wilt in potato. Both isolates exhibited multiple plant beneficial traits. B18 demonstrated strong phosphate solubilization, indole 3 acetic acid production, putative nitrogen fixation related activity, siderophore production, and hydrogen cyanide production. These traits correlated with enhanced plant growth promoting effects, including stimulation of seed germination and radicle growth. In contrast, B14 primarily exhibited antagonistic activity against Verticillium species through similar plant beneficial mechanisms, indicating complementary activities between the strains. The cell free supernatants of B18 further supported its biostimulant activity, suggesting a significant role for its extracellular metabolites. Greenhouse experiments using the Verticillium susceptible potato cultivar Russet Burbank, inoculated with either strain, showed enhanced plant growth and reduced disease severity compared with pathogen only controls. Under pathogen challenge, plants treated with plant growth promoting rhizobacteria (PGPR) exhibited up to 62% greater shoot height and approximately double the leaf production. Additionally, these plants produced 4.2 times more tubers than pathogen only plants. Disease progression, measured as the area under the disease progress curve (AUDPC), was reduced by 84 to 92% following bacterial inoculation. While individual strains effectively suppressed disease, the combined B18 plus B14 strains resulted in the most substantial improvements in growth, biomass, root development, and tuber production. These findings demonstrate that stress adapted endophytic Pseudomonas strains from wild Lupinus can contribute to sustainable potato production. The B18 plus B14 consortium, when combined with two-strain inoculation, demonstrated the most significant effects. These findings emphasize the potential of functionally complementary microbial inoculants for the integrated management of Verticillium wilt and other persistent soil-borne diseases in potatoes.
items.abstract_zh: 黄萎病主要由大丽轮枝菌（Verticillium dahliae）引起，是影响全球马铃薯生产的最具破坏性的土传病害之一。真菌繁殖体可在土壤中长时间保持活力，而常规防治措施往往效果有限。这些挑战凸显了可持续病害管理策略的必要性。我们评估了从加拿大魁北克未经管理的野生羽扇豆（Lupinus）根系中分离的两株逆境适应型内生假单胞菌菌株 B18 和 B14 对马铃薯黄萎病的植物促生和生物防治潜力。两株分离菌均表现出多种植物有益性状。B18 表现出较强的溶磷、吲哚-3-乙酸产生、推定的固氮相关活性、铁载体产生和氰化氢产生能力。这些性状与增强的植物促生效应相关，包括促进种子萌发和胚根生长。相比之下，B14 主要通过类似的植物有益机制表现出对轮枝菌属（Verticillium）的拮抗活性，表明两株菌之间存在互补活性。B18 的无细胞上清液进一步支持其生物刺激活性，表明其胞外代谢物发挥重要作用。使用黄萎病易感马铃薯品种 Russet Burbank 的温室实验表明，与仅接种病原菌的对照相比，接种任一菌株的植株生长增强且病害严重度降低。在病原菌挑战下，经植物促生根际细菌（PGPR）处理的植株株高最多增加 62%，叶片数量约增加一倍。此外，这些植株产生的块茎数量是仅接种病原菌植株的 4.2 倍。以病情进展曲线下面积（AUDPC）衡量的病害进展在细菌接种后降低 84% 至 92%。虽然单株菌均能有效抑制病害，但 B18 与 B14 联合处理在生长、生物量、根系发育和块茎产量方面改善最为显著。这些发现表明，来自野生羽扇豆的逆境适应型内生假单胞菌菌株可为可持续马铃薯生产作出贡献。B18 与 B14 联合体在双菌株接种时表现出最显著的效果。这些发现强调了功能互补的微生物接种剂在马铃薯黄萎病及其他持久性土传病害综合治理中的潜力。

items.title_en: Universal two-qubit control across dilution refrigerators via a 10-km coherent optical link
items.title_zh: 通过10公里相干光链路实现跨稀释制冷机的通用两量子比特控制
items.abstract_en: Distributed quantum networks are important for scalable quantum processors and for potential applications in communication, distributed computation, and sensing, in which direct classical links for adaptive control are essential to harness the shared entanglement. However, controlling superconducting quantum processors from a separate refrigerator over long distances remains elusive. Here, we introduce a coherent optical link (COL) that delivers microwave waveforms and their phase references between dilution refrigerators. Combining a laser, a microwave-to-optical transducer and an optical-to-microwave photodiode, the COL transmits microwave control signals over 10~km of fiber, while optical references derived from the same laser compensate for the frequency mismatch between devices. Through the COL, we deliver a universal gate set to a transmon qubit and a cavity qubit in another refrigerator and entangle them, and achieve a Bell-state fidelity of 80.6\%. Quantum control delivered through the COL thus provides a classical backbone for modular quantum processors.
items.abstract_zh: 分布式量子网络对于可扩展量子处理器以及通信、分布式计算和传感中的潜在应用很重要；在这些应用中，用于自适应控制的直接经典链路对于利用共享纠缠至关重要。然而，在长距离上从单独的制冷机控制超导量子处理器仍然难以实现。在此，我们引入一种相干光链路（COL），在稀释制冷机之间传递微波波形及其相位参考。该COL结合激光器、微波到光转换器和光到微波光电二极管，通过10 km光纤传输微波控制信号，同时由同一激光器得到的光参考补偿设备之间的频率失配。通过该COL，我们向另一台制冷机中的transmon量子比特和腔量子比特传递通用门集合，并使它们纠缠，实现了80.6%的贝尔态保真度。因此，通过COL传递的量子控制为模块化量子处理器提供了经典骨干。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为光学器件与计算，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Inversion-Free High-Dimensional Counterfactual Inference
items.title_zh: 免反演的高维反事实推断
items.abstract_en: Counterfactual inference is the task of answering hypothetical "what-if" queries about a unit, given an observational dataset, modeling assumptions, and a causal graph. This enables a modeler to reason about hypothetical scenarios that cannot otherwise be answered without assumptions or a causal graph. The simpler case involves a causal graph with scalar 1-D variables that denote different attributes in the data-generation process. While the literature is clear in the 1-D case, extending this to settings with high-dimensional nodes (e.g., images) remains challenging. Conventionally, in the literature, methods recover the latent state from the factual image (inversion), generate counterfactual attributes from the graph, and render the counterfactual image from the latent state using the updated attributes. In our work, we investigate the necessity of the inversion step in computing high-dimensional counterfactuals. We first discuss moving from the scalar 1-D case to the higher-dimensional case. Secondly, we discuss the relevance of the inversion step and evaluate an inversion-free counterpart repurposed from the image-editing literature. Finally, on image datasets such as CelebA and ADNI, we benchmark our approach using two measures: namely, effectiveness and identity preservation. While effectiveness is a measure of how faithfully the counterfactual attribute is rendered, identity preservation measures whether the same unit (image) is being rendered, both of which are crucial for high-dimensional counterfactual inference. We present the tradeoffs of using inversion-based and inversion-free approaches in our work.
items.abstract_zh: 反事实推断是在给定观测数据集、建模假设和因果图的条件下，回答关于某个单元的假设性“如果……会怎样”查询的任务。这使建模者能够对假想情景进行推理，而在没有假设或因果图的情况下，这些情景无法得到回答。较简单的情况涉及具有标量一维变量的因果图，这些变量表示数据生成过程中的不同属性。尽管文献在一维情况下已较为清晰，但将其扩展到具有高维节点（例如图像）的设置仍然具有挑战性。传统上，文献中的方法从事实图像中恢复潜在状态（反演），从图中生成反事实属性，并使用更新后的属性从潜在状态渲染反事实图像。在我们的工作中，我们研究在计算高维反事实时反演步骤的必要性。我们首先讨论从标量一维情况向更高维情况的过渡。其次，我们讨论反演步骤的相关性，并评估一个从图像编辑文献中改造而来的免反演对应方法。最后，在CelebA和ADNI等图像数据集上，我们使用两个度量对我们的方法进行基准测试：即有效性和身份保持。有效性衡量反事实属性被渲染的忠实程度，而身份保持衡量是否渲染的是同一单元（图像），二者对于高维反事实推断都至关重要。我们在工作中展示了使用基于反演和免反演方法的权衡。

items.title_en: How Far Does Second-Order Linear Response Predict Quantization Mismatch? Pre-Registered Measurements on Five Language Models
items.title_zh: 二阶线性响应能在多大程度上预测量化失配？对五个语言模型的预注册测量
items.abstract_en: Serving systems choose a weight format for each model and deployment. A low-cost screen predicts the resulting KL divergence from the unquantized model's Fisher information using $\tfrac12Δ^\top FΔ$, the expansion underlying Hessian-aware and second-order post-training quantizers. We assess the reliability of this screen in GPU batches with channel-wise int8, per-tensor fp8 and group-wise int4 on Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Relative predictions hold across a 16-fold range of perturbation scales, int4 group sizes and rounding modes, while absolute predictions are heavy-tailed. A trimmed average brings 10 of 12 cells on Qwen3-4B and OLMo-2 within 15% of measured KL. The MoE model exhibits nonquadratic response at small perturbations, with int8 KL scaling as $α^{0.63}$. Computing per-sequence gradients in bf16 can cause fourfold prediction errors. We trace these errors to arithmetic in the lower half of the backward pass and eliminate them by using fp32 there. Batch-invariant kernels run at 0.55 times the throughput, while changes in reduction order introduce a floor of 0.17-0.22 nats per sequence. We build a screener with one streamed fp32 Fisher pass, trimmed tensor-block predictions with a band, a flag for aligned tensors and per-layer format allocation. On the unseen Mistral-7B-v0.3 family, all six predictions fall within the band, all three KL budgets are met, and vLLM throughput is predicted within 0.4%.
items.abstract_zh: 服务系统会为每个模型和部署选择权重格式。一种低成本筛选方法利用未量化模型的 Fisher 信息，通过 ½ΔᵀFΔ 预测由此产生的 KL 散度；该展开式也是 Hessian 感知和二阶训练后量化器的基础。我们在 GPU 批次中评估该筛选方法的可靠性，涉及通道级 int8、逐张量 fp8 和分组 int4，并在 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-4B、OLMo-2-7B、Qwen3-32B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上测试。相对预测在扰动尺度、int4 分组大小和舍入模式的 16 倍范围内保持成立，而绝对预测呈重尾分布。采用修剪平均后，Qwen3-4B 和 OLMo-2 上 12 个单元中有 10 个与实测 KL 的误差在 15% 以内。MoE 模型在小扰动下表现出非二次响应，int8 的 KL 按 α^0.63 缩放。以 bf16 计算逐序列梯度可能导致四倍的预测误差。我们将这些误差追溯到反向传播下半段的算术运算，并通过在该处使用 fp32 消除它们。批不变核的运行吞吐为 0.55 倍，而归约顺序的变化引入每序列 0.17–0.22 nats 的下限。我们构建了一个筛选器，包含一次流式 fp32 Fisher 计算遍、带区间的修剪张量块预测、对齐张量标志以及逐层格式分配。在未见过的 Mistral-7B-v0.3 系列上，全部六个预测均落在区间内，三个 KL 预算均得到满足，vLLM 吞吐量的预测误差在 0.4% 以内。

items.title_en: Trajectory Inversion for a Rudderless Dual Vectored-Thrust Flying Wing
items.title_zh: 无舵双矢量推力飞翼的轨迹反演
items.abstract_en: A rudderless dual vectored-thrust flying wing combines vertical takeoff and landing with efficient for- ward flight in a compact tailless configuration. Without aerodynamic control surfaces, vectored thrust couples translation and pitch control. Therefore, generating dy- namically compatible trajectories remains an open chal- lenge. To address this challenge, this study proposes a trajectory generation method that jointly optimizes path geometry and timing. Trajectory inversion yields state and control histories that satisfy the coupled equations of motion. The optimization balances curvature-induced acceleration against aerodynamic support, lowering thrust- vectoring demand while retaining the defining maneuver features. Representative looping and rolling sequences are tracked in closed-loop simulations. These results provide a basis for planning autonomous aerobatic maneuvers with rudderless vectored-thrust aircraft.
items.abstract_zh: 无舵双矢量推力飞翼在紧凑的无尾布局中结合了垂直起降与高效前飞。在没有气动控制面的情况下，矢量推力将平移与俯仰控制耦合。因此，生成动力学兼容的轨迹仍是一个开放挑战。为解决该挑战，本研究提出一种联合优化路径几何与时间安排的轨迹生成方法。轨迹反演产生满足耦合运动方程的状态与控制历史。该优化在曲率诱导加速度与气动支撑之间取得平衡，降低推力矢量需求，同时保留标志性机动特征。代表性筋斗和滚转序列在闭环仿真中被跟踪。这些结果为使用无舵矢量推力飞行器规划自主特技机动提供了基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Occupancy Modelling of Biased Landslide Inventories: When Does Separating Occurrence from Recording Improve on Neutralisation?
items.title_zh: 有偏滑坡清单的占据建模：将发生与记录分离何时优于中和？
items.abstract_en: Landslide susceptibility models are trained on inventories that record where landslides were seen, not where they occurred. The established remedy fits bias-describing variables and neutralises them when mapping. We adapt occupancy-detection modelling from ecology, treating several inventories as imperfect observers of one event and separating occurrence from recording, and ask when this improves on neutralisation. We use near-complete inventories of the 2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi, 2015 Gorkha and 2010 Haiti earthquakes with simulated reporting bias, and three real Gorkha inventories. Compared with standard practice, the occupancy model reduces road bias in 24 of 25 paired draws and raises AUC by 0.08-0.14 on Gorkha and 0.03 on Haiti, but only 0.01-0.02 on Iburi. Its median predicted-to-true landslide rate is 0.99 (range 0.44-1.89), against 0.24-0.30 for the baselines. Rescaling the baselines with the same anchor area corrects their median but leaves larger errors (range 0.20-4.34). Cell-level probabilities remain too extreme (calibration slope 0.59). Compared with the best neutralised model, AUC is higher on Iburi (by 0.03-0.07) and lower on Gorkha and Haiti (by 0.01-0.05). Transplant experiments tie the Iburi advantage to the structure of its true landslide pattern, not to its terrain or road network. In all eight settings with a low interaction gap, computable from biased records, neutralisation was at least as accurate, including a prespecified test on Haiti; a high gap did not guarantee an advantage. The real Gorkha inventories are slope-biased, not road-biased, and there the model brings no meaningful gain. Report-based catalogues remain the main untested case.
items.abstract_zh: 滑坡敏感性模型基于记录滑坡被看见位置的清单进行训练，而不是基于滑坡实际发生的位置。既有补救方法是拟合描述偏差的变量，并在制图时将其中和。我们改编生态学中的占据检测建模，将多个清单视为对同一事件的不完美观测者，并将发生与记录分离，进而考察这种方法何时优于中和。我们使用 2018 年北海道胆振东部地震、2015 年尼泊尔戈尔卡地震和 2010 年海地地震的近完整清单，并加入模拟报告偏差，以及三个真实的戈尔卡清单。与标准做法相比，占据模型在 25 次配对抽样中的 24 次降低了道路偏差，并将戈尔卡的 AUC 提高 0.08–0.14、海地提高 0.03，但胆振仅提高 0.01–0.02。其中位预测滑坡率与真实滑坡率之比为 0.99（范围 0.44–1.89），而基线为 0.24–0.30。用相同锚定面积重新缩放基线可校正其中位数，但会留下更大误差（范围 0.20–4.34）。单元级概率仍然过于极端（校准斜率 0.59）。与最佳中和模型相比，AUC 在胆振更高（高 0.03–0.07），在戈尔卡和海地更低（低 0.01–0.05）。移植实验将胆振的优势与其真实滑坡格局的结构联系起来，而非与其地形或道路网络相关。在所有八个具有低交互差距且可由有偏记录计算的情形中，中和至少同样准确，包括在海地上进行的预设检验；高差距并不保证优势。真实戈尔卡清单存在坡度偏差，而非道路偏差，在该数据上该模型没有带来有意义的增益。基于报告的目录仍是主要未检验情形。

items.title_en: Agents Propose, Code Verifies, Humans Decide: Verified Agentic Ingestion of Heterogeneous Scientific Tables into Relational Databases
items.title_zh: 智能体提议，代码验证，人类决策：将异构科学表格经验证地智能体化摄取到关系数据库
items.abstract_en: Public scientific datasets rarely arrive analysis-ready. They arrive as messy folders of wide matrices, long tables, spreadsheets, and per-cohort files whose keys and encodings differ, and every reanalysis must reconnect them first. A coding agent can automate this, but its mistakes can look plausible, and without an audit trail, a mistake that corrupts data can go uncaught. We present an AI-assisted ingestion pipeline built on one rule: LLM agents propose, deterministic code verifies, and humans decide. Narrow agents see compact, citable evidence about the files, never the data, and return typed proposals. A verifier with 39 check types tests each proposal against that evidence in two loops, one for the schema's structure and one for its meaning, and a human reviewer approves the schema and the load. Code compiles PostgreSQL DDL, reshapes the data, quarantines rows it cannot place, records provenance, and reconciles every staged row against the database. On four public biomedical datasets, one held out from development, 9 of 20 first proposals failed a check and every failure was caught: the loops repaired eight, and a one-line reviewer edit fixed the ninth. All 45.1 million values loaded with zero reconciliation gap. Discovering a dataset's structure took 4-7 LLM calls and preparing its data at most one more, costing under $0.50 per dataset. In a separate test, each of nine planted data errors was quarantined with a reason or recorded in an audit log.
items.abstract_zh: 公共科学数据集很少以可直接分析的形式出现。它们以杂乱文件夹的形式出现，其中包含宽矩阵、长表、电子表格和按队列划分的文件，其键和编码各不相同，每次再分析都必须先将它们重新连接起来。编码智能体可以自动化这一过程，但其错误可能看起来合理，而且如果没有审计轨迹，破坏数据的错误可能不会被发现。我们提出一个 AI 辅助的数据摄取流水线，其建立在一项规则之上：LLM 智能体提议，确定性代码验证，人类决策。窄范围智能体查看关于文件的紧凑、可引用证据，而从不查看数据，并返回类型化提议。一个具有 39 种检查类型的验证器在两个循环中针对该证据检验每个提议，一个循环针对模式的结构，另一个针对其语义，并由人类审阅者批准模式和加载。代码编译 PostgreSQL DDL、重塑数据、隔离无法放置的行、记录来源，并将每个暂存行与数据库对账。在四个公共生物医学数据集上（其中一个留出用于开发），20 个首次提议中有 9 个未通过检查，且每个失败都被捕获：循环修复了八个，审阅者一行编辑修复了第九个。全部 4510 万个值加载完成，对账差异为零。发现数据集结构用了 4–7 次 LLM 调用，准备其数据至多再增加一次调用，每个数据集成本低于 0.50 美元。在一项单独测试中，九个植入的数据错误中的每一个都被隔离并附有原因，或被记录在审计日志中。

items.title_en: AI-Driven Discovery of Entanglement Witness in Spin Hamiltonians
items.title_zh: AI 驱动的自旋哈密顿量中纠缠见证发现
items.abstract_en: Entanglement is a crucial resource in quantum science and engineering, but detecting it in many-body states from experimentally accessible observables remains challenging. Here we introduce EntNet, an AI-driven framework to discover compact combinations of spin observables that accurately distinguish entangled from fully separable many-body mixed states in one-dimensional spin-$1/2$ chains governed by short-range Hamiltonians. We construct local-unitary-invariant representations of measurable Pauli correlators up to four-body order, sparsely select 16 candidate invariant feature channels, and learn their spatial structure using a Transformer architecture with rotary positional embeddings. Using only expectation values of these low-order observables, EntNet achieves $>98\%$ recall on certified entangled states with near-zero false-positive rates on separable states. Remarkably, it exhibits transferability across system sizes and distinct Hamiltonian families, including frustrated and disordered spin models, with minimal loss of accuracy. Beyond detection, EntNet provides physical insight into entanglement detection by revealing a selective spatial organization of pair correlations, while its finite-temperature decision boundary tracks the excitation gap of Jordan-Wigner quasiparticles. These results establish a transferable and physically interpretable framework for data-driven discovery of entanglement witnesses from local correlation functions.
items.abstract_zh: 纠缠是量子科学与工程中的关键资源，但从实验可及的可观测量中检测多体态中的纠缠仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出 EntNet，一个 AI 驱动框架，用于发现自旋可观测量的紧凑组合，从而在一维自旋-1/2 链中准确区分纠缠多体混合态与完全可分离多体混合态，这些链由短程哈密顿量支配。我们构建最多四体阶的可测量泡利关联器的局域幺正不变表示，稀疏选择 16 个候选不变特征通道，并使用带旋转位置嵌入的 Transformer 架构学习其空间结构。仅使用这些低阶可观测量的期望值，EntNet 在已认证纠缠态上达到 >98% 的召回率，在可分离态上假阳性率接近零。值得注意的是，它在系统尺寸和不同哈密顿量族之间表现出可迁移性，包括阻挫和无序自旋模型，且准确率损失极小。除检测之外，EntNet 通过揭示对关联的选择性空间组织，为纠缠检测提供了物理洞见；其有限温度决策边界跟踪 Jordan-Wigner 准粒子的激发间隙。这些结果建立了一个可迁移且物理可解释的框架，用于从局域关联函数中数据驱动地发现纠缠见证。

items.title_en: From Granger causality to causal structure in dynamical systems
items.title_zh: 从格兰杰因果到动力系统中的因果结构
items.abstract_en: The idea of testing whether the past of one signal improves the prediction of another can be traced back to Wiener. It was Granger who formalized the concept. Granger causality has become one of the most widely used tools to infer directed interactions between the components of a system. The name however can be misleading: it detects predictive relations among the measured signals, not causal relations among the mechanisms that generate them. This article starts by reviewing recent advances in observation-space Granger analysis. It then follows a path to directed structure in latent dynamical models, and asks under which conditions that structure can be read causally.
items.abstract_zh: 检验一个信号的过去是否能改进对另一个信号的预测，这一思想可追溯到 Wiener。是 Granger 将该概念形式化。格兰杰因果已成为推断系统各组分之间有向交互的最广泛使用工具之一。然而这一名称可能具有误导性：它检测的是被测信号之间的预测关系，而不是生成这些信号的机制之间的因果 relations。本文首先回顾观测空间格兰杰分析的近期进展，然后沿一条路径走向潜变量动力模型中的有向结构，并追问在哪些条件下该结构可以被因果地解读。

items.title_en: Text Grouping Changes Completion-Time Comparisons in Long-Form Simultaneous Speech Translation
items.title_zh: 文本分组改变长时同声语音翻译中的完成时间比较
items.abstract_en: Does grouping translation updates before speech synthesis change the measured completion gap between two translators? We compare StreamAtt with its fixed-audio-history baseline on ten English-German talks. For each translation, we keep the intended text and its availability times fixed and vary how updates are grouped for synthesis. Four-second grouping increases StreamAtt's mean completion lead from 106.6 to 229.1 seconds with XTTS-v2, but reduces it from 169.5 to 146.5 seconds with Piper. Both produce shorter audio; different changes in playback idle account for the opposite effects. These directions recur on a separately selected twenty-talk panel. In continuing CosyVoice 3 sessions, grouping instead leaves paired audio unchanged and delays completion on nineteen of twenty blocks. A speech-timing comparison therefore needs to specify how text enters synthesis, not just which synthesizer is used. Recognition and automatic word timing describe the outputs, but do not establish translation accuracy or intelligibility.
items.abstract_zh: 在语音合成前对翻译更新进行分组，是否会改变测得的两名翻译器之间的完成时间差？我们在十场英语-德语演讲上比较 StreamAtt 与其固定音频历史基线。对于每个翻译，我们保持预期文本及其可用时间不变，并改变合成时更新的分组方式。四秒分组在 XTTS-v2 下将 StreamAtt 的平均完成领先时间从 106.6 秒提高到 229.1 秒，但在 Piper 下将其从 169.5 秒降低到 146.5 秒。两者都产生更短音频；播放空闲的不同变化解释了相反的效果。这些方向在另行选取的二十场演讲面板上再次出现。在持续的 CosyVoice 3 会话中，分组反而使配对音频保持不变，并在二十个块中的十九个上延迟完成。因此，语音时序比较需要说明文本如何进入合成，而不只是说明使用哪个合成器。识别和自动词级时间标注描述了输出，但不能确立翻译准确性或可懂度。

items.title_en: FATHOM: World-Model-Guided Diffusion Action-Trajectory Selection for Sparse-Marker AUV Tracking
items.title_zh: FATHOM：用于稀疏标记AUV跟踪的世界模型引导扩散动作轨迹选择
items.abstract_en: Reliable relative tracking is fundamental to cooperative autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs), yet remains challenging under nonlinear vehicle dynamics and degraded underwater visual conditions. Active light markers improve robustness to appearance variation, but provide deliberately sparse observations that can become incomplete or corrupted by occlusion, reflections, and detection noise during dynamic motion. To address the resulting partial-observation control problem, this paper proposes FATHOM, a world-model-guided diffusion action-trajectory selection framework for sparse-marker AUV tracking. FATHOM first integrates structured marker observations, inertial measurements, action history, and temporal dynamics into a predictive tracking belief using a multimodal task-supervised recurrent state-space model. A diffusion action prior then generates multiple expert-like multi-thruster trajectories, whose future tracking consequences are predicted through the learned latent dynamics. Rather than directly executing a generated trajectory, FATHOM selects the most favorable candidate under an explicit receding-horizon objective and continually updates the decision from onboard observations. Extensive offline analyses verify the learned predictive belief, multi-step world-model prediction, diffusion trajectory generation, and predictive selection. More importantly, comprehensive real-AUV experiments, including strong pose-based comparisons and component ablations, demonstrate robust autonomous tracking across nominal and challenging motions with naturally occurring partial marker visibility, while maintaining real-time onboard operation without motion-capture feedback.
items.abstract_zh: 可靠的相对跟踪是协作自主水下航行器（AUVs）的基础，但在非线性载体动力学和水下视觉条件退化情况下仍具挑战。主动光标记提高对外观变化的鲁棒性，但提供刻意稀疏的观测，在动态运动过程中可能因遮挡、反射和检测噪声而变得不完整或损坏。为解决由此产生的部分观测控制问题，本文提出FATHOM，一种用于稀疏标记AUV跟踪的世界模型引导扩散动作轨迹选择框架。FATHOM首先使用多模态任务监督的循环状态空间模型，将结构化标记观测、惯性测量、动作历史和时间动态整合为预测性跟踪信念。随后，扩散动作先验生成多个类专家多推进器轨迹，其未来跟踪后果通过学习的潜动力学预测。FATHOM不直接执行生成的轨迹，而是在显式滚动时域目标下选择最有利的候选，并从机载观测持续更新决策。大量离线分析验证了学习的预测信念、多步世界模型预测、扩散轨迹生成和预测选择。更重要的是，全面的真实AUV实验，包括强基于位姿的比较和组件消融，证明在自然发生的部分标记可见性下，跨名义和挑战性运动实现稳健自主跟踪，同时保持无动作捕捉反馈的实时机载运行。

items.title_en: RBA: A Read-out Basis Adapter for Parameter-Efficient Interactive OCTA Vessel Segmentation with SEEM
items.title_zh: RBA：一种用于 SEEM 参数高效交互式 OCTA 血管分割的读出基适配器
items.abstract_en: Retinal disease monitoring with optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) relies on segmentation of vessels and the foveal avascular zone (FAZ). Promptable models such as SEEM (Segment Everything Everywhere All at Once) allow click-based refinement, but without adaptation SEEM segments thin vessels poorly and needs many clicks. Fully fine-tuning its 342 million parameters on a few hundred images is costly and risks overfitting, and parameter-efficient methods such as low-rank adaptation (LoRA) usually adapt only the encoder. Yet SEEM reads every candidate mask from one feature map at quarter resolution, too coarse for vessels one to three pixels wide. This study introduces the Read-out Basis Adapter (RBA), whose read-out branch generates 32 image-specific basis maps at half resolution. Each candidate accesses them through its own vector and a zero-initialised projection, so the model starts exactly as SEEM. The encoder branch, a standard rank-1 LoRA, supplies the information needed to tell arteries from veins. RBA adds 0.47 million trainable parameters. Under simulated error-driven clicks, with the ground truth used only to place them, RBA outperforms LoRA, Conv-LoRA andAdaptFormer on OCTA-500 3mmlarge vessels. Averaged over three seeds, it reaches an intersection over union (IoU) of 85.16% and a Dice score of 91.93%, 2.90 and 1.72 percentage points above Conv-LoRA. On the 6 mm subset, one run gives margins of 4.35 and 2.76 points. The gain extends to arteries, veins and ROSE-O but not to the FAZ. In SEEM, adaptation capacity pays more at the mask read-out than in the encoder.
items.abstract_zh: 利用光学相干断层扫描血管成像 (OCTA) 进行视网膜疾病监测依赖于血管和中心凹无血管区 (FAZ) 的分割。诸如 SEEM（Segment Everything Everywhere All at Once）之类的可提示模型允许基于点击的细化，但未经适配时，SEEM 对细小血管的分割效果差，且需要多次点击。在几百张图像上完全微调其 3.42 亿参数成本高昂且存在过拟合风险，而低秩适配 (LoRA) 等参数高效方法通常只适配编码器。然而，SEEM 从四分之一分辨率的单一特征图读取每个候选掩码，对于 1 到 3 像素宽的血管而言过于粗糙。本研究引入读出基适配器 (RBA)，其读出分支以半分辨率生成 32 个图像特定基图。每个候选通过自己的向量和零初始化投影访问这些基图，因此模型初始时与 SEEM 完全一致。编码器分支是标准秩-1 LoRA，提供区分动脉与静脉所需的信息。RBA 增加 47 万可训练参数。在模拟错误驱动点击下，真实标注仅用于放置点击，RBA 在 OCTA-500 3mm 大血管上优于 LoRA、Conv-LoRA 和 AdaptFormer。在三个随机种子上平均，它达到 85.16% 的交并比 (IoU) 和 91.93% 的 Dice 分数，分别比 Conv-LoRA 高 2.90 和 1.72 个百分点。在 6 mm 子集上，一次运行给出 4.35 和 2.76 个百分点的优势。该增益扩展到动脉、静脉和 ROSE-O，但不扩展到 FAZ。在 SEEM 中，适配容量在掩码读出处比在编码器中带来更多收益。

items.title_en: Causal Outcome Learning with Noisy Proxies
items.title_zh: 含噪声代理的因果结局学习
items.abstract_en: Modern observational biomedical datasets contain increasingly extensive baseline and outcome measurements, yet detecting a clinically meaningful treatment effect remains difficult because investigators must identify an outcome that captures treatment response while adjusting for confounding distributed across numerous noisy baseline variables. We introduce SCOUT (Score-based Causal Outcome Learning Using Treatment signals), a framework that learns a clinically interpretable, treatment-responsive outcome while adjusting for confounding throughout the learning process. SCOUT constructs low-dimensional adjustment representations of high-dimensional baseline measurements to estimate the average treatment effect (ATE) and conditional average treatment effect (CATE) for the learned outcome. Importantly, the final adjustment space is at most two-dimensional, allowing treatment-effect heterogeneity to be estimated in this space rather than in the full high-dimensional covariate space. SCOUT also introduces a fourth-order statistic for testing treatment-effect heterogeneity that emphasizes unusually large deviations from the ATE. In synthetic and semi-synthetic experiments, the algorithm achieved competitive ATE estimation accuracy and substantially lower CATE estimation error. In an observational study of patients with bipolar disorder, SCOUT identified a clinically recognizable lithium-associated adverse-effect profile, detecting both a significant ATE (Holm-adjusted $p$ = 0.0026) and significant treatment-effect heterogeneity (Holm-adjusted $p$ = 0.033).These results demonstrate how jointly learning outcomes and controlling for confounding can facilitate the discovery of treatment effects in high-dimensional observational data.
items.abstract_zh: 现代观察性生物医学数据集包含越来越广泛的基线和结局测量，但检测有临床意义的治疗效果仍然困难，因为研究者必须识别一个能捕捉治疗反应的结局，同时校正分布在众多含噪基线变量中的混杂。我们引入 SCOUT（Score-based Causal Outcome Learning Using Treatment signals），这是一个在学习全过程校正混杂的同时学习临床可解释、对治疗有反应的结局的框架。SCOUT 构建高维基线测量的低维校正表示，以估计所学结局的平均治疗效果 (ATE) 和条件平均治疗效果 (CATE)。重要的是，最终校正空间至多二维，使治疗效果异质性能够在该空间中估计，而不是在完整高维协变量空间中估计。SCOUT 还引入一个四阶统计量来检验治疗效果异质性，该统计量强调相对 ATE 的异常大偏差。在合成和半合成实验中，该算法取得了有竞争力的 ATE 估计精度和显著更低的 CATE 估计误差。在一项双相情感障碍患者的观察性研究中，SCOUT 识别出临床可识别的锂相关不良反应特征，检测到显著的 ATE（Holm 校正 $p$ = 0.0026）和显著的治疗效果异质性（Holm 校正 $p$ = 0.033）。这些结果表明，联合学习结局并控制混杂如何促进高维观察数据中的治疗效果发现。

items.title_en: Beyond Quantum Messages: Toward Quantum-Native Network Functioning
items.title_zh: 超越量子消息：迈向量子原生网络功能
items.abstract_en: The Quantum Internet is commonly envisioned as a network that transports quantum states and distributes entanglement as the key resource underpinning distributed quantum applications. This view is necessary but incomplete if quantum phenomena are confined to what the network carries or manages, while network functionalities remain grounded predominantly in classical abstractions. This Perspective advances a broader thesis: quantum phenomena can also participate directly in the realization of network functionalities. We first establish the architectural baseline by introducing entanglement as a stateful network resource whose operational condition is non-locally distributed across remote nodes, evolves through manipulation or consumption, and degrades over time through decoherence. Its evolving state must therefore remain visible to the functionalities acting on it. We then move beyond resource visibility and use two mechanisms as proof points of a broader quantum-native functional design space: entanglement generation during propagation through coherent spatial-path superposition, and operational connectivity induced by shared entanglement that can depart from the physical graph. These examples show that paths, neighbors, or participating nodes may become operationally relevant in ways determined by quantum coherence and shared entanglement, rather than by physical connectivity alone. We identify Quantum Addressing as a transversal abstraction capable of representing such relations while complementing, rather than replacing, classical addressing and signaling. The resulting perspective broadens the Quantum Internet from transporting quantum information and distributing entanglement to exploiting quantum phenomena in network functioning, opening a coupled frontier spanning routing, forwarding, control, and functionality placement.
items.abstract_zh: 量子互联网通常被设想为传输量子态并分发纠缠的网络，纠缠是支撑分布式量子应用的关键资源。如果量子现象仅限于网络所承载或管理的内容，而网络功能仍主要基于经典抽象，这一观点虽然必要但不完整。本展望提出一个更广泛的论点：量子现象也可以直接参与网络功能的实现。我们首先通过引入纠缠作为一种有状态网络资源来建立架构基线，其运行条件非局域地分布在远程节点上，通过操纵或消耗而演化，并随时间因退相干而退化。因此，其演化状态必须对作用于它的功能保持可见。随后，我们超越资源可见性，使用两种机制作为更广泛的量子原生功能设计空间的例证：通过相干空间路径叠加在传播过程中生成纠缠，以及由共享纠缠诱导的可偏离物理图的操作连通性。这些例子表明，路径、邻居或参与节点可能以由量子相干性和共享纠缠而非仅由物理连通性决定的方式变得操作相关。我们将量子寻址（Quantum Addressing）确定为一种能够表示此类关系的横向抽象，同时补充而非取代经典寻址和信令。由此形成的视角将量子互联网从传输量子信息和分发纠缠扩展到在网络功能中利用量子现象，开辟了一个跨越路由、转发、控制和功能放置的耦合前沿。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Inference Validation for Regulated AI: Building a Decision Pipeline on NVIDIA AIPerf
items.title_zh: 受监管 AI 的推理验证：在 NVIDIA AIPerf 上构建决策流水线
items.abstract_en: Deploying large language models in regulated industries requires more than picking the fastest inference engine: it requires evidence that a configuration meets contractual and legal obligations before it serves a single customer request. We describe Runway, an internal validation harness built at MasterControl that builds a governed decision pipeline around NVIDIA AIPerf. The key insight is separating concerns: AIPerf provides the trusted measurement, while Runway provides the experiment design that comes before it and the compliance, cost, and audit decisions that come after. We describe the architecture and the storage model that makes caching and audit one mechanism. We report three findings from Runway sweeps: TensorRT-LLM and vLLM rankings invert with concurrency; a newer, pricier GPU instance can be the cheaper one per request; and speculative decoding behaves differently across engines under load, so engine configuration can outweigh engine choice.
items.abstract_zh: 在受监管行业部署大语言模型需要的不仅是选择最快的推理引擎：它需要证据，证明某个配置在服务任一客户请求之前满足合同和法律义务。我们描述 Runway，这是 MasterControl 构建的内部验证框架，它在 NVIDIA AIPerf 周围构建受治理的决策流水线。关键洞见是关注点分离：AIPerf 提供可信测量，而 Runway 提供其之前的实验设计以及其后的合规、成本和审计决策。我们描述架构和存储模型，该存储模型使缓存与审计成为一个机制。我们报告 Runway 系列测试的三项发现：TensorRT-LLM 与 vLLM 的排名随并发度反转；更新、更贵的 GPU 实例按每请求计算可能更便宜；推测解码在不同引擎负载下表现不同，因此引擎配置可能比引擎选择更重要。

items.title_en: Detecting AI-Authored Text in Authentic Student Writing: Evidence from PISA 2025
items.title_zh: 在真实学生写作中检测 AI 撰写文本：来自 PISA 2025 的证据
items.abstract_en: AI-text detectors reach near-perfect scores in evaluations that contrast fully human-written texts with texts generated from researcher-designed prompts. In authentic student writing, however, AI use is voluntary and often partial. We study this setting with the PISA 2025 FLA dataset, in which 15-year-olds in Germany wrote English argumentative essays with and without access to a gpt-4o-mini-based chatbot. Keystroke, clipboard and chat logs let us trace every character of the final essay to its origin. From this provenance, we derive text- and sentence-level labels for human-written, AI-generated and mixed text, and for text written after chatbot use without traceable AI material. We evaluate a feature-based detector and a classifier on frozen Llama-3.1-8B embeddings, both adapted from top-ranked shared-task systems. Both separate AI from human text reliably (macro-F1 up to 0.96 for texts and 0.95 for sentences), independently of spelling errors. The feature-based detector, however, relies on lexical complexity, which a simple student-style rewriting prompt removes (AI recall 0.92 $\to$ 0.60 with gpt-4o-mini, 0.41 with Qwen3). The embedding-based detector stays robust for whole texts (AI recall $\geq$ 0.94) but not for single sentences (AI recall as low as 0.59). Mixed text falls between the two classes, and text without traceable AI material is classified as human-written in about 95\% of texts.
items.abstract_zh: 在将完全由人类撰写的文本与根据研究者设计提示生成的文本进行对比的评估中，AI 文本检测器达到近乎完美的分数。然而，在真实学生写作中，AI 使用是自愿的且常常是部分的。我们使用 PISA 2025 FLA 数据集研究这一情境，其中德国 15 岁学生在可使用和不可使用基于 gpt-4o-mini 的聊天机器人条件下撰写英语议论文。击键、剪贴板和聊天日志使我们能够将最终论文的每个字符追溯到其来源。基于这种来源信息，我们推导出文本级和句子级标签，分别对应人类撰写、AI 生成和混合文本，以及聊天机器人使用后撰写但不含可追溯 AI 材料的文本。我们评估一个基于特征的检测器和一个基于冻结 Llama-3.1-8B 嵌入的分类器，二者均改编自排名靠前的共享任务系统。二者都能可靠区分 AI 与人类文本（文本 macro-F1 最高 0.96，句子 0.95），且不受拼写错误影响。然而，基于特征的检测器依赖词汇复杂性，而简单的学生风格改写提示会消除这种复杂性（使用 gpt-4o-mini 时 AI 召回率 0.92 → 0.60，使用 Qwen3 时 0.41）。基于嵌入的检测器对整篇文本保持稳健（AI 召回率 ≥ 0.94），但对单句不稳健（AI 召回率低至 0.59）。混合文本介于两类之间，不含可追溯 AI 材料的文本在约 95% 的文本中被分类为人类撰写。

items.title_en: A Multimodal Haptic Interface for Simultaneous Softness and Thermal Modulation
items.title_zh: 用于同时调制柔软度与温度的多模态触觉界面
items.abstract_en: Haptic interactions, such as touching an object in virtual reality, involve detecting a plethora of sensations through the skin. Whilst tactile displays exist to simulate and manipulate all of these cues individually, little progress has been made constructing devices that can control multiple cues simultaneously. This paper presents a tactile display technology that offers both softness and temperature change. A prototype display, based on particle jamming and the thermal transfer of heated and cooled water, is evaluated in terms of its ability to change both stiffness and temperature. Mechanical evaluations demonstrate controllable stiffness increase of 300%, whilst thermal characterisation showed strong surface uniformity and a range of achievable temperatures from 10°C up to 50°C, with closed-loop control maintaining a 0.2°C error from a setpoint. This work advances the design of multimodal tactile displays with applications to perceptual research, medical simulation, and affective haptics.
items.abstract_zh: 触觉交互，例如在虚拟现实中触摸物体，涉及通过皮肤检测大量感觉。尽管已有触觉显示器可分别模拟和操控所有这些线索，但在构建能同时控制多种线索的设备方面进展甚微。本文提出一种同时提供柔软度和温度变化的触觉显示技术。一个基于颗粒阻塞以及加热和冷却水热传递的原型显示器，就其改变刚度和温度的能力进行了评估。力学评估表明刚度可控制地增加300%，热表征显示表面均匀性强，可实现温度范围为10°C至50°C，闭环控制相对设定点的误差保持在0.2°C。这项工作推进了多模态触觉显示器的设计，其应用包括知觉研究、医学仿真和情感触觉。
